function totalVehicleValue(inv){return (inv.vehicles||[]).reduce((s,v)=>s+v.value,0);}
function vehicleMonthlyCost(inv){return (inv.vehicles||[]).reduce((s,v)=>s+v.monthlyCost,0);}

function tickVehicles(inv){
  if(!inv.vehicles) inv.vehicles=[];
  for(const v of inv.vehicles){
    // Monthly depreciation = yearly rate / 12
    v.value = Math.max(Math.round(v.price*0.15), Math.round(v.value * (1 - v.depRate/12)));
    v.age = (v.age||0) + 1;
  }
}

function tickMarket(inv){
  if(inv.climateYearsLeft>0){inv.climateYearsLeft--;if(inv.climateYearsLeft===0)inv.climate='normal';}
  else{
    const r=Math.random();
    if(r<0.07){inv.climate='recession';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,3);}
    else if(r<0.13){inv.climate='bear';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,2);}
    else if(r<0.21){inv.climate='bull';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,3);}
    else if(r<0.25){inv.climate='bubble';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,2);}
    else inv.climate='normal';
  }
}

const CLIMATE_MULT = {
  normal:{stock:1.0,tech:1.0,crypto:1.0,re:1.0},
  bull:{stock:1.4,tech:1.5,crypto:1.3,re:1.15},
  bear:{stock:0.75,tech:0.70,crypto:0.65,re:0.90},
  bubble:{stock:1.1,tech:2.0,crypto:1.5,re:1.0},
  recession:{stock:0.70,tech:0.65,crypto:0.50,re:0.85},
};

function tickStocks(inv){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  const SQRT12=Math.sqrt(12);
  for(const s of inv.stocks){
    const cm=s.sector==='tech'?m.tech:s.id==='SPY'?m.stock:m.stock;
    const annDrift=(s.avgReturn||0.08)*cm-1;
    const monthlyDrift=annDrift/12;
    const monthlyVol=s.vol/SQRT12;
    const z=randn();
    s.price=Math.max(0.01,+(s.price*(1+monthlyDrift+monthlyVol*z)).toFixed(2));
    s.history.push(s.price);if(s.history.length>50)s.history.shift();
  }
}

function tickCrypto(inv){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  const SQRT12=Math.sqrt(12);
  for(const c of inv.cryptos){
    const z=randn();
    const monthlyDrift=rf(-0.3,0.5)*m.crypto/12;
    const monthlyVol=c.vol*0.3/SQRT12;
    const ret=monthlyDrift+monthlyVol*z;
    c.price=Math.max(0.00001,+(c.price*(1+ret)).toPrecision(5));
    c.history.push(c.price);if(c.history.length>50)c.history.shift();
  }
}

function tickRetirement(inv, char){
  const baseRet={normal:0.07,bull:0.12,bear:0.02,bubble:0.09,recession:-0.05}[inv.climate]||0.07;
  const z=randn(); const r=baseRet+0.10*z;
  inv.k401=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.k401*(1+r)));
  inv.ira=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.ira*(1+r)));
  inv.roth=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.roth*(1+r)));
  // Auto 401k contribution if employed
  if(char.employed&&char.salary>0){
    const contrib=Math.round(char.salary*0.05);
    const match=Math.round(char.salary*0.03);
    inv.k401+=contrib+match;
    char.checking-=contrib;
  }
}

function tickRealEstate(inv, ev){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  let rentInc=0, mortPaid=0;
  for(const p of inv.properties){
    const z=randn(); const app=(0.03+0.06*z)*m.re;
    p.value=Math.max(10000,Math.round(p.value*(1+app)));
    if(p.debt>0){const pay=p.monthlyPayment*12;const int=p.debt*0.065;const prin=Math.min(p.debt,pay-int);p.debt=Math.max(0,p.debt-prin);mortPaid+=pay;}
    if(p.rented){p.rent=Math.round(p.rent*1.03);rentInc+=p.rent*12;}
    p.age++;
  }
  if(rentInc>0) ev.push({type:'good',text:`Rental income: ${fmt$(rentInc)}/yr`});
}

function tickBusinesses(inv, char, ev){
  for(const b of inv.businesses){
    if(!b.employees) b.employees=[];
    if(b.equipTier===undefined){ b.equipTier=1; b.equipAge=0; }
    const cm=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
    const statF=(char.smarts/100)*0.6+(char.looks/100)*0.2+0.2;
    // Employee morale dampens boost: avg morale < 50 cuts effectiveness
    const avgMorale=b.employees.length ? b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.morale||75),0)/b.employees.length : 75;
    const moraleF=0.4 + (avgMorale/100)*0.7;  // ~0.75 at 50 morale, ~1.05 at 90
    const empBoost=1 + b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+((e.boost||0)*((e.morale||75)/75)),0);
    const einfo = equipmentInfo(b);
    const equipF = 1 + einfo.tier.revBoost - (einfo.old ? 0.08 : 0);
    const rev=Math.round(b.startCost*b.revMult*statF*(cm.stock)*rf(0.75,1.25)*Math.max(0.5,Math.log(b.age+2))*empBoost*equipF);
    const wages=b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.wage||0)*12,0);
    const exp=Math.round(rev*rf(0.55,0.75)+b.startCost*0.05)+wages;
    b.profit=rev-exp; b.value=Math.max(Math.round(b.startCost*0.3),Math.round(b.profit*rf(2,4)));
    b.age++;
    b.equipAge=(b.equipAge||0)+1;
    if(b.profit>0){char.checking+=b.profit;ev.push({type:'good',text:`${b.name} profit: ${fmt$(b.profit)} (wages ${fmt$(wages)}, morale ${Math.round(avgMorale)}%, equip ${einfo.tier.label}${einfo.old?' OLD':''})`});}
    else{char.checking+=b.profit;ev.push({type:'bad',text:`${b.name} loss: ${fmt$(Math.abs(b.profit))} (wages ${fmt$(wages)}, morale ${Math.round(avgMorale)}%, equip ${einfo.tier.label}${einfo.old?' OLD':''})`});}
  }
}

    const einfo = equipmentInfo(b);

    const profitPerEmp = (b.profit||0) / Math.max(1, b.employees.length);
    for(const e of b.employees){
      e.tenure = (e.tenure||0)+1;
      if(e.morale===undefined) e.morale=75;
      // Monthly morale drift
      let drift = ri(-2,2);
      if(profitPerEmp > 5000) drift += 2;
      else if(profitPerEmp < -2000) drift -= 4;
      else if(profitPerEmp < 0) drift -= 2;
      // Old equipment erodes morale over time
      if(einfo.old) drift -= ri(1,3);
      else if(einfo.tier.tier >= 4) drift += 1;
      // Long tenure without pay bump â†’ slight decay
      if(e.tenure > 24 && e.tenure % 12 === 0) drift -= 1;

      if(!pct(0.12)) continue;

function sponsorsUnlocked(inv){ return totalBizValue(inv||GS.inv) >= 500000; }
function rollSponsorOffers(){
  const inv = GS.inv;
  const bizVal = totalBizValue(inv);
  const scale = Math.min(4, 1 + Math.log10(Math.max(1, bizVal/500000))); // 1x at 500k, ~2x at 5M, ~3x at 50M
  const pool = SPONSOR_CATALOG.slice();
  const picks = [];
  const n = Math.min(5, pool.length);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const idx = ri(0, pool.length-1);
    const s = pool.splice(idx,1)[0];
    const monthly = Math.round(s.monthly * scale * rf(0.85, 1.25));
    picks.push({...s, monthly});
  }
  inv.sponsorOffers = picks;
  inv.sponsorOffersMonth = GS.char.monthAge;
  return picks;
}
function signSponsor(offer){
  const inv = GS.inv;

function tickSportsOffers(c){
  if(!c.employed || c.jobSector !== 'sports') return;
  // 6% chance per month of receiving an offer
  if(!pct(0.06)) return;
  const teams = SPORTS_TEAMS[c.jobId];
  if(!teams || !teams.length) return;
  // Avoid repeat offers from the current team
  const team = pick(teams.filter(t => t.name !== c.sportsTeam)) || pick(teams);
  const cur = c.salary || 0;
  const baseOffer = ri(team.min, team.max);
  const newSalary = Math.max(baseOffer, Math.round(cur * rf(1.15, 1.8)));
  const raise = newSalary - cur;
  if(raise <= 0) return;
  const months = pick([12, 24, 36, 48]);
  const monthlyPay = Math.round(newSalary / 12);
  const curMonthly = Math.round(cur / 12);
  const raiseMonthly = monthlyPay - curMonthly;
  const y = Math.floor(c.monthAge/12), m = (c.monthAge%12)+1;
  addInboxItem({
    type:'offer',
    icon: team.emoji,
    subject: `${team.name} offers you a contract`,
    date: `Y${y}M${m}`,
    body: `Dear ${c.name},\n\n${team.name} (${team.league}) wants to sign you as a ${c.jobTitle} to a ${months}-month deal.\n\nCurrent: ${fmt$(cur)}/yr (${fmt$(curMonthly)}/mo)\nOffered: ${fmt$(newSalary)}/yr (${fmt$(monthlyPay)}/mo)\nRaise:   +${fmt$(raise)}/yr (+${fmt$(raiseMonthly)}/mo)\n\nSigning bonus: ${fmt$(Math.round(newSalary*0.08))}\n\nIf you accept, your salary is immediately replaced with the offered amount and paid out from the team.`,
    offer:{
      teamName: team.name,
      league: team.league,
      emoji: team.emoji,
      newSalary,
      months,
      raise,
      raiseMonthly,
      signingBonus: Math.round(newSalary*0.08),
    },
  });
}

function sendEuroCompResults(c){
  const comp = c._euroComp;
  if(!comp || !EURO_COMP_POOLS[comp]) return;
  const meta = EURO_COMP_META[comp];
  const pool = EURO_COMP_POOLS[comp].filter(t => t !== c.sportsTeam);
  const salaryFactor = Math.min(1, (c.salary||0) / 10000000);
  // League-phase finish position (1-36), salary-biased
  const r = Math.random();
  let leaguePos;
  if(salaryFactor > 0.5) leaguePos = r<0.5 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.85 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  else if(salaryFactor > 0.2) leaguePos = r<0.3 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.75 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  else leaguePos = r<0.15 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.6 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  const path = [];
  path.push(`League phase: finished ${ordinal(leaguePos)} of 36`);
  let champion = null;
  let eliminatedAt = null;
  const shuffleOpp = () => pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  const aggScore = (win) => {
    const a = win ? ri(2,4) : ri(0,2);
    const b = win ? ri(0,2) : ri(2,4);
    if(a === b) return `${a}-${b} (${win?'won':'lost'} on penalties)`;
    return `${a}-${b} agg`;
  };
  if(leaguePos > 24){
    eliminatedAt = 'league phase';
  } else {
    if(leaguePos > 8){
      const kpOpp = shuffleOpp();
      const win = Math.random() < (0.45 + salaryFactor*0.2);
      path.push(`Knockout Playoff vs ${kpOpp} â€” ${aggScore(win)} ${win?'âœ…':'â�Œ'}`);
      if(!win) eliminatedAt = 'Knockout Playoff';
    } else {
      path.push(`Top 8 finish â†’ direct to Round of 16 âœ…`);
    }
    if(!eliminatedAt){
      const rounds = ['Round of 16','Quarterfinal','Semifinal','Final'];
      for(const round of rounds){
        const opp = shuffleOpp();
        const isFinal = round === 'Final';
        const baseWin = 0.5 + salaryFactor*0.15;
        const win = Math.random() < baseWin;
        const scoreTxt = isFinal
          ? (win ? `${ri(1,3)}-${ri(0,2)}` : `${ri(0,2)}-${ri(1,3)}`) + ' (single match)'
          : aggScore(win);
        path.push(`${round} vs ${opp} â€” ${scoreTxt} ${win?'âœ…':'â�Œ'}`);
        if(!win){ eliminatedAt = round; break; }
        if(isFinal){ champion = c.sportsTeam; break; }
      }
    }
  }
  if(!champion) champion = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  const won = champion === c.sportsTeam;
  // Effects
  if(won){
    c.happiness = clamp((c.happiness||75) + 15, 0, 100);
    c.checking += Math.round((c.salary||0) * 0.15);
  } else if(eliminatedAt === 'league phase'){
    c.happiness = clamp((c.happiness||75) - 4, 0, 100);
  }
  const summary = won
    ? `ðŸ�† ${c.sportsTeam} WON the ${meta.label}! Continental champions!`
    : `Campaign ended in the ${eliminatedAt || 'final'}.`;
  const body =
    `${meta.icon} ${meta.label} â€” Campaign Summary\n\n`+
    `${summary}\n\n`+
    `ðŸ�† ${meta.short} Winner: ${champion}\n\n`+
    `Your path:\n${path.map((p,i)=>`${i+1}. ${p}`).join('\n')}\n\n`+
    (won ? `Prize: ${fmt$(Math.round((c.salary||0)*0.15))} bonus credited. +15 happiness.\n\n` : '') +
    `Next season's European qualification depends on your domestic league finish.`;
  const y = Math.floor(c.monthAge/12);
  addInboxItem({
    type:'news', icon: won ? 'ðŸ�†' : meta.icon,
    subject: won ? `${meta.short} CHAMPIONS â€” ${c.sportsTeam}!` : `${meta.short} â€” ${c.sportsTeam} campaign ended`,
    date: `Y${y}-Jun`,
    body,
  });

}

function sendNHLStanleyCup(c){
  const team = c.sportsTeam;

  const seed = c._nhlSeed || 16;

  const otherChamp = pick(NHL_CONFERENCES[otherConf]);
  const inPlayoffs = seed <= 10; // 1-6 auto, 7-10 via play-in
  const salaryFactor = Math.min(1, (c.salary||0)/10000000);

  addInboxItem({type:'news', icon:'ðŸ�†', subject:`Stanley Cup â€” ${inPlayoffs?'Results':'Recap'}`, date:`Y${y}-Jun`, body});

function tickNHLSeason(c){
  if(c.jobId !== 'hockey_player' || !c.sportsTeam) return;
  const m = c.monthAge % 12;
  if(m === 9) sendNHLSchedule(c);        // October

function signSportsContract(item){
  const c = GS.char;
  if(!item || !item.offer) return 'Invalid offer.';
  if(c.jobSector !== 'sports'){ return 'You\'re no longer a pro athlete.'; }
  const o = item.offer;
  c.salary = o.newSalary;
  c.sportsTeam = o.teamName;
  // Reset jobTitle to the base role (strip any prior team), then append new team
  const baseRole = (c.jobTitle||'').split(' @ ')[0];
  c.jobTitle = `${baseRole} @ ${o.teamName}`;
  // Reset European qualification â€” new team, re-seed next tick
  c._euroInit = false; c._euroComp = null;
  c.checking += o.signingBonus;
  item.signed = true;
  item.body += `\n\nâœ… Signed. New salary applied: ${fmt$(o.newSalary)}/yr. Signing bonus ${fmt$(o.signingBonus)} credited.`;

function tickSponsors(inv, char){
  if(!inv.sponsors || !inv.sponsors.length) return;
  const remaining=[];
  for(const s of inv.sponsors){
    char.checking += s.monthly;
    s.monthsLeft--;
    if(s.monthsLeft <= 0){
      addInboxItem({
        type:'news', icon:s.icon,
        subject:`Sponsorship ended â€” ${s.name}`,
        date: currentMonthDate(char),
        body:`Your deal with ${s.name} has run its course.\n\nTotal monthly payments over the term added up over time. You can re-sign if they're still available in the Sponsors tab.`
      });
    } else {
      remaining.push(s);
    }
  }
  inv.sponsors = remaining;
}

function stockPortfolioValue(inv){
  return Object.entries(inv.portfolio).reduce((s,[id,pos])=>{
    const st=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===id);return s+(st?st.price*pos.shares:0);},0);
}
function cryptoPortfolioValue(inv){
  return Object.entries(inv.cryptoHeld).reduce((s,[id,pos])=>{
    const c=inv.cryptos.find(x=>x.id===id);return s+(c?c.price*pos.coins:0);},0);
}
function totalRetirement(inv){return inv.k401+inv.ira+inv.roth;}
function totalPropertyValue(inv){return inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0);}
function totalPropertyEquity(inv){return inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+(p.value-p.debt),0);}
function totalBizValue(inv){return inv.businesses.reduce((s,b)=>s+b.value,0);}

function calcNetWorth(char, inv){
  const liquid=char.checking+char.savings+char.highYield;
  const invested=stockPortfolioValue(inv)+cryptoPortfolioValue(inv)+totalRetirement(inv)+totalPropertyEquity(inv)+totalBizValue(inv)+totalVehicleValue(inv);
  const debt=char.debt+(inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.debt,0));
  return liquid+invested-debt;
}

function selectEvents(char){
  const rw={opportunity:60,disaster:40,milestone:50,flavor:30};
  const elig=EVENTS_POOL.filter(e=>{try{return e.cond(char)}catch{return false}});
  if(!elig.length)return[];
  const pool=elig.map(e=>({e,w:rw[e.cat]||20}));
  const total=pool.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.w,0);
  const count=ri(1,3); const sel=[]; const used=new Set();
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const rem=pool.filter(x=>!used.has(x.e.id));
    if(!rem.length)break;
    let r=Math.random()*rem.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.w,0);
    for(const{e,w}of rem){r-=w;if(r<=0){sel.push(e);used.add(e.id);break;}}
  }
  return sel;
}

// â”€â”€ Pending Expense Tick â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function tickPendingExpenses(char, ev){
  if(!char.pendingExpenses) char.pendingExpenses=[];
  const stillPending=[];
  for(const exp of char.pendingExpenses){
    exp.monthsLeft--;
    if(exp.monthsLeft<=0){
      // Time's up â€” force-pay regardless of balance
      const hadFunds = char.checking >= exp.cost;
      char.checking -= exp.cost;
      // Credit score hit: -15 to -25, worse if it pushed balance negative
      const scoreDrop = hadFunds ? ri(15,25) : ri(30,50);
      char.creditScore = clamp(char.creditScore - scoreDrop, 300, 850);
      const balanceNote = !hadFunds ? ` Account went negative!` : '';
      if(!char.belongings) char.belongings=[];
      char.belongings.push({id:`b_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, name:exp.name, icon:exp.icon, cost:exp.cost, purchasedAt:char.monthAge});
      ev.push({type:'bad', text:`âš ï¸� Forced payment: ${exp.icon} ${exp.name} â€” ${fmt$(exp.cost)} auto-deducted. Credit score -${scoreDrop}.${balanceNote}`});
    } else {
      stillPending.push(exp);
    }
  }
  char.pendingExpenses = stillPending;
}

// â”€â”€ Monthly Expense Generator â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function generateMonthlyExpenseEvent(char){
  if(char.age < 16) return null;
  // Pick 4 distinct items, each with its own rolled cost
  const pool = MONTHLY_EXPENSES.slice();
  const picks = [];
  const count = Math.min(4, pool.length);
  for(let i=0; i<count; i++){
    const idx = ri(0, pool.length-1);
    const item = pool.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    picks.push({item, cost: ri(item.min, item.max)});
  }
  const descLines = picks.map(p => `${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)}`).join('  Â·  ');
  const choices = [];
  for(const p of picks){
    choices.push({
      text:`Buy ${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)}`,
      fn(c){
        c.checking -= p.cost;
        const bump = ri(1,3);
        c.creditScore = clamp(c.creditScore + bump, 300, 850);
        if(!c.belongings) c.belongings=[];
        c.belongings.push({id:`b_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, name:p.item.name, icon:p.item.icon, cost:p.cost, purchasedAt:c.monthAge});
        return `Paid ${fmt$(p.cost)} for ${p.item.name}. Added to belongings â€” sell anytime from Assets tab. Credit score +${bump}.`;
      }
    });
  }
  for(const p of picks){
    choices.push({
      text:`Defer ${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)} (10 mo)`,
      fn(c){
        if(!c.pendingExpenses) c.pendingExpenses=[];
        c.pendingExpenses.push({name:p.item.name, icon:p.item.icon, cost:p.cost, monthsLeft:10});
        return `Deferred ${p.item.name}. ${fmt$(p.cost)} due in 10 months. Miss it and your credit takes a hit.`;
      }
    });
  }
  choices.push({
    text:`Pass â€” none of these`,
    fn(){ return `Skipped this month's offers. Maybe next time.`; }
  });
  return {
    id: 'monthly_expense_'+Date.now(),
    title: 'Monthly Shopping Offers',
    cat: 'expense',
    icon: picks[0].item.icon,
    desc: `Four items caught your eye this month. Pick one to buy, defer the cost up to 10 months, or pass entirely.\n\n${descLines}`,
    choices,
  };
}

function annualTick(){ monthlyTick(); } // alias kept for compatibility

function monthlyTick(){
  const c=GS.char, inv=GS.inv;
  const ev=[];

  c.monthAge++;
  const prevAge = c.age;
  c.age = Math.floor(c.monthAge / 12);
  const isNewYear = c.age > prevAge; // a full year just completed

  // Auto high school at 14
  if(c.age===14&&isNewYear&&c.education==='none'&&!c.inSchool){
    c.inSchool=true;c.schoolType='high_school';c.schoolMonthsLeft=48;c.schoolCostMonthly=0;
    ev.push({type:'info',text:'Started high school.'});
  }

  // School progress (monthly)
  tickSchool(c, ev);

  // Auto seek job
  if(!c.inSchool&&!c.employed&&!c.retired&&c.age>=16&&pct(0.065)){
    const avail=getAvailableJobs(c);
    if(avail.length){const j=avail[ri(0,Math.min(2,avail.length-1))];applyForJob(c,j);ev.push({type:'good',text:`Got job: ${c.jobTitle} â€” ${fmt$(c.salary)}/yr`});}
  }

  // Monthly markets: prices update every month
  tickStocks(inv);
  tickCrypto(inv);
  tickVehicles(inv);

  // Annual systems: fire once per year
  if(isNewYear){
    tickCareerNew(c, ev);
    tickRelationship(c, ev);
    tickMarket(inv);
    tickRetirement(inv, c);
    tickRealEstate(inv, ev);
    tickBusinesses(inv, c, ev);
    if(c.age>40) c.health=clamp(c.health-rf(0.5,1.5),0,100);
  }

  // Tick deferred expenses (auto-pay overdue ones)
  tickPendingExpenses(c, ev);

  // Monthly sponsor payments + term tracking
  tickSponsors(inv, c);

  // Sports team contract offers (monthly chance for athletes)
  tickSportsOffers(c);

  // Soccer season events (fixtures in Aug, standings in Jun)
  tickSoccerSeason(c);
  // NFL season: Sep schedule, Jan playoffs, Feb Super Bowl
  tickNFLSeason(c);
  // NHL season: Oct schedule, Apr play-in, Jun Stanley Cup
  tickNHLSeason(c);

  // Monthly finances
  const fin=tickFinances(c, ev);

  // Happiness drifts slowly each month
  c.happiness=clamp(Math.round(c.happiness+(55-c.happiness)*0.004),0,100);

  // Net worth
  const prevNW = GS.nwHistory.length?GS.nwHistory[GS.nwHistory.length-1]:0;
  const nw=calcNetWorth(c,inv);
  GS.nwHistory.push(nw);

  // Log background events
  for(const e of ev) logEvent(e.text, e.type||'info');

  // Death check (monthly probability)
  if(tickDeath(c)){
    setTimeout(()=>showGameOver(),500);
    return;
  }

  // Build event queue: monthly expense first, then life event, then occasional tip
  GS.pendingEvents=[];
  const expEvent = generateMonthlyExpenseEvent(c);
  if(expEvent) GS.pendingEvents.push(expEvent);
  if(pct(0.30)){
    const events=selectEvents(c);
    if(events.length) GS.pendingEvents.push(events[0]);
  }
  // Financial tip: roughly every 4-5 months
  if(pct(0.22)) GS.pendingEvents.push(generateTipEvent());

  // Inbox: monthly news + bills
  generateInboxItems(c, inv);

  // Downside event: 3% monthly chance
  if(pct(0.03)) triggerDownside(c);

  // Bank update message: ~9% monthly chance (about 1/year per bank feature)
  maybeEmitBankUpdate(c);

  // Employee check-ins: monthly morale drift + inbox messages from staff
  tickEmployeeMessages(c, inv);

  updateUI(fin, prevNW, nw);
  saveGame();

  if(GS.pendingEvents.length>0) showNextEvent();
}

function resaleValue(item, c){
  const ageMonths = Math.max(0, (c.monthAge||0) - (item.purchasedAt||0));
  // First month: 70% resale; drop 3% per month; floor at 15% of cost
  const factor = Math.max(0.15, 0.70 - ageMonths*0.03);
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(item.cost * factor));
}

function renderBelongings(c){
  const el=$('belongings-list'); if(!el) return;
  const items=c.belongings||[];
  if(!items.length){
    el.innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px">Nothing to sell. Monthly expense items you buy will show up here.</p>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = items.map((b,i)=>{
    const resale = resaleValue(b, c);
    const ageM = Math.max(0, (c.monthAge||0) - (b.purchasedAt||0));
    return `<div class="info-row" style="align-items:center">

function sellBelonging(id){
  const c=GS.char; if(!c||!c.belongings) return;
  const idx=c.belongings.findIndex(b=>b.id===id); if(idx<0) return;
  const item=c.belongings[idx];
  const resale=resaleValue(item, c);
  c.checking += resale;
  c.belongings.splice(idx,1);
  logEvent(`Sold ${item.icon} ${item.name} for ${fmt$(resale)} (paid ${fmt$(item.cost)}).`, 'info');
  showToast(`Sold ${item.name} for ${fmt$(resale)}`);
  saveGame();

  setText('fi-check',fmt$(c.checking));
}

function renderStocksTable(inv){
  const held=Object.entries(inv.portfolio);
  if(!held.length){$('stocks-table-wrap').innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px">No stocks owned.</p>';return;}
  let h='<table class="stock-table"><thead><tr><th>Ticker</th><th>Shares</th><th>Price</th><th>Change</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(const[id,pos]of held){
    const s=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s)continue;
    const hist=s.history;const prev=hist.length>1?hist[hist.length-2]:s.price;
    const chg=((s.price-prev)/prev*100).toFixed(1);
    const val=s.price*pos.shares;
    const cls=parseFloat(chg)>=0?'chg-pos':'chg-neg';
    h+=`<tr><td>${id}</td><td>${pos.shares}</td><td>$${s.price.toFixed(2)}</td><td class="${cls}">${parseFloat(chg)>=0?'+':''}${chg}%</td><td>${fmt$(val)}</td></tr>`;
  }
  $('stocks-table-wrap').innerHTML=h+'</tbody></table>';
}

  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cx=W/2,cy=H-10,r=H-20;
  // Background arc
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,Math.PI,0);ctx.strokeStyle='#2e4a2e';ctx.lineWidth=12;ctx.stroke();
  // Score arc
  const pct=(score-300)/550;
  const col=score>=750?'#00c853':score>=670?'#ffd700':score>=580?'#ffa726':'#ff3d3d';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,Math.PI,Math.PI+(pct*Math.PI));ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=12;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
  // Score label
  const el=$('cs-score'); if(el){el.textContent=score;el.style.color=col;}
  const gradeEl=$('cs-grade'); if(gradeEl){
    gradeEl.textContent=score>=800?'Exceptional':score>=740?'Very Good':score>=670?'Good':score>=580?'Fair':'Poor';
  }
}

function drawNetWorthChart(){
  const canvas=$('nw-chart'); if(!canvas)return;
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const W=canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;const H=80;
  canvas.width=W*dpr;canvas.height=H*dpr;
  canvas.style.width=W+'px';canvas.style.height=H+'px';
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  const hist=GS.nwHistory;if(hist.length<2)return;
  const mn=Math.min(...hist),mx=Math.max(...hist);
  const range=mx-mn||1;
  const pts=hist.map((v,i)=>[i/(hist.length-1)*W,H-10-((v-mn)/range)*(H-20)]);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  const last=hist[hist.length-1];
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  const col=last>=0?'rgba(0,200,83,.3)':'rgba(255,61,61,.3)';
  grad.addColorStop(0,col);grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.lineTo(W,H);ctx.lineTo(0,H);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.strokeStyle=last>=0?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
  // Current dot
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pts[pts.length-1][0],pts[pts.length-1][1],4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=last>=0?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';ctx.fill();
}

// â”€â”€ Mini sparkline chart for asset cards â”€â”€
function drawMiniChart(canvas, history, up){
  if(!canvas) return;
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const W=canvas.clientWidth||220, H=50;
  canvas.width=W*dpr; canvas.height=H*dpr;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(!history||history.length<2){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#4a6a4a'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,H/2); ctx.lineTo(W,H/2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--muted');
    ctx.font='10px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('No history yet',W/2,H/2+14);
    return;
  }
  const mn=Math.min(...history), mx=Math.max(...history);
  const range=mx-mn||Math.abs(mn)*0.01||1;
  const pad=4;
  const pts=history.map((v,i)=>[i/(history.length-1)*W, H-pad-((v-mn)/range)*(H-pad*2)]);
  const col=up?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';
  // fill gradient
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, up?'rgba(0,200,83,.35)':'rgba(255,61,61,.35)');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle=grad; ctx.fill();
  // line
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke();
  // end dot
  const last=pts[pts.length-1];
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(last[0],last[1],2.5,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fill();
}

      <div class="ac-actions">

        <button class="ac-btn buy" ${canAfford?'':'disabled'} data-buy="${s.id}">Buy $</button>
        <button class="ac-btn sell" ${owned?'':'disabled'} data-sell="${s.id}">Sell All</button>
      </div>`;
    grid.appendChild(card); cards.push({canvas:'ch-stk-'+idx, history:h, up:chg>=0});
  });
  ch.appendChild(grid);
  const closeBtn=document.createElement('button'); closeBtn.className='choice-btn'; closeBtn.textContent='Close';
  closeBtn.onclick=()=>{$('modal-box').classList.remove('wide'); closeModal();};
  ch.appendChild(closeBtn);
  function refreshStockCard(id){
    const s=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!s) return;
    const card=grid.querySelector(`[data-stock-card="${id}"]`); if(!card) return;
    const pos=inv.portfolio[s.id]; const owned=pos?pos.shares:0;
    const meta=card.querySelector('.ac-meta');
    if(meta) meta.innerHTML=`<span>${owned?`Owned: ${owned} sh Â· ${fmt$(s.price*owned)}`:'Not held'}</span><span>1sh = $${s.price.toFixed(2)}</span>`;
    const sellBtn=card.querySelector('.ac-btn.sell'); if(sellBtn) sellBtn.disabled=!owned;
  }
  function refreshStockAffordability(){
    $('m-body').textContent=`Climate: ${inv.climate.toUpperCase()} Â· Cash: ${fmt$(c.checking)} Â· Prices update monthly.`;
    inv.stocks.forEach(stk=>{
      const b=grid.querySelector(`[data-buy="${stk.id}"]`);
      if(b) b.disabled=c.checking<stk.price;
    });
  }
  grid.onclick=(e)=>{
    const buyId=e.target.getAttribute('data-buy');
    const sellId=e.target.getAttribute('data-sell');
    if(buyId){
      const s=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===buyId);
      const input=grid.querySelector(`[data-buy-input="${buyId}"]`);
      const wanted=Math.max(0, Math.floor(parseFloat(input?.value)||0));
      if(wanted<s.price){ showToast(`Need at least $${s.price.toFixed(2)} for 1 share.`); return; }
      if(c.checking<wanted){ showToast('Not enough cash.'); return; }
      const shares=Math.floor(wanted / s.price);
      const cost=Math.round(shares * s.price);
      if(shares<1){ showToast('Amount buys 0 shares.'); return; }
      c.checking-=cost;
      if(!inv.portfolio[s.id]) inv.portfolio[s.id]={shares:0,avgCost:0};
      const p=inv.portfolio[s.id]; p.avgCost=(p.avgCost*p.shares+cost)/(p.shares+shares); p.shares+=shares;
      showToast(`Bought ${shares} ${s.id} for ${fmt$(cost)}`);
      refreshStockCard(buyId); refreshStockAffordability();
    }else if(sellId){
      const s=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===sellId); const p=inv.portfolio[sellId]; if(!p) return;
      const proceeds=Math.round(s.price*p.shares);
      const cg=Math.round((s.price-p.avgCost)*p.shares);
      const tax=cg>0?Math.round(cg*0.15):0;
      c.checking+=proceeds-tax;
      delete inv.portfolio[sellId];
      showToast(`Sold ${sellId} for ${fmt$(proceeds-tax)}`);
      refreshStockCard(sellId); refreshStockAffordability();
    }
  };
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>cards.forEach(cd=>drawMiniChart($(cd.canvas), cd.history, cd.up)));
}

function genCoworkers(c){

  c._coworkers = list;

  return list;

// Build a synthetic vertical league table for the player's team's league
function buildSoccerStandings(c){
  const league = soccerPlayerTeamLeague(c);
  if(!league || !SOCCER_LEAGUE_TEAMS[league]) return null;
  const teams = SOCCER_LEAGUE_TEAMS[league].slice();
  if(!teams.includes(c.sportsTeam)) teams.unshift(c.sportsTeam);
  // Use cached standings per league/team if present
  const key = league+'|'+c.sportsTeam;
  if(c._lgStandingsKey === key && Array.isArray(c._lgStandings)) return { league, rows: c._lgStandings };
  const rows = teams.map(t => {
    const played = ri(20, 28);
    const w = ri(4, played-3);
    const d = ri(1, Math.max(2, played-w-1));
    const l = Math.max(0, played - w - d);
    const gf = w*2 + d + ri(0, 12);
    const ga = l*2 + ri(0, 14);
    return { team: t, p: played, w, d, l, gf, ga, gd: gf-ga, pts: w*3+d };
  });
  rows.sort((a,b) => b.pts - a.pts || b.gd - a.gd || b.gf - a.gf);
  c._lgStandings = rows;
  c._lgStandingsKey = key;
  return { league, rows };
}
function buildEuroCompStandings(c){
  if(!c._euroComp || !EURO_COMP_POOLS[c._euroComp]) return null;
  const meta = EURO_COMP_META[c._euroComp];
  const pool = [c.sportsTeam, ...EURO_COMP_POOLS[c._euroComp].filter(t => t !== c.sportsTeam)].slice(0, 36);
  const key = c._euroComp+'|'+c.sportsTeam;
  if(c._euroStandingsKey === key && Array.isArray(c._euroStandings)) return { meta, rows: c._euroStandings };
  const rows = pool.map(t => {
    const p = ri(2, 8);
    const w = ri(0, p);
    const d = ri(0, Math.max(0, p-w));
    const l = Math.max(0, p-w-d);
    return { team: t, p, w, d, l, gf: w*2+d+ri(0,4), ga: l*2+ri(0,5), gd: 0, pts: w*3+d };
  });
  rows.forEach(r => r.gd = r.gf - r.ga);
  rows.sort((a,b) => b.pts - a.pts || b.gd - a.gd || b.gf - a.gf);
  c._euroStandings = rows;
  c._euroStandingsKey = key;
  return { meta, rows };
}

      const isFirst = !inv.properties.some(p=>p.livedIn);
      inv.properties.push({name:t.name,value:t.price,debt,monthlyPayment:mp,rented:false,rent:Math.round(t.price*0.006),age:0,livedIn:isFirst});
      c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(p=>p.livedIn);
      return`Bought ${t.name}! Equity: ${fmt$(down)}${isFirst?' Â· Moved in.':''}`;
    }};
  });
  // Per-property options: move in/out, rent toggle, sell
  for(let i=0;i<inv.properties.length;i++){
    const p=inv.properties[i];
    const tag=p.livedIn?' ðŸ�¡ (living here)':p.rented?' ðŸ’° (renting out)':' (vacant)';
    if(!p.livedIn){
      choices.push({text:`Move into ${p.name}${tag}`,fn(){
        inv.properties.forEach(x=>x.livedIn=false);
        p.livedIn=true; p.rented=false;
        c.hasHouse=true;
        return`Moved into ${p.name}. Your new home!`;
      }});
    } else {
      choices.push({text:`Move out of ${p.name}${tag}`,fn(){
        p.livedIn=false;
        c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(x=>x.livedIn);
        return`Moved out of ${p.name}. Now paying rent elsewhere.`;
      }});
    }
    if(!p.livedIn){
      if(!p.rented) choices.push({text:`Rent out ${p.name} (~${fmt$(p.rent)}/mo)`,fn(){p.rented=true;return`Now renting for ${fmt$(p.rent)}/mo!`}});
      else choices.push({text:`Stop renting ${p.name}`,fn(){p.rented=false;return'Stopped renting.'}});
    }
    choices.push({text:`Sell ${p.name} (equity: ${fmt$(p.value-p.debt)})${tag}`,fn(){
      const eq=p.value-p.debt; c.checking+=eq;
      inv.properties.splice(i,1);
      c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(x=>x.livedIn);
      return`Sold for ${fmt$(eq)} net equity.${!c.hasHouse?' Back to renting.':''}`;
    }});
  }
  choices.unshift({text:'ðŸš— Browse Vehicles (cars, bikes, boats, planes)',fn(){setTimeout(()=>showVehiclesModal(),50);return'Opening vehicles...';}});

};

function runSideHustle(h){
  const c=GS.char;
  if(c.checking<h.cost) return `Need ${fmt$(h.cost)} startup capital.`;
  c.checking-=h.cost;
  let successRate=h.success;
  if(h.stat==='smarts') successRate=clamp(successRate*(0.5+c.smarts/100),0,0.95);
  else if(h.stat==='looks') successRate=clamp(successRate*(0.5+c.looks/100),0,0.95);
  if(pct(successRate)){
    const statMult = h.stat==='smarts'?(0.6+c.smarts/120):h.stat==='looks'?(0.6+c.looks/120):1.0;
    const inc = Math.round((h.incMin + Math.random()*(h.incMax-h.incMin)) * statMult);
    if(inc<=0){
      const loss=Math.abs(inc);
      return `${h.name} lost money. Down ${fmt$(loss+h.cost)} total.`;
    }
    c.sideHustleIncome=(c.sideHustleIncome||0)+inc;
    return `ðŸŽ‰ ${h.name} paying off! +${fmt$(inc)}/yr side-hustle income (tracked separately from job salary).`;
  }
  const loss = h.incMin<0 ? Math.round(Math.abs(h.incMin)*Math.random()) : 0;
  if(loss>0){ c.checking-=loss; return `â�Œ ${h.name} flopped. Lost ${fmt$(h.cost+loss)} total.`; }
  return `â�Œ ${h.name} didn't gain traction. Lost ${fmt$(h.cost)} startup.`;
}

  function takeLoan(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    const cs = c.creditScore || 580;
    const rate = cs>=750?0.06 : cs>=680?0.09 : cs>=620?0.13 : 0.20;
    const max = Math.round(((c.salary||30000) + 0.1*(c.savings||0)) * (cs>=720?2:1));
    if(amount > max) return `Max ${fmt$(max)} at credit ${cs}.`;
    c.checking += amount;
    c.personalLoan = (c.personalLoan||0) + amount;
    c.personalLoanRate = rate;
    return `Borrowed ${fmt$(amount)} at ${(rate*100).toFixed(1)}% APR.`;
  }
  function payLoan(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    if((c.personalLoan||0) <= 0) return 'No active loans.';
    if(c.checking < amount) return `Need ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
    const pay = Math.min(amount, c.personalLoan);
    c.checking -= pay;
    c.personalLoan -= pay;
    if(c.personalLoan <= 0){
      c.creditScore = clamp((c.creditScore||580) + 12, 300, 850);
      return `Loan paid off! +12 credit.`;
    }
    return `Paid ${fmt$(pay)}. Balance: ${fmt$(c.personalLoan)}.`;
  }
  function tickLoan(c){
    if((c.personalLoan||0) <= 0) return;
    const interest = Math.round(c.personalLoan * (c.personalLoanRate||0.10) / 12);
    const minPay = Math.max(50, Math.round(c.personalLoan * 0.02));
    if(c.checking >= minPay){
      c.checking -= minPay;
      c.personalLoan = Math.max(0, c.personalLoan + interest - minPay);

  }

  function ipoBusiness(idx){
    const inv=GS.inv, c=GS.char;
    const b = (inv.businesses||[])[idx];
    if(!b) return 'No business.';
    if(b.ipo) return 'Already public.';
    if(b.value < 5000000) return 'Need $5M+ valuation to IPO.';
    const proceeds = Math.round(b.value * 0.4);
    c.checking += proceeds;
    b.ipo = true;
    b.value = Math.round(b.value * 0.7);
    logScrap(c, `IPO'd ${b.name} (${fmt$(proceeds)})`, 'gold');
    return `IPO! Raised ${fmt$(proceeds)}, retained controlling stake.`;
  }
  function acquireCompetitor(idx){
    const inv=GS.inv, c=GS.char;
    const b = (inv.businesses||[])[idx];
    if(!b) return 'No business.';
    const cost = Math.round(b.value * 0.6);
    if(c.checking < cost) return `Need ${fmt$(cost)} for acquisition.`;
    c.checking -= cost;
    b.value = Math.round(b.value * 1.5);
    if(b.profit) b.profit = Math.round(b.profit * 1.4);
    return `Acquired competitor for ${fmt$(cost)}. Value +50%, profit +40%.`;
  }
  function franchiseBusiness(idx){
    const inv=GS.inv, c=GS.char;
    const b = (inv.businesses||[])[idx];
    if(!b) return 'No business.';
    if(b.value < 1000000) return 'Need $1M+ business to franchise.';
    const setupCost = 100000;
    if(c.checking < setupCost) return `Need ${fmt$(setupCost)} setup cost.`;
    c.checking -= setupCost;
    b.franchiseCount = (b.franchiseCount||0) + 1;
    return `Opened franchise location #${b.franchiseCount}. Royalty stream begins.`;
  }
  function pivotBusiness(idx){
    const inv=GS.inv;
    const b = (inv.businesses||[])[idx];

    const h = HOBBY_CATALOG[idx]; if(!h) return 'Pick a hobby.';

    for(const h of (inv.hobbies||[])){

  function casinoPlay(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    if(c.checking < amount) return `Need ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
    c.checking -= amount;
    const r = Math.random();
    if(r < 0.005){ const win = amount * 100; c.checking += win; logScrap(c, `Casino jackpot ${fmt$(win)}`, 'gold'); return `ðŸŽ° JACKPOT! Won ${fmt$(win)}.`; }
    if(r < 0.10){ const win = amount * 5; c.checking += win; return `Big win! +${fmt$(win)}.`; }

    return `Lost ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
  }

(function(){

    buildCarriedPhone();

    // A few trees on the very edge for park feel
    for (let i=0; i<24; i++){
      const r = 113 + Math.random()*4;
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI*2;
      const x = Math.cos(a)*r, z = Math.sin(a)*r;
      buildTree(x, z);
    }

    bindInput();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if (!isTouch) $$('hud-pointerlock').classList.add('show');
  }

  // Sign canvas: front-of-building shop sign with icon + label
  function makeSignTexture(cfg){
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 384; c.height = 96;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 384, 96);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a1a'; ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(3, 3, 378, 90);
    // icon
    ctx.font = '64px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillText(cfg.icon, 56, 50);
    // label
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillText(cfg.label.toUpperCase(), 110, 52);
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    tex.anisotropy = 4;
    return tex;
  }

  function buildBuilding(cfg){
    if (cfg.id === 'table'){ buildStadium(cfg); return; }
    const W = 5, H = 3.5, D = 5;
    const group = new THREE.Group();

    // Variant per cfg.id â€” different silhouettes so each feels distinct
    const variant = cfg.id;
    const isSkyscraper = (variant === 'bank' || variant === 'stocks' || variant === 'crypto');
    const isCozy = (variant === 'home' || variant === 'realty');
    const isStadium = (variant === 'table');
    const isTall = (variant === 'edu');

    // â”€â”€ Walls â”€â”€
    const wallMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xf4e8d0 });
    const tier1H = isSkyscraper ? 5.5 : (isTall ? 4.5 : (isCozy ? 3.0 : H));
    const tier1W = isStadium ? 7 : W;
    const tier1D = isStadium ? 7 : D;
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W, tier1H, tier1D), wallMat);
    body.position.y = tier1H / 2;
    group.add(body);

    // Skyscraper: add a slimmer second tier
    let topY = tier1H;
    if (isSkyscraper){
      const tier2 = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W*0.7, 3.2, tier1D*0.7),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xe8dcc0 })
      );
      tier2.position.y = tier1H + 1.6;
      group.add(tier2);
      topY = tier1H + 3.2;
    }

    // â”€â”€ Roof â”€â”€
    const roofMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: cfg.color });
    if (isSkyscraper){
      // Flat parapet roof + antenna
      const parapet = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W*0.72, 0.35, tier1D*0.72),
        roofMat
      );
      parapet.position.y = topY + 0.18;
      group.add(parapet);
      const antenna = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.06, 1.6, 6),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8a8a8a })
      );
      antenna.position.y = topY + 1.2;
      group.add(antenna);
    } else if (isStadium){
      // Open stadium: rim only, with bowl interior
      const rim = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W*1.05, 0.3, tier1D*1.05),
        roofMat
      );
      rim.position.y = topY + 0.15;
      group.add(rim);
      // green pitch on top
      const pitch = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W*0.85, 0.05, tier1D*0.85),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x5cb85c })
      );
      pitch.position.y = topY + 0.32;
      group.add(pitch);
    } else {
      // Pyramid roof (4-sided cone, rotated 45Â°)
      const r = Math.max(tier1W, tier1D) * 0.78;
      const roof = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, 1.7, 4), roofMat);
      roof.position.y = topY + 0.85;
      roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
      group.add(roof);
      // Trim band at top of walls
      const trim = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W + 0.15, 0.25, tier1D + 0.15),
        roofMat
      );
      trim.position.y = topY - 0.13;
      group.add(trim);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Door (front face = +Z in local space) â”€â”€
    const door = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.95, 1.7, 0.1),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x5d4037 })
    );
    door.position.set(0, 0.87, tier1D/2 + 0.06);
    group.add(door);
    const knob = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 8, 6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffd700 })
    );
    knob.position.set(0.32, 0.95, tier1D/2 + 0.13);
    group.add(knob);
    // Doorstep
    const step = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4, 0.12, 0.6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x9e9e9e })
    );
    step.position.set(0, 0.06, tier1D/2 + 0.32);
    group.add(step);

    // â”€â”€ Windows â”€â”€
    const winMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
      color: 0x9fdcff,
      emissive: 0x4fc3f7,
      emissiveIntensity: 0.15,
    });
    const frameMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x222222 });
    function addWindow(x, y, z, rotY, ww=0.95, wh=0.95){
      const fr = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ww+0.12, wh+0.12, 0.06), frameMat);
      const w  = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ww, wh, 0.04), winMat);
      fr.position.set(x, y, z); fr.rotation.y = rotY;
      w.position.set(x, y, z);  w.rotation.y = rotY;
      const out = 0.05;
      if (rotY === 0)             { fr.position.z += 0.01; w.position.z += out; }
      else if (rotY === Math.PI)  { fr.position.z -= 0.01; w.position.z -= out; }
      else if (rotY ===  Math.PI/2){fr.position.x += 0.01; w.position.x += out; }
      else if (rotY === -Math.PI/2){fr.position.x -= 0.01; w.position.x -= out; }
      group.add(fr); group.add(w);
    }
    if (!isStadium){
      // Front (each side of door)
      addWindow(-1.55, 1.7, tier1D/2, 0);
      addWindow( 1.55, 1.7, tier1D/2, 0);
      // Sides
      addWindow( tier1W/2,  1.7,  1.4, Math.PI/2);
      addWindow( tier1W/2,  1.7, -1.4, Math.PI/2);
      addWindow(-tier1W/2,  1.7,  1.4,-Math.PI/2);
      addWindow(-tier1W/2,  1.7, -1.4,-Math.PI/2);
      // Back
      addWindow(-1.55, 1.7, -tier1D/2, Math.PI);
      addWindow( 1.55, 1.7, -tier1D/2, Math.PI);
      // Skyscraper: row of windows on tier 2
      if (isSkyscraper){
        for (const xz of [[-1.0, tier1D*0.35], [1.0, tier1D*0.35]]){
          addWindow(xz[0], tier1H + 1.6, xz[1] + 0.02, 0, 0.8, 0.9);
        }
        addWindow( tier1W*0.36, tier1H + 1.6, 0,  Math.PI/2, 0.8, 0.9);
        addWindow(-tier1W*0.36, tier1H + 1.6, 0, -Math.PI/2, 0.8, 0.9);
      }
    } else {
      // Stadium: vertical slits all around
      for (let i=0; i<6; i++){
        const f = (i+0.5)/6 - 0.5;
        addWindow(f*tier1W, 1.6, tier1D/2, 0, 0.4, 1.6);
        addWindow(f*tier1W, 1.6,-tier1D/2, Math.PI, 0.4, 1.6);
        addWindow( tier1W/2, 1.6, f*tier1D,  Math.PI/2, 0.4, 1.6);
        addWindow(-tier1W/2, 1.6, f*tier1D, -Math.PI/2, 0.4, 1.6);
      }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Storefront sign above the door â”€â”€
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(tier1W * 0.85, 0.95),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeSignTexture(cfg) })
    );
    sign.position.set(0, tier1H - 0.55, tier1D/2 + 0.08);
    group.add(sign);

    // Position + face-toward-island-center rotation
    group.position.set(cfg.pos[0], 0, cfg.pos[1]);
    // Building's local +Z is the front. Aim that vector at the origin.
    const yaw = Math.atan2(-cfg.pos[0], -cfg.pos[1]);
    group.rotation.y = yaw;
    scene.add(group);

    // Floating label well above the roof, visible from anywhere on the island
    const lc = document.createElement('canvas');
    lc.width = 256; lc.height = 64;
    const lctx = lc.getContext('2d');
    lctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.78)';
    lctx.fillRect(0, 14, 256, 40);
    lctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    lctx.textAlign = 'center';
    lctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    lctx.fillText(cfg.label, 128, 42);
    const ltex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(lc);
    const lsprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: ltex, transparent: true, depthTest: false }));
    lsprite.renderOrder = 999;
    lsprite.scale.set(4.2, 1.05, 1);
    const labelY = topY + (isSkyscraper ? 2.5 : (isStadium ? 1.6 : 2.6));
    lsprite.position.set(cfg.pos[0], labelY, cfg.pos[1]);
    scene.add(lsprite);

    buildings3d.push({
      group, label: lsprite, cfg,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(cfg.pos[0], 0, cfg.pos[1]),
      collideR: Math.max(tier1W, tier1D) * 0.5 + 0.4,
    });
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� REAL STADIUM â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  // Bowl-shaped arena: outer steel/glass shell, ribs, 3 tiered seating rings,
  // vivid green field with painted lines + goals, roof trusses, 4 floodlight
  // towers, hanging scoreboards, LED ribbon, VIP boxes, crowd, entry tunnels.
  function buildStadium(cfg){
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const RAD = 14;          // outer radius
    const HEIGHT = 12;       // shell height
    const TEAM = cfg.color;  // primary team color (from BUILDINGS cfg)
    const AWAY = '#ff7700';  // away accent

    // â”€â”€ Outer concrete/steel shell â”€â”€
    const shell = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(RAD, RAD, HEIGHT, 32, 1, true),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x9ca3af, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    shell.position.y = HEIGHT/2;
    group.add(shell);

    // Glass band (upper part of shell, slightly larger ring)
    const glass = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(RAD + 0.25, RAD + 0.25, 4, 32, 1, true),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4a90d9, transparent: true, opacity: 0.45, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    glass.position.y = HEIGHT - 2;
    group.add(glass);

    // Vertical concrete ribs around the shell (every 15Â°)
    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++){
      const a = (i / 24) * Math.PI * 2;
      const rib = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, HEIGHT, 0.4),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x6b7280 })
      );
      rib.position.set(Math.cos(a) * (RAD + 0.05), HEIGHT/2, Math.sin(a) * (RAD + 0.05));
      group.add(rib);
    }

    // Entry tunnels (4 dark openings cut into the shell)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++){
      const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI/4;
      const tunnel = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.4, 3.0, 0.6),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x1a1a1a })
      );
      tunnel.position.set(Math.cos(a) * RAD, 1.5, Math.sin(a) * RAD);
      tunnel.lookAt(0, 1.5, 0);
      group.add(tunnel);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Tiered seating bowl (3 concentric rings, stepped down toward field) â”€â”€
    const TIERS = [
      { r1: 13.0, r2: 11.5, h: 4.0, y: 3.5, color: TEAM },
      { r1: 11.0, r2:  9.5, h: 2.5, y: 1.0, color: 0x1f4e79 },
      { r1:  9.0, r2:  8.0, h: 1.0, y: 0.0, color: 0x0066cc },
    ];
    for (const t of TIERS){
      const tier = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(t.r1, t.r2, t.h, 32, 1, true),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: t.color, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
      );
      tier.position.y = t.y + t.h/2;
      group.add(tier);
    }

    // Concrete walkway ring around the field
    const walkway = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(7.5, 8.0, 32),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x6b7280, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    walkway.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
    walkway.position.y = 0.04;
    group.add(walkway);

    // â”€â”€ Field â”€â”€
    const FIELD_W = 14, FIELD_D = 9;
    const fc = document.createElement('canvas');
    fc.width = 512; fc.height = 320;
    const fctx = fc.getContext('2d');
    // Striped grass
    for (let y = 0; y < 320; y += 32){
      fctx.fillStyle = ((y/32) % 2 === 0) ? '#3da043' : '#4caf50';
      fctx.fillRect(0, y, 512, 32);
    }
    // Painted lines (soccer pitch)
    fctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; fctx.lineWidth = 4;
    fctx.strokeRect(8, 8, 496, 304);
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.moveTo(256, 8); fctx.lineTo(256, 312); fctx.stroke();
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.arc(256, 160, 50, 0, Math.PI*2); fctx.stroke();
    fctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.arc(256, 160, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); fctx.fill();
    fctx.strokeRect(8, 60, 100, 200);     // left penalty box
    fctx.strokeRect(404, 60, 100, 200);   // right penalty box
    fctx.strokeRect(8, 100, 50, 120);     // left goal area
    fctx.strokeRect(454, 100, 50, 120);   // right goal area
    // Penalty spots
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.arc(80, 160, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); fctx.fill();
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.arc(432, 160, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); fctx.fill();
    const fieldTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(fc);
    fieldTex.anisotropy = 4;
    const field = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(FIELD_W, FIELD_D),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: fieldTex })
    );
    field.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
    field.position.y = 0.06;
    group.add(field);

    // Goals at each end
    for (const side of [-1, 1]){
      const goal = new THREE.Group();
      const post1 = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 1.6, 8),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff })
      );
      post1.position.set(0, 0.8, -1.5); goal.add(post1);
      const post2 = post1.clone(); post2.position.set(0, 0.8, 1.5); goal.add(post2);
      const bar = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 3, 8),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff })
      );
      bar.rotation.x = Math.PI/2;
      bar.position.set(0, 1.6, 0);
      goal.add(bar);
      // Net (translucent)
      const net = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 1.6, 3),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.25 })
      );
      net.position.set(side * 0.5, 0.8, 0);
      goal.add(net);
      goal.position.set(side * (FIELD_W/2 - 0.4), 0, 0);
      group.add(goal);
    }

    // Center ball
    const ball = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 8, 6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff })
    );
    ball.position.set(0, 0.18, 0);
    group.add(ball);

    // Technical area benches at sidelines
    for (const side of [-1, 1]){
      const bench = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 0.4, 0.6),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2a2a2a })
      );
      bench.position.set(0, 0.2, side * (FIELD_D/2 + 0.45));
      group.add(bench);
      const roof = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.1, 0.05, 0.7),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: TEAM })
      );
      roof.position.set(0, 1.4, side * (FIELD_D/2 + 0.45));
      group.add(roof);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Roof: torus rim + radial steel trusses â”€â”€
    const roofRim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(RAD - 0.5, 0.4, 8, 32),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4a4a4a })
    );
    roofRim.rotation.x = Math.PI/2;
    roofRim.position.y = HEIGHT + 0.3;
    group.add(roofRim);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++){
      const a = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
      const truss = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(RAD - 1, 0.18, 0.12),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x5a5a5a })

      truss.position.set(Math.cos(a) * (RAD/2 - 0.5), HEIGHT + 0.25, Math.sin(a) * (RAD/2 - 0.5));

      group.add(truss);
    }
    // Inner roof panel ring (partial cover)
    const roofPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(7.5, RAD - 0.5, 32),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x6a6a6a, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55 })
    );
    roofPanel.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
    roofPanel.position.y = HEIGHT + 0.1;

    // â”€â”€ 4 Floodlight towers at compass corners â”€â”€
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++){

      // Floodlight head pointing at field center
      const head = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.0, 0.9, 0.5),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2c2c2c })
      );
      head.position.set(x, HEIGHT + 4.4, z);
      head.lookAt(0, 5, 0);
      group.add(head);
      // Glowing lamp face

      glow.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

    // â”€â”€ Hanging scoreboards at field ends â”€â”€
    for (const side of [-1, 1]){

      sctx.font = 'bold 56px Arial Black, sans-serif';
      sctx.textAlign = 'center'; sctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      sctx.fillText('HOME 2 - 1 AWAY', 256, 70);
      sctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
      sctx.font = 'bold 96px Arial Black, sans-serif';
      sctx.fillText('45:23', 256, 160);
      sctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      sctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
      sctx.fillText('â—� LIVE', 60, 30);

      const score = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6, 3),

      score.position.set(side * (FIELD_W/2 + 1.2), 7, 0);
      score.rotation.y = side > 0 ? -Math.PI/2 : Math.PI/2;

      const win = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.2, 0.75),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x9fdcff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 })
      );
      const inward = 0.36;
      win.position.set(Math.cos(a) * (r - inward), HEIGHT - 2, Math.sin(a) * (r - inward));
      win.lookAt(0, HEIGHT - 2, 0);
      group.add(win);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Crowd dots: ~280 little colored cylinders in the seats â”€â”€
    for (let i = 0; i < 280; i++){
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      // Pick a tier
      const tIdx = Math.random() < 0.45 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2);
      const t = TIERS[tIdx];
      const r = t.r2 + 0.3 + Math.random() * (t.r1 - t.r2 - 0.6);
      const y = t.y + 0.4 + Math.random() * (t.h - 0.5);
      const homeFan = Math.random() < 0.7;
      const col = homeFan ? TEAM : AWAY;
      const person = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.13, 0.13, 0.45, 6),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: col })
      );
      person.position.set(Math.cos(a) * r, y, Math.sin(a) * r);
      group.add(person);
      // Head
      const head = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.09, 6, 4),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xf2c98a })
      );
      head.position.set(Math.cos(a) * r, y + 0.3, Math.sin(a) * r);
      group.add(head);
    }

    // â”€â”€ Plaza paving around the stadium â”€â”€
    const plaza = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(RAD + 0.5, RAD + 4.5, 48),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xb8b0a0, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
    );
    plaza.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
    plaza.position.y = 0.02;
    group.add(plaza);

    // â”€â”€ Team banner at the top of the shell facing the road â”€â”€
    const bc = document.createElement('canvas');
    bc.width = 1024; bc.height = 256;
    const bctx = bc.getContext('2d');
    bctx.fillStyle = TEAM; bctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 256);
    bctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    bctx.fillRect(0, 8, 1024, 6); bctx.fillRect(0, 242, 1024, 6);
    bctx.font = 'bold 130px Arial Black, sans-serif';
    bctx.textAlign = 'center'; bctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    bctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    bctx.fillText('STADIUM', 512, 128);
    const bannerTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bc);
    const banner = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 2.5),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: bannerTex })
    );
    banner.position.set(0, HEIGHT - 1.5, RAD + 0.05);
    group.add(banner);
    const bannerBack = banner.clone();
    bannerBack.position.set(0, HEIGHT - 1.5, -(RAD + 0.05));
    bannerBack.rotation.y = Math.PI;
    group.add(bannerBack);

    // â”€â”€ Floating Stadium label above â”€â”€
    const lc = document.createElement('canvas');
    lc.width = 256; lc.height = 64;
    const lctx = lc.getContext('2d');
    lctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.78)';
    lctx.fillRect(0, 14, 256, 40);
    lctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    lctx.textAlign = 'center';
    lctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    lctx.fillText(cfg.label, 128, 42);
    const ltex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(lc);
    const lsprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: ltex, transparent: true, depthTest: false }));
    lsprite.renderOrder = 999;
    lsprite.scale.set(4.2, 1.05, 1);
    lsprite.position.set(cfg.pos[0], HEIGHT + 6, cfg.pos[1]);
    scene.add(lsprite);

    // Position whole stadium and register for collision
    group.position.set(cfg.pos[0], 0, cfg.pos[1]);
    scene.add(group);
    buildings3d.push({
      group, label: lsprite, cfg,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(cfg.pos[0], 0, cfg.pos[1]),
      collideR: RAD + 0.5,
    });
  }

  function buildTree(x, z){
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const trunkH = 1.4 + Math.random() * 0.6;
    const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.26, trunkH, 6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x6d4c2a })
    );
    trunk.position.y = trunkH / 2;
    group.add(trunk);
    const foliageH = 2.0 + Math.random() * 0.8;
    const foliage = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.95 + Math.random()*0.25, foliageH, 7),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2e7d32 })
    );
    foliage.position.y = trunkH + foliageH/2 - 0.2;
    group.add(foliage);

    const foliage2 = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.7, 1.4, 7),

    );

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� CITY: roads, sidewalks, lane stripes, crosswalks â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function buildCity(){
    const roadMat     = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2a2a2a });
    const sidewalkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xb0b0b0 });
    const stripeMat   = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe066 });
    const zebraMat    = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf6f3ee });
    const ROAD_LEN = 220;

    function plane(geom, mat, x, y, z){
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
      m.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
      m.position.set(x, y, z);
      scene.add(m);
      return m;
    }

    // Avenues (run along Z)
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(AVE_W, ROAD_LEN), roadMat, ax, 0.02, 0);
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(SIDEWALK_W, ROAD_LEN), sidewalkMat, ax - (AVE_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W/2), 0.05, 0);
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(SIDEWALK_W, ROAD_LEN), sidewalkMat, ax + (AVE_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W/2), 0.05, 0);
      // dashed yellow center
      for (let z = -ROAD_LEN/2 + 2; z < ROAD_LEN/2; z += 6){
        plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.25, 3), stripeMat, ax, 0.027, z);
      }
    }
    // Streets (run along X)
    for (const sz of STREETS){
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(ROAD_LEN, ST_W), roadMat, 0, 0.022, sz);
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(ROAD_LEN, SIDEWALK_W), sidewalkMat, 0, 0.052, sz - (ST_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W/2));
      plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(ROAD_LEN, SIDEWALK_W), sidewalkMat, 0, 0.052, sz + (ST_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W/2));
      for (let x = -ROAD_LEN/2 + 2; x < ROAD_LEN/2; x += 6){
        plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3, 0.25), stripeMat, x, 0.028, sz);
      }
    }
    // Crosswalks at every avenueÃ—street intersection (4 crossings each)
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      for (const sz of STREETS){
        for (const side of [-1, 1]){
          // crossings on north/south sides of intersection (parallel to street)
          const z = sz + side * (ST_W/2 + 0.9);
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++){
            const cw = AVE_W * 0.85;
            const sx = ax - cw/2 + i*cw/5 + cw/10;
            plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(cw/5*0.65, 0.6), zebraMat, sx, 0.029, z);
          }
          // crossings on east/west sides
          const x = ax + side * (AVE_W/2 + 0.9);
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++){
            const cd = ST_W * 0.85;
            const sz2 = sz - cd/2 + i*cd/5 + cd/10;
            plane(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.6, cd/5*0.65), zebraMat, x, 0.029, sz2);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� FILLER buildings + corner stores on every lot â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function isActionLot(cx, cz){
    for (const b of BUILDINGS){
      if (Math.abs(b.pos[0] - cx) < 18 && Math.abs(b.pos[1] - cz) < 18) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  const FILLER_PALETTE = [0xb98a6e, 0x8a8a8a, 0xa67c5d, 0xc7b299, 0x9a8a7a, 0x7a6f6a, 0xb6a08a, 0x807168, 0x5a4f48, 0xa6603d];

  function fillCity(){
    for (let i = 0; i < AVENUES.length-1; i++){
      for (let j = 0; j < STREETS.length-1; j++){
        const x0 = AVENUES[i] + AVE_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W;
        const x1 = AVENUES[i+1] - AVE_W/2 - SIDEWALK_W;
        const z0 = STREETS[j] + ST_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W;
        const z1 = STREETS[j+1] - ST_W/2 - SIDEWALK_W;
        const cx = (x0+x1)/2, cz = (z0+z1)/2;

        // Corner store at the SW corner of every lot â€” covers all corners across the grid
        buildCornerStore(x0 + 3, z0 + 3, FILLER_PALETTE[(i+j) % FILLER_PALETTE.length]);

        // Skip filler if this lot hosts an action building
        if (isActionLot(cx, cz)) continue;

        // Pack 6 filler towers per non-action lot â€” N/S/E/W edges + 2 interior
        const slots = [
          [x0 + 6, z0 + 9],         // SW
          [x1 - 6, z0 + 9],         // SE
          [x0 + 6, z1 - 9],         // NW
          [x1 - 6, z1 - 9],         // NE
          [cx, z0 + 6],             // S center
          [cx, z1 - 6],             // N center
        ];
        for (const [fx, fz] of slots){
          const jitter = () => (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6;
          const w = 5 + Math.random()*4;
          const d = 5 + Math.random()*4;
          const h = 7 + Math.random()*22;
          buildFiller(fx + jitter(), fz + jitter(), w, d, h, FILLER_PALETTE[Math.floor(Math.random()*FILLER_PALETTE.length)]);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� SUBURBS â€” fill the green ring outside the city grid â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function fillSuburbs(){
    const innerR = 95;            // start just outside the 90-line grid
    const outerR = ISLAND_R - 6;  // leave a thin park strip at the water
    const minSpacing = 7.0;
    const placed = []; // local list for spacing checks

    function tooClose(x, z){
      // existing buildings (action + grid fillers + corner stores)
      for (const b of buildings3d){
        if (Math.hypot(x - b.pos.x, z - b.pos.z) < (b.collideR || 3) + 4) return true;
      }
      // other suburbs we just placed
      for (const p of placed){
        if (Math.hypot(x - p[0], z - p[1]) < minSpacing) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    // A few curved access roads connecting the grid to the suburbs
    const accessRoadMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2e2e2e });
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++){
      const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI/16;
      const r0 = 92, r1 = ISLAND_R - 4;
      const segments = 8;
      for (let s = 0; s < segments; s++){
        const t  = s / segments;
        const t1 = (s+1) / segments;
        const r  = r0 + (r1 - r0) * t;
        const r2 = r0 + (r1 - r0) * t1;
        const x1s = Math.cos(a)*r, z1s = Math.sin(a)*r;
        const x2s = Math.cos(a)*r2, z2s = Math.sin(a)*r2;
        const cx = (x1s+x2s)/2, cz = (z1s+z2s)/2;
        const len = Math.hypot(x2s-x1s, z2s-z1s);
        const ang = Math.atan2(z2s-z1s, x2s-x1s);
        const seg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(len + 0.2, 4), accessRoadMat);
        seg.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
        seg.rotation.z = -ang;
        seg.position.set(cx, 0.018, cz);
        scene.add(seg);
      }
    }

    // Pack random small buildings in the ring
    let attempts = 0, total = 0, max = 220;
    while (total < max && attempts < max * 6){
      attempts++;
      const r = innerR + Math.random() * (outerR - innerR);
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const x = Math.cos(a) * r;
      const z = Math.sin(a) * r;
      if (tooClose(x, z)) continue;
      // Mostly small brownstones, a few mid-rises
      const isMid = Math.random() < 0.18;
      const w = isMid ? (5 + Math.random()*3)  : (3.4 + Math.random()*2);
      const d = isMid ? (5 + Math.random()*3)  : (3.4 + Math.random()*2);
      const h = isMid ? (12 + Math.random()*16) : (4 + Math.random()*6);
      buildFiller(x, z, w, d, h, FILLER_PALETTE[Math.floor(Math.random()*FILLER_PALETTE.length)]);
      placed.push([x, z]);
      total++;
    }
  }

  // Pick a city-center filler that will represent the player's office on Maps.
  function chooseWorkplace(){
    // Use a building near (45, 0) â€” the avenue between Bank lot and the central lot.
    let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
    const target = { x: 45, z: 0 };
    for (const b of buildings3d){
      if (!b.isFiller || b.cfg) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(b.pos.x - target.x, b.pos.z - target.z);
      if (d < bestD){ bestD = d; best = b; }
    }
    if (best) return { x: best.pos.x, z: best.pos.z };
    return { x: 45, z: 0 };
  }

  function buildFiller(cx, cz, w, d, h, col){
    // Window-row texture
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 64; c.height = 64;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#' + col.toString(16).padStart(6,'0');
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++){
      for (let c2 = 0; c2 < 4; c2++){
        ctx.fillStyle = (Math.random() < 0.7) ? '#ffe7a0' : '#3a4660';
        ctx.fillRect(8 + c2*14, 8 + r*14, 8, 10);
      }
    }
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    tex.repeat.set(Math.max(1, Math.round(w/3)), Math.max(2, Math.round(h/3)));
    tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;

    const wall = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex })
    );
    wall.position.set(cx, h/2, cz);
    scene.add(wall);
    const roof = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(w + 0.4, 0.4, d + 0.4),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x3a3a3a })
    );
    roof.position.set(cx, h + 0.2, cz);
    scene.add(roof);
    // Rooftop water tower (NYC signature)
    if (Math.random() < 0.45){
      const tank = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.55, 1.0, 12),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x6b4a32 })
      );
      tank.position.set(cx + (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5, h + 1.0, cz + (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5);
      scene.add(tank);
      const top = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.6, 0.5, 12),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4a3422 })
      );
      top.position.copy(tank.position); top.position.y += 0.7;
      scene.add(top);
    }
    // Track for collision (no interaction)
    const fillerEntry = {
      group: wall, label: null, cfg: null,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(cx, 0, cz),
      collideR: Math.max(w, d) * 0.55,
      isFiller: true,
      isCityFiller: !!buildFiller._cityMode,
    };
    buildings3d.push(fillerEntry);
  }

  function buildCornerStore(cx, cz, awningColor){
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const W = 5, H = 4, D = 5;
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(W, H, D),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xc57b57 })
    );
    body.position.y = H/2;
    group.add(body);

    // Striped awning
    const ac = document.createElement('canvas');
    ac.width = 64; ac.height = 16;
    const acx = ac.getContext('2d');
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++){
      acx.fillStyle = (i & 1) ? '#ffffff' : '#' + awningColor.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
      acx.fillRect(i*8, 0, 8, 16);
    }
    const awTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(ac);
    const awning = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(W * 0.95, 0.22, 1.3),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: awTex })
    );
    awning.position.set(0, 2.7, D/2 + 0.6);
    awning.rotation.x = -0.12;
    group.add(awning);

    // Sign
    const sigC = document.createElement('canvas');
    sigC.width = 256; sigC.height = 64;
    const sctx = sigC.getContext('2d');
    sctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a'; sctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 64);
    const names = ['DELI','BODEGA','PIZZA','MARKET','DINER','LAUNDRY','COFFEE','LIQUOR','BAGELS','GROCER','BARBER','RAMEN'];
    sctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial Black, sans-serif';
    sctx.textAlign = 'center'; sctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    sctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
    sctx.fillText(names[Math.floor(Math.random()*names.length)], 128, 34);
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(W * 0.85, 0.7),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: new THREE.CanvasTexture(sigC) })
    );
    sign.position.set(0, 3.4, D/2 + 0.04);
    group.add(sign);

    // Door + window
    const door = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.85, 1.6, 0.05),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4f342a })
    );
    door.position.set(-1.2, 0.8, D/2 + 0.03);
    group.add(door);
    const win = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.0, 1.4, 0.04),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xa9d6e8, emissive: 0x4fc3f7, emissiveIntensity: 0.18 })
    );
    win.position.set(1.0, 1.4, D/2 + 0.03);
    group.add(win);

    group.position.set(cx, 0, cz);
    // Face the nearest road
    group.rotation.y = (Math.abs(cx) > Math.abs(cz)) ? (cx > 0 ? -Math.PI/2 : Math.PI/2) : (cz > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
    scene.add(group);

    buildings3d.push({
      group, label: null, cfg: null,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(cx, 0, cz),
      collideR: Math.max(W, D) * 0.55,
      isFiller: true,
    });
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� STREET PROPS â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function placeStreetProps(){
    // Lamps along avenues every 12 units, both sidewalks
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      for (let z = -100; z <= 100; z += 12){
        buildLamp(ax + AVE_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W * 0.5, z);
        buildLamp(ax - AVE_W/2 - SIDEWALK_W * 0.5, z);
      }
    }
    // Hydrants at every intersection
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      for (const sz of STREETS){
        const hx = ax + AVE_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W * 0.5;
        const hz = sz + ST_W/2 + SIDEWALK_W * 0.5;
        const h = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.22, 0.7, 8),
          new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xc62828 })
        );
        h.position.set(hx, 0.35, hz);
        scene.add(h);
      }
    }
  }

  function resizeRenderer(){
    if (!renderer) return;
    const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
    renderer.setSize(w, h, false);

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� INPUT â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function bindInput(){
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      // If the Block Trade iframe has focus, route keys to the game (not FinLife).
      if (blockTradeIframe && document.activeElement === blockTradeIframe) return;
      const k = (e.key || '').toLowerCase();
      keys[k] = true;
      if (k === 'e'){ e.preventDefault(); togglePhone(); }
      else if (k === 'tab'){ e.preventDefault(); togglePhone(); } // legacy compatibility
      else if (k === 'f' && !phoneOpen) interact();
      else if (k === 'escape' && phoneOpen) closePhone();
    });
    window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[(e.key||'').toLowerCase()] = false; });

    const canvas = $$('world3d');
    canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (phoneOpen || isTouch) return;
      if (!pointerLocked) canvas.requestPointerLock();
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
      pointerLocked = (document.pointerLockElement === canvas);
      $$('hud-pointerlock').classList.toggle('show', !pointerLocked && !phoneOpen && !isTouch);
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      if (!pointerLocked) return;
      mouseDX += e.movementX || 0;
      mouseDY += e.movementY || 0;
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeRenderer);

    // Phone wiring
    document.querySelectorAll('#phone-home button').forEach(b => {
      b.onclick = () => openApp(b.dataset.app);
    });
    $$('phone-back').onclick = showPhoneHome;

    // Route cancel
    $$('hr-cancel').onclick = clearRoute;

    // Sleep dialog
    $$('sleep-no').onclick = () => $$('sleep-dialog').classList.remove('open');
    $$('sleep-ok').onclick = () => {
      $$('sleep-dialog').classList.remove('open');
      const ageBtn = $$('btn-age');
      if (ageBtn) ageBtn.click();
      setTimeout(updateHud, 60);
    };

    // Mobile
    if (isTouch) bindMobile();
  }

  function bindMobile(){
    const stick = $$('mob-stick'), knob = $$('mob-stick-knob');
    let stickActive = false, sCx = 0, sCy = 0;
    stick.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const r = stick.getBoundingClientRect();
      sCx = r.left + r.width/2; sCy = r.top + r.height/2;
      stickActive = true;
    }, { passive:false });
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
      if (!stickActive) return;
      const t = e.touches[0]; if (!t) return;
      const dx = t.clientX - sCx, dy = t.clientY - sCy;
      const m = Math.min(50, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
      const a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      knob.style.left = (50 + Math.cos(a)*m*0.7) + '%';
      knob.style.top = (50 + Math.sin(a)*m*0.7) + '%';
      touchMove.active = true;
      touchMove.dx = Math.cos(a) * (m/50);
      touchMove.dy = Math.sin(a) * (m/50);
    }, { passive:false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      if (!e.touches || e.touches.length === 0){
        stickActive = false; touchLook.active = false;
        touchMove.active = false; touchMove.dx = 0; touchMove.dy = 0;
        knob.style.left = '50%'; knob.style.top = '50%';
      }
    });

    const look = $$('mob-look');
    look.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
      const t = e.touches[0]; if (!t) return;
      touchLook.active = true; touchLook.lastX = t.clientX; touchLook.lastY = t.clientY;
    }, { passive:false });
    look.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
      if (!touchLook.active) return;
      const t = e.touches[0]; if (!t) return;
      mouseDX += (t.clientX - touchLook.lastX) * 1.6;
      mouseDY += (t.clientY - touchLook.lastY) * 1.6;
      touchLook.lastX = t.clientX; touchLook.lastY = t.clientY;
    }, { passive:false });

    $$('mob-e').addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); interact(); }, { passive:false });
    $$('mob-phone').addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); togglePhone(); }, { passive:false });
  }
