  function getMapsDestinations(){
    const dests = [];
    for (const b of BUILDINGS){
      dests.push({ kind:'building', x:b.pos[0], z:b.pos[1], name:b.label, icon:b.icon, id:b.id });
    }
    // Work: pick a designated workplace filler if char is employed
    const gs = readGS();
    const c = gs && gs.char;
    if (c && c.employed && workplacePos){
      dests.push({ kind:'work', x:workplacePos.x, z:workplacePos.z, name: c.jobTitle || 'Office', icon:'ðŸ’¼' });
    }
    // Family: spouse + kids live at home
    if (c && (c.spouseName || (c.kids|0) > 0)){
      const homeBld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'home');
      const fam = [];
      if (c.spouseName) fam.push(c.spouseName);
      if ((c.kids|0) > 0) fam.push((c.kids|0) + ' ' + ((c.kids|0) === 1 ? 'kid' : 'kids'));
      dests.push({ kind:'family', x:homeBld.pos[0], z:homeBld.pos[1], name:'Family â€” ' + fam.join(' Â· '), icon:'â�¤ï¸�' });
    }
    return dests;
  }

  function renderMapsApp(){
    const canvas = document.querySelector('.maps-canvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    // World extent â€” island radius ISLAND_R; map fits a square slightly larger
    const view = ISLAND_R + 8;
    const scale = (W * 0.5) / view;
    const wx = (x) => W/2 + x*scale;
    const wz = (z) => H/2 + z*scale; // +z is south (down on map)

    // Water
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1565c0';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // Sand
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ead9a8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, SAND_R*scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // Grass
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4caf50';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, ISLAND_R*scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // Roads
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a';
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      ctx.fillRect(wx(ax) - (AVE_W*scale)/2, 0, AVE_W*scale, H);
    }
    for (const sz of STREETS){
      ctx.fillRect(0, wz(sz) - (ST_W*scale)/2, W, ST_W*scale);
    }

    // Filler buildings (small dark dots)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3e3e3e';
    for (const b of buildings3d){
      if (!b.isFiller) continue;
      ctx.fillRect(wx(b.pos.x) - 1.5, wz(b.pos.z) - 1.5, 3, 3);
    }

    // Action buildings (colored dots with letters)
    for (const b of BUILDINGS){
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx(b.pos[0]), wz(b.pos[1]), 6, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Route line + target
    if (mapsTarget){
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe066';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(wx(player.x), wz(player.z));
      ctx.lineTo(wx(mapsTarget.x), wz(mapsTarget.z));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(wx(mapsTarget.x), wz(mapsTarget.z), 9, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#000'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Player (blue arrow)
    const px = wx(player.x), pz = wz(player.z);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, pz);
    // yaw: 0 = looking -Z (up on map). +yaw = looking +X side (right on map).
    ctx.rotate(player.yaw);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4fc3f7';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -10); ctx.lineTo(7, 7); ctx.lineTo(0, 4); ctx.lineTo(-7, 7); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Build the destination lists
    const dests = getMapsDestinations();
    const buildingsList = $$('maps-list-buildings');
    const peopleList    = $$('maps-list-people');
    if (!buildingsList || !peopleList) return;
    buildingsList.innerHTML = '';
    peopleList.innerHTML = '';
    for (const d of dests){
      const dist = Math.hypot(d.x - player.x, d.z - player.z);
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'maps-row';
      if (mapsTarget && mapsTarget.x === d.x && mapsTarget.z === d.z) row.classList.add('active');
      row.innerHTML = `
        <span class="mr-name">${d.icon} ${d.name}</span>
        <span class="mr-dist">${Math.round(dist)} m</span>
      `;
      row.onclick = () => { setRoute(d); closePhone(); };
      if (d.kind === 'building') buildingsList.appendChild(row);
      else peopleList.appendChild(row);
    }
    if (peopleList.childNodes.length === 0){
      peopleList.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;padding:6px 4px">No people or workplace yet â€” get a job and start a family!</div>';
    }
    const clearBtn = $$('maps-clear-btn');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.classList.toggle('show', !!mapsTarget);
  }

  function setRoute(dest){

    mapsBeacon.position.z = dest.z;

  }

  function clearRoute(){

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� INTERACT â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function interact(){
    // In-store: buy nearest item OR exit if at the south door
    if (inStore){
      const si = findNearestStoreItem();
      if (si){ buyStoreItem(si); return; }
      if (isAtStoreExit()){ exitStore(); return; }
      return;
    }
    // City filler that's been assigned a brand store
    if (nearestStoreFiller){
      enterStore(nearestStoreFiller);
      return;
    }
    if (!nearestBuilding) return;
    const cfg = nearestBuilding.cfg;
    if (cfg.action === 'sleep'){
      $$('sleep-dialog').classList.add('open');
      if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
      return;
    }
    const btn = document.getElementById(cfg.action);
    if (!btn) return;
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
    btn.click();
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� MAIN LOOP â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if (!scene || !renderer) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, clock.getDelta());

    // Look
    if (mouseDX || mouseDY){
      player.yaw   -= mouseDX * 0.0025;
      player.pitch -= mouseDY * 0.0025;
      if (player.pitch >  1.2) player.pitch =  1.2;
      if (player.pitch < -1.2) player.pitch = -1.2;
      mouseDX = 0; mouseDY = 0;
    }

    // Move
    if (!phoneOpen){
      const speed = inStore ? 5 : 14;
      let fwd = 0, right = 0;
      if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup'])    fwd   += 1;
      if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown'])  fwd   -= 1;
      if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft'])  right -= 1;
      if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) right += 1;
      if (touchMove.active){ fwd -= touchMove.dy; right += touchMove.dx; }
      if (fwd || right){
        const mag = Math.hypot(fwd, right) || 1;
        fwd /= mag; right /= mag;
        const sin = Math.sin(player.yaw), cos = Math.cos(player.yaw);
        const dx = (-sin * fwd + cos * right) * speed * dt;
        const dz = (-cos * fwd - sin * right) * speed * dt;
        let nx = player.x + dx, nz = player.z + dz;
        if (inStore){
          // Clamp to store room walls
          const halfW = storeRoom.w/2 - 0.4, halfD = storeRoom.d/2 - 0.4;
          if (nx >  halfW) nx =  halfW;
          if (nx < -halfW) nx = -halfW;
          if (nz >  halfD) nz =  halfD;
          if (nz < -halfD) nz = -halfD;
        } else {
          const r = Math.hypot(nx, nz);
          if (r > ISLAND_R - 2){ const k = (ISLAND_R - 2)/r; nx *= k; nz *= k; }
          for (const b of buildings3d){
            const d = Math.hypot(nx - b.pos.x, nz - b.pos.z);
            const cr = b.collideR || 2.8;
            if (d < cr){
              const pa = Math.atan2(nz - b.pos.z, nx - b.pos.x);
              nx = b.pos.x + Math.cos(pa) * cr;
              nz = b.pos.z + Math.sin(pa) * cr;
            }
          }
        }
        player.x = nx; player.z = nz;
      }
    }

    camera.position.set(player.x, player.y, player.z);
    camera.rotation.set(player.pitch, player.yaw, 0);

    // Proximity: in-store = nearest shelf item; outside = action building or store entrance
    nearestBuilding = null;
    nearestStoreFiller = null;
    const prompt = $$('hud-prompt');
    if (inStore){
      const si = findNearestStoreItem();
      if (si && !phoneOpen){
        prompt.innerHTML = `Press <b>F</b> to buy <b>${si.item[2]} ${si.item[0]}</b> â€” $${si.item[1]}`;
        prompt.classList.add('show');
      } else if (isAtStoreExit() && !phoneOpen){
        prompt.innerHTML = `Press <b>F</b> to leave the store`;
        prompt.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        prompt.classList.remove('show');
      }
    } else {
      let bestD = Infinity;
      for (const b of buildings3d){
        if (!b.cfg) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(player.x - b.pos.x, player.z - b.pos.z);
        const range = (b.collideR || 2.8) + 1.6;
        if (d < range && d < bestD){ bestD = d; nearestBuilding = b; }
      }
      // Brand-store fillers
      let bestS = Infinity;
      for (const b of buildings3d){
        if (!b.isCityFiller || b.storeIdx === undefined) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(player.x - b.pos.x, player.z - b.pos.z);
        const range = (b.collideR || 2.8) + 1.6;
        if (d < range && d < bestS){ bestS = d; nearestStoreFiller = b; }
      }
      if (nearestBuilding && !phoneOpen){
        prompt.innerHTML = nearestBuilding.cfg.action === 'sleep'
          ? `Press <b>F</b> to sleep at <b>${nearestBuilding.cfg.label}</b>`
          : `Press <b>F</b> to enter <b>${nearestBuilding.cfg.label}</b>`;
        prompt.classList.add('show');
      } else if (nearestStoreFiller && !phoneOpen){
        const [name] = STORES[nearestStoreFiller.storeIdx];
        prompt.innerHTML = `Press <b>F</b> to enter <b>${name}</b>`;
        prompt.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        prompt.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }

    // Carried phone bob + hide while overlay is open
    if (phoneModel){
      phoneBobT += dt;
      const moving = !phoneOpen && (keys['w']||keys['a']||keys['s']||keys['d']||keys['arrowup']||keys['arrowdown']||keys['arrowleft']||keys['arrowright']||touchMove.active);
      const bob = moving ? Math.sin(phoneBobT * 9) * 0.006 : 0;
      phoneModel.position.y = -0.13 + bob;
      phoneModel.visible = !phoneOpen;
    }

    // While in a store, hide the routing chip
    if (inStore){
      $$('hud-route').classList.remove('show');
    }
    // Routing HUD chip + auto-clear on arrival (skip while in a store)
    if (mapsTarget && !inStore){
      const dx = mapsTarget.x - player.x;
      const dz = mapsTarget.z - player.z;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (dist < 4.5){
        clearRoute();
      } else {
        // Bearing relative to player heading. yaw=0 â†’ forward = -Z; +yaw rotates toward +X.
        // World direction-to-target angle (atan2(x, -z) yields 0 when target is straight ahead).
        const targetAngle = Math.atan2(dx, -dz);
        let rel = targetAngle - player.yaw;
        // wrap to [-Ï€, Ï€]
        rel = ((rel + Math.PI) % (Math.PI*2) + (Math.PI*2)) % (Math.PI*2) - Math.PI;
        const arrowEl = $$('hr-arrow');
        const distEl  = $$('hr-dist');
        if (arrowEl) arrowEl.style.transform = 'rotate(' + (rel * 180/Math.PI) + 'deg)';
        if (distEl)  distEl.textContent  = Math.round(dist) + 'm';
        // Subtle beacon pulse via emissive scale
        if (mapsBeacon){
          const t = clock ? clock.elapsedTime : 0;
          mapsBeacon.scale.x = mapsBeacon.scale.z = 1 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.06;
        }
      }
    }

    // Render the active scene through the shared camera. Camera stays parented to `scene`
    // so the carried phone (its child) renders outside; inside a store the phone is hidden
    // but the store interior renders correctly.
    renderer.render(inStore && storeScene ? storeScene : scene, camera);
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� HUD â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  // GS / MONTH_NAMES / GAME_START_YEAR are top-level `const` in the prior script
  // (lexically global but NOT on window). Read them defensively.
  function readGS(){ try { return GS; } catch(e){ return null; } }
  function readMonthNames(){ try { return MONTH_NAMES; } catch(e){ return ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']; } }
  function readStartYear(){ try { return GAME_START_YEAR; } catch(e){ return 2026; } }

  function updateHud(){
    const gs = readGS();
    const c = gs && gs.char;
    if (!c) return;
    const money = (c.checking||0) + (c.savings||0) + (c.highYield||0);
    const fmt = m => '$' + Math.round(m).toLocaleString();
    $$('hud-money').textContent = fmt(money);
    $$('hud-age').textContent = c.age;
    const startY = readStartYear();
    const monthAge = (c.monthAge != null) ? c.monthAge : (c.age * 12);
    const monthsSinceStart = monthAge - 18*12;
    const yr = startY + Math.floor(monthsSinceStart / 12);
    const mo = ((monthsSinceStart % 12) + 12) % 12;
    const monthNames = readMonthNames();
    $$('hud-date').textContent = `${monthNames[mo]} ${yr}`;
    $$('ps-info').textContent = `${fmt(money)} Â· Age ${c.age}`;
  }

  // â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� HOOK INTO GAME START â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�â•�
  function attachStart(){
    const startBtn = $$('btn-start');
    if (!startBtn) return;

  function buildWarehouseInterior(scene, store, palette, w, d){
    const shelfItems = [];
    function makeItemTexture(name, price, icon){
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=128; c.height=128;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.accent; ctx.fillRect(0,0,128,128);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fillRect(4,4,120,120);
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.accent; ctx.fillRect(8,8,112,112);
      ctx.font = '64px Arial'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(icon||'?', 64, 54);
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.primary; ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial Black, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('$'+price, 64, 100);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    }
    function makeBannerTexture(text){
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=1024; c.height=256;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.primary; ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,256);
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.secondary; ctx.fillRect(0,6,1024,6); ctx.fillRect(0,244,1024,6);
      ctx.font = 'bold 96px Arial Black, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(text, 512, 128);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    }
    const frameMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x3a3a3a});
    const shelfMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x808080});
    const counterMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:palette.primary});
    const registerMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x222222});
    const tubeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfff8d6});
    const cartMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xb0b4b8});
    const numUnits = 4, unitW=4, unitH=3, unitD=0.7, aisleHalf=2.2;
    const totalRowLen = numUnits*unitW;
    const startX = -totalRowLen/2 + unitW/2;
    const shelfYs = [0.5, 1.4, 2.3];
    const shelves = [];
    for (let row = 0; row < 2; row++){
      const zPos = (row===0?-1:1)*aisleHalf;
      const facing = (row===0?1:-1);
      for (let i = 0; i < numUnits; i++){
        const x = startX + i*unitW;
        const group = new THREE.Group();
        const back = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(unitW, unitH, 0.05), frameMat);
        back.position.set(0, unitH/2, -facing*unitD/2); group.add(back);
        for (let s=-1; s<=1; s+=2){
          const post = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, unitH, unitD), frameMat);
          post.position.set(s*unitW/2, unitH/2, 0); group.add(post);
        }
        for (const sy of shelfYs){
          const sh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(unitW-0.1, 0.05, unitD), shelfMat);
          sh.position.set(0, sy, 0); group.add(sh);
          shelves.push({x:x, y:sy+0.05+0.175, z:zPos, facing:facing, unitW:unitW});
        }
        group.position.set(x, 0, zPos); scene.add(group);
      }
    }
    const inv = store.inv||[];
    const itemsPerShelf = Math.ceil(inv.length/shelves.length);
    for (let i=0; i<inv.length; i++){
      const item = inv[i];
      const shelfIdx = i % shelves.length;
      const slotIdx = Math.floor(i/shelves.length);
      const sh = shelves[shelfIdx];
      const slotsAcross = Math.max(itemsPerShelf, 4);
      const spacing = (sh.unitW-0.6)/slotsAcross;
      const localX = -sh.unitW/2 + 0.3 + (slotIdx+0.5)*spacing;
      const px = sh.x + localX, py = sh.y, pz = sh.z + sh.facing*0.05;
      const tex = makeItemTexture(item[0], item[1], item[2]);
      const sideMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:palette.accent});
      const frontMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:tex});
      const mats = [sideMat,sideMat,sideMat,sideMat,sideMat,sideMat];
      if (sh.facing>0) mats[4]=frontMat; else mats[5]=frontMat;
      const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.35, 0.35), mats);
      box.position.set(px, py, pz); scene.add(box);
      shelfItems.push({type:'shelfItem', item, mesh:box, pos:[px,py,pz]});
    }
    const counter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4, 0.8, 1), counterMat);
    counter.position.set(-w/4, 0.4, d/2 - 1.5); scene.add(counter);
    const register = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.4, 0.5), registerMat);
    register.position.set(-w/4 + 1.2, 1.0, d/2 - 1.5); scene.add(register);
    const screen = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.3, 0.05), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x88ddff}));
    screen.position.set(-w/4 + 1.2, 1.05, d/2 - 1.27); scene.add(screen);
    const bannerTex = makeBannerTexture((store.n||'STORE').toUpperCase());
    const banner = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w*0.6, 1.5), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:bannerTex}));
    banner.position.set(0, 3, -d/2 + 0.05); scene.add(banner);
    const numTubes = 5, tubeLen = w*0.9;
    for (let i=0; i<numTubes; i++){
      const tube = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.06, tubeLen, 8), tubeMat);
      tube.rotation.z = Math.PI/2;
      const tz = -d/2 + (i+1)*(d/(numTubes+1));
      tube.position.set(0, 3.85, tz); scene.add(tube);
      const housing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(tubeLen, 0.08, 0.25), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xeeeeee}));
      housing.position.set(0, 3.95, tz); scene.add(housing);
    }
    const corralX = w/2 - 2, corralZ = d/2 - 1.5;
    for (let i=0; i<4; i++){
      const cart = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.7, 0.5), cartMat);
      cart.position.set(corralX - i*0.25, 0.4, corralZ); scene.add(cart);
    }
    const stripe = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(totalRowLen+2, 0.15),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:palette.secondary}));
    stripe.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; stripe.position.set(0, 0.01, 0); scene.add(stripe);
    return shelfItems;
  }

  function buildBoutiqueInterior(scene, store, palette, w, d){
    const shelfItems = [];
    const makeItemTex = (name, price, icon) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=256; c.height=256;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,256,256);
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.primary;
      ctx.font = '120px serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(icon, 128, 110);
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia, serif';
      const nm = (name||'').length > 14 ? name.slice(0,13)+'â€¦' : (name||'');
      ctx.fillText(nm, 128, 188);
      ctx.font = 'bold 26px Georgia, serif';
      ctx.fillText('$'+price, 128, 220);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    };
    const makeSignTex = (text) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=1024; c.height=256;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.primary; ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,256);
      ctx.fillStyle = palette.secondary;
      ctx.font = 'bold 96px Georgia, serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(text, 512, 128);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    };
    const woodMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x5d3a1a});
    const glassMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xb8e0ff, transparent:true, opacity:0.35});
    const itemBoxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 0.3);
    const floorAccent = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w-0.5, d-0.5),

    floorAccent.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; floorAccent.position.y = 0.01; scene.add(floorAccent);

      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xa8c8e8, transparent:true, opacity:0.7}));

    const frame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w*0.55+0.2, 2.6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:palette.primary}));
    frame.position.set(0, 2.0, -d/2 + 0.02); scene.add(frame);
    const inv = store.inv||[];
    const casePositions = [
      {x:-w/2+1.2, z:-d/4, ry:Math.PI/2},
      {x: w/2-1.2, z:-d/4, ry:-Math.PI/2},
      {x:-w/2+1.2, z: d/4, ry:Math.PI/2},
      {x: w/2-1.2, z: d/4, ry:-Math.PI/2},
    ];
    let invIdx = 0;
    casePositions.forEach((cp) => {
      const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.5, 1.0, 0.6), woodMat);
      base.position.set(cp.x, 0.5, cp.z); base.rotation.y = cp.ry; scene.add(base);
      const top = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.5, 0.6), glassMat);
      top.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; top.position.set(cp.x, 1.02, cp.z); scene.add(top);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3 && invIdx < inv.length; i++){
        const item = inv[invIdx % inv.length];
        const tex = makeItemTex(item[0], item[1], item[2]);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:tex});
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(itemBoxGeo, mat);
        const offset = (i-1)*0.45;
        const lx = cp.x - Math.sin(cp.ry)*offset;
        const lz = cp.z + Math.cos(cp.ry)*offset;
        mesh.position.set(lx, 1.18, lz); scene.add(mesh);
        shelfItems.push({type:'shelfItem', item, mesh, pos:[lx,1.18,lz]});
        invIdx++;
      }
    });
    const shelfYs = [1.6, 2.4];
    const sides = [{x:-w/2+0.05, dir:1},{x:w/2-0.05, dir:-1}];
    sides.forEach((s) => {

        const shelf = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(d*0.6, 0.25),
          new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x5d3a1a, side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
        shelf.rotation.y = s.dir > 0 ? Math.PI/2 : -Math.PI/2;
        shelf.position.set(s.x, y, 0); scene.add(shelf);
        const count = 4;
        for (let i = 0; i < count && invIdx < inv.length*2; i++){
          const item = inv[invIdx % inv.length];
          const tex = makeItemTex(item[0], item[1], item[2]);
          const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:tex});
          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(itemBoxGeo, mat);
          const zPos = (i-(count-1)/2)*(d*0.55/count);
          mesh.position.set(s.x + s.dir*0.2, y+0.2, zPos); scene.add(mesh);
          shelfItems.push({type:'shelfItem', item, mesh, pos:[s.x+s.dir*0.2, y+0.2, zPos]});
          invIdx++;
        }
      });
    });
    const podium = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.6, 1.0, 24), woodMat);
    podium.position.set(0, 0.5, d/2 - 1.8); scene.add(podium);
    const register = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.25, 0.35),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:palette.accent}));
    register.position.set(0, 1.13, d/2 - 1.8); scene.add(register);
    const mannMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:palette.accent});
    const mann = new THREE.Group();
    mann.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 0.8, 12), mannMat));

        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfff2c8}));
      bulb.position.set(px, 3.1, 0); scene.add(bulb);
    });
    const signTex = makeSignTex(store.n);
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w*0.5, 0.7),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:signTex}));
    sign.position.set(0, 3.3, d/2 - 0.05); sign.rotation.y = Math.PI; scene.add(sign);
    return shelfItems;
  }

  function buildGroceryInterior(scene, store, palette, w, d){
    const shelfItems = [];
    const lam = (col) => new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:col});
    const makeProductTex = (item) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=128; c.height=160;
      const g = c.getContext('2d');
      g.fillStyle = palette.primary; g.fillRect(0,0,128,160);
      g.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; g.fillRect(4,4,120,152);
      g.fillStyle = palette.primary; g.fillRect(8,8,112,100);
      g.font = '64px sans-serif'; g.textAlign='center'; g.textBaseline='middle';
      g.fillText(item[2]||'*', 64, 60);
      g.fillStyle = palette.accent; g.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
      g.fillText('$'+item[1], 64, 130);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    };
    // checkered floor
    const floorCan = document.createElement('canvas'); floorCan.width=256; floorCan.height=256;
    const fg = floorCan.getContext('2d');
    for (let i=0; i<8; i++) for (let j=0; j<8; j++){
      fg.fillStyle = ((i+j)%2===0) ? '#ffffff' : '#222222';
      fg.fillRect(i*32, j*32, 32, 32);
    }
    const floorTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(floorCan);
    floorTex.wrapS = floorTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    floorTex.repeat.set(w/4, d/4);
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w-0.2, d-0.2),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:floorTex}));
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; floor.position.y = 0.01; scene.add(floor);
    // produce stands
    const produceColors = [0xff3b3b, 0xff7a1a, 0xffd84d, 0x6cd24a, 0xa83fff, 0xff9bd2];
    for (let s=0; s<3; s++){
      const bx = -w/3 + s*(w/3);
      const bin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.8, 0.7, 1.2), lam(0xc9a36a));
      bin.position.set(bx, 0.35, d/2 - 2.2); scene.add(bin);
      for (let i=0; i<10; i++){
        const sph = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.13, 8, 6),
          lam(produceColors[(i+s)%produceColors.length]));
        sph.position.set(bx+(Math.random()-0.5)*1.4, 0.78+Math.random()*0.1, d/2-2.2+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.9);
        scene.add(sph);
      }
    }
    // pantry shelves
    const aisleZs = [-d/6, 0, d/6];
    let invIdx = 0;
    const inv = store.inv || [];
    for (let a=0; a<3; a++){
      const z = aisleZs[a];
      const unit = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(Math.min(6, w*0.6), 2.4, 0.7), lam(0xf0f0f0));
      unit.position.set(0, 1.2, z); scene.add(unit);
      for (const yL of [0.55, 1.25, 1.95]){
        for (const side of [-1, 1]){
          for (let i=0; i<6; i++){
            if (invIdx >= inv.length) break;
            const item = inv[invIdx++];
            const tex = makeProductTex(item);
            const mats = [lam(0xdddddd),lam(0xdddddd),lam(0xdddddd),lam(0xdddddd),
              new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:tex}), lam(0xdddddd)];
            if (side===-1){ mats[5]=mats[4]; mats[4]=lam(0xdddddd); }
            const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.4, 0.25), mats);
            const px = -2.4 + i*0.55, pz = z + side*0.32;
            box.position.set(px, yL+0.2, pz); scene.add(box);
            shelfItems.push({type:'shelfItem', item, mesh:box, pos:[px, yL+0.2, pz]});

    // freezer aisle
    const freezerCount = 4, freezerSpan = w*0.7;
    const freezerStart = -freezerSpan/2 + 0.75;
    for (let f=0; f<freezerCount; f++){
      const fx = freezerStart + f*(freezerSpan/(freezerCount-1));
      const fz = -d/2 + 0.45;
      const cab = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.5, 2.2, 0.8), lam(0xc0c8d0));
      cab.position.set(fx, 1.1, fz); scene.add(cab);
      const door = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.36, 2.05),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xb8e0ff, transparent:true, opacity:0.5}));
      door.position.set(fx, 1.1, fz+0.42); scene.add(door);
    }
    // checkout
    for (let lane=0; lane<2; lane++){
      const lx = (lane===0?-1:1)*2.2, lz = d/2 - 4.2;
      const beltBase = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 0.85, 0.55), lam(0xdddddd));
      beltBase.position.set(lx, 0.42, lz); scene.add(beltBase);
      const reg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.5, 0.5),
        lam(parseInt((palette.primary||'#666').replace('#',''), 16)));
      reg.position.set(lx+1.1, 1.2, lz); scene.add(reg);
    }
    // sign
    const signCan = document.createElement('canvas'); signCan.width=1024; signCan.height=256;
    const sg = signCan.getContext('2d');
    sg.fillStyle = palette.primary; sg.fillRect(0,0,1024,256);
    sg.fillStyle = palette.accent;
    sg.font = 'bold 80px Arial Black, sans-serif'; sg.textAlign='center'; sg.textBaseline='middle';
    sg.fillText((store.n||'').toUpperCase(), 512, 128);
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w*0.55, 1.2),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:new THREE.CanvasTexture(signCan)}));
    sign.position.set(0, 3.2, d/2 - 0.05); sign.rotation.y = Math.PI; scene.add(sign);
    return shelfItems;
  }

  function buildCafeInterior(scene, store, palette, w, d){
    const shelfItems = [];
    const primary = palette.primary || '#006241';
    const secondary = palette.secondary || '#a07a4f';
    const accent = palette.accent || '#ffffff';
    function makeTextTex(draw, ww, hh){
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=ww; c.height=hh;
      draw(c.getContext('2d'), ww, hh);
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    }
    const counterZ = -d/2 + 1.5;
    const counter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(8, 1.05, 0.9),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x3a2618}));
    counter.position.set(0, 0.525, counterZ); scene.add(counter);
    const marble = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 0.9),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xdcd0c0}));
    marble.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; marble.position.set(0, 1.06, counterZ); scene.add(marble);
    const caseGroup = new THREE.Group();
    const caseBody = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 0.8, 0.6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x2a1810}));
    caseBody.position.y = 0.4; caseGroup.add(caseBody);
    const glass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 0.8),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xb8e0ff, transparent:true, opacity:0.4}));
    glass.position.set(0, 0.4, 0.301); caseGroup.add(glass);
    caseGroup.position.set(-2.8, 1.07, counterZ + 0.1); scene.add(caseGroup);
    const items = store.inv || [];
    const cols = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, items.length));
    for (let i=0; i<items.length; i++){
      const it = items[i];
      const tex = makeTextTex((ctx, ww, hh) => {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff7e6'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,ww,hh);
        ctx.fillStyle = primary; ctx.font = 'bold 60px serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
        ctx.fillText(it[2]||'', ww/2, hh*0.5);
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
        ctx.fillText(String(it[0]).slice(0,10), ww/2, hh*0.78);
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial'; ctx.fillText('$'+it[1], ww/2, hh*0.95);
      }, 128, 128);
      const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({map:tex});
      const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.25, 0.25), mat);
      const col = i % cols, row = Math.floor(i/cols);
      const x = -2.8 + (col-(cols-1)/2)*0.36;
      const y = 0.95 + row*0.3;
      const z = counterZ + 0.1;
      box.position.set(x, y, z); caseGroup.add(box);
      shelfItems.push({type:'shelfItem', item:it, mesh:box, pos:[x,y,z]});
    }
    // espresso machine
    const espBody = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 0.6, 0.5),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xc0c0c0}));
    espBody.position.set(1.2, 1.4, counterZ); scene.add(espBody);
    // tables + chairs
    const tableMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xc9a36a});
    const pedMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x3a2618});
    const chairMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:primary});
    const tablePositions = [[-w/4, d/8],[w/4, d/8],[-w/4, d/3.5],[w/4, d/3.5]];
    for (const [tx, tz] of tablePositions){
      const ped = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 0.7, 12), pedMat);
      ped.position.set(tx, 0.35, tz); scene.add(ped);
      const top = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.6, 0.05, 16), tableMat);
      top.position.set(tx, 0.75, tz); scene.add(top);
      for (let cc=0; cc<2; cc++){
        const off = cc===0 ? -0.95 : 0.95;
        const seat = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 0.05, 0.45), chairMat);
        seat.position.set(tx+off, 0.45, tz); scene.add(seat);
      }
    }
    // pendant lights
    for (let i=0; i<3; i++){
      const px = -2.5 + i*2.5;
      const shade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.25, 0.4, 12, 1, true),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfff2c8}));
      shade.position.set(px, 3.0, counterZ); scene.add(shade);
    }
    // sign
    const signTex = makeTextTex((ctx, ww, hh) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = primary; ctx.fillRect(0,0,ww,hh);
      ctx.fillStyle = accent; ctx.font = 'bold 56px Georgia, serif';
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(store.n||'Cafe', ww/2, hh/2);
    }, 1024, 200);
    const sign = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w*0.45, 0.7),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:signTex}));
    sign.position.set(0, 3.3, d/2 - 0.05); sign.rotation.y = Math.PI; scene.add(sign);
    return shelfItems;
  }

  const STORE_BUILDERS = {
    warehouse: buildWarehouseInterior,
    boutique:  buildBoutiqueInterior,
    grocery:   buildGroceryInterior,
    cafe:      buildCafeInterior,
  };

  // â”€â”€ Store flow: assignment, signage, enter, shop, exit â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  let storeScene = null;
  let storeShelfItems = [];
  let inStore = false;
  let currentStoreIdx = -1;
  let storeRoom = { w: 18, d: 14 };
  let storeSnapshot = null;

  function assignStoresToFillers(){
    // Only city-grid fillers (not suburbs ring)
    const eligible = buildings3d.filter(b => b.isCityFiller);
    for (let i = 0; i < eligible.length; i++){
      eligible[i].storeIdx = i % STORES.length;
    }
  }

  function makeStoreSignTexture(name, primary, secondary){
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 512; c.height = 96;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.fillStyle = primary; g.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 96);
    g.fillStyle = secondary;
    g.fillRect(0, 4, 512, 4); g.fillRect(0, 88, 512, 4);
    g.fillStyle = secondary;
    let fontSize = 44;
    if (name.length > 14) fontSize = 32;
    if (name.length > 22) fontSize = 24;
    g.font = `bold ${fontSize}px Arial Black, sans-serif`;
    g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    g.fillText(name.toUpperCase(), 256, 48);
    return new THREE.CanvasTexture(g.canvas);
  }

  function renderStoreSigns(){
    for (const b of buildings3d){
      if (!b.isCityFiller || b.storeIdx === undefined) continue;
      const [name, , primary, secondary] = STORES[b.storeIdx];
      const sign = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.5, 0.85),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: makeStoreSignTexture(name, primary, secondary) })
      );
      // Place above the building, facing the nearest road
      const faceRot = nearestRoadFacingHelper(b.pos.x, b.pos.z);
      const offX = Math.sin(faceRot) * 0.42, offZ = Math.cos(faceRot) * 0.42;
      // Sign sits just outside the building at mid-height
      const yOff = (b.collideR || 3) * 0.6;
      sign.position.set(b.pos.x + offX * (b.collideR + 0.05), 4.5 + yOff*0, b.pos.z + offZ * (b.collideR + 0.05));
      sign.rotation.y = faceRot;
      scene.add(sign);
    }
  }

  function nearestRoadFacingHelper(cx, cz){
    let best = Infinity, rot = 0;
    for (const ax of AVENUES){
      const dd = Math.abs(cx - ax);
      if (dd < best){ best = dd; rot = (cx > ax) ? Math.PI/2 : -Math.PI/2; }
    }
    for (const sz of STREETS){
      const dd = Math.abs(cz - sz);
      if (dd < best){ best = dd; rot = (cz > sz) ? Math.PI : 0; }
    }
    return rot;
  }

  function enterStore(filler){
    if (!filler || filler.storeIdx === undefined) return;
    const [name, archetype, primary, secondary] = STORES[filler.storeIdx];
    const palette = { primary, secondary, accent: '#ffffff' };
    const inv = STORE_INVS[archetype] || STORE_INVS.bigbox;
    const store = { n: name, a: archetype, p: [primary, secondary], inv: inv.slice() };
    const vis = VIS_OF[archetype] || 'warehouse';
    const w = (vis === 'warehouse') ? 22 : (vis === 'grocery' ? 20 : (vis === 'cafe' ? 14 : 14));
    const d = (vis === 'warehouse') ? 18 : (vis === 'grocery' ? 16 : (vis === 'cafe' ? 12 : 12));
    storeRoom = { w, d };

    // Build a fresh interior scene
    storeScene = new THREE.Scene();
    storeScene.background = new THREE.Color(0xd8cebd);
    storeScene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.85));
    const lamp = new THREE.PointLight(0xfff2c8, 1.1, 60);
    lamp.position.set(0, 3.6, 0); storeScene.add(lamp);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.35);
    fill.position.set(8, 12, 6); storeScene.add(fill);
    // NOTE: keep the camera in `scene` so the carried phone (child of camera) still renders outside.
    // We add a separate cloned phone to storeScene and update its transform each frame.

    // Floor
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, d),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8d6e63 }));
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; storeScene.add(floor);
    // Ceiling
    const ceil = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, d),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xeeeeee }));
    ceil.rotation.x = Math.PI/2; ceil.position.y = 4; storeScene.add(ceil);
    // Walls
    function addWall(x, y, z, ww, hh, ry){
      const wall = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ww, hh, 0.2),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xf0e6d2 }));
      wall.position.set(x, y, z); wall.rotation.y = ry; storeScene.add(wall);
    }
    addWall( 0, 2,  d/2, w, 4, 0);
    addWall( 0, 2, -d/2, w, 4, Math.PI);
    addWall( w/2, 2, 0, d, 4,  Math.PI/2);
    addWall(-w/2, 2, 0, d, 4, -Math.PI/2);
    // Door + exit marker on south wall
    const door = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 2.2, 0.05),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4f342a }));
    door.position.set(0, 1.1, d/2 - 0.05); storeScene.add(door);

    // Archetype-specific furnishings
    const builder = STORE_BUILDERS[vis] || buildWarehouseInterior;
    storeShelfItems = builder(storeScene, store, palette, w, d);

    // Snapshot exterior + teleport into store
    storeSnapshot = { x:player.x, y:player.y, z:player.z, yaw:player.yaw, pitch:player.pitch };
    inStore = true;
    currentStoreIdx = filler.storeIdx;
    player.x = 0; player.y = 1.6; player.z = d/2 - 1.8; player.yaw = 0; player.pitch = 0;
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
    showToast('Entered ' + name);
  }

  function exitStore(){
    if (!inStore) return;
    inStore = false;
    currentStoreIdx = -1;
    if (storeSnapshot){
      player.x = storeSnapshot.x; player.y = storeSnapshot.y; player.z = storeSnapshot.z;
      player.yaw = storeSnapshot.yaw; player.pitch = storeSnapshot.pitch;
    }
    storeScene = null;
    storeShelfItems = [];
  }

  function findNearestStoreItem(){
    if (!inStore) return null;
    let nearest = null, best = 1.6;
    for (const si of storeShelfItems){
      const d = Math.hypot(player.x - si.pos[0], player.z - si.pos[2]);
      if (d < best){ best = d; nearest = si; }
    }
    return nearest;
  }

  function isAtStoreExit(){
    if (!inStore) return false;
    return player.z > storeRoom.d/2 - 1.8;
  }

  function buyStoreItem(si){
    const c = readGS()?.char;
    if (!c){ showToast('Game not started'); return; }
    const [name, price, icon] = si.item;
    const total = (c.checking||0) + (c.savings||0);
    if (total < price){ showToast('Not enough cash for ' + name); return; }
    if ((c.checking||0) >= price) c.checking -= price;
    else { const fromCk = c.checking||0; c.checking = 0; c.savings = (c.savings||0) - (price - fromCk); }
    if (!c.belongings) c.belongings = [];
    c.belongings.push({
      id:'b_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),
      name, icon, cost:price,
      purchasedAt: c.monthAge,
      from: STORES[currentStoreIdx]?.[0] || 'Store',
    });
    // Hide the bought item box from the shelf
    if (si.mesh && si.mesh.parent) si.mesh.parent.remove(si.mesh);
    // Remove from active list so it's no longer interactable
    const idx = storeShelfItems.indexOf(si);
    if (idx >= 0) storeShelfItems.splice(idx, 1);
    showToast(`Bought ${icon} ${name} for $${price}`);
    updateHud();
  }

  // Make these accessible to existing interact()/render code below
  window.__finlife3d_stores = {
    enterStore, exitStore, findNearestStoreItem, isAtStoreExit, buyStoreItem,
    isInStore: () => inStore, getStoreScene: () => storeScene, getStoreRoom: () => storeRoom,
    STORES, STORE_INVS, VIS_OF,
  };

  window.__finlife3d = {
    initScene, openPhone, closePhone, BUILDINGS,
    // dev/test hooks â€” handy for debugging viewpoint and screenshotting
    _getPlayer: () => player,
    _getScene:  () => scene,
    _getCamera: () => camera,
    _getBuildings: () => buildings3d,
    _getStores: () => STORES,
    _enterStore: enterStore,
    _exitStore: exitStore,
    _isInStore: () => inStore,
  };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#0f1f0f;--bg2:#1a2e1a;--bg3:#243824;--bg4:#2e4a2e;
  --gold:#ffd700;--gold-dim:#b89b00;--gold-glow:rgba(255,215,0,.18);
  --green:#00c853;--green-dim:#00843a;--red:#ff3d3d;--red-dim:#a01010;
  --blue:#4fc3f7;--purple:#ce93d8;--orange:#ffa726;--teal:#26c6da;
  --white:#f0f4f0;--muted:#7a9a7a;--border:#2e4a2e;--border-gold:rgba(255,215,0,.35);
  --radius:10px;--radius-sm:6px;--shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);--t:.18s ease;
}
html,body{height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;overflow:hidden}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px}

/* â”€â”€ SCREENS â”€â”€ */
.screen{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10}
.screen.active{display:flex}

/* â”€â”€ NEW GAME â”€â”€ */
#screen-new{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#1e3a1e 0%,var(--bg) 70%);padding:24px;overflow-y:auto}
.ng-card{width:100%;max-width:460px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);
  border-radius:18px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow),0 0 60px rgba(255,215,0,.06);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.ng-logo{text-align:center}
.ng-logo .logo-ico{font-size:48px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.ng-logo h1{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,215,0,.4)}
.ng-logo p{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}
.fg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.fg label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px}
.fg input,.fg select{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  color:var(--white);padding:9px 13px;font-size:14px;outline:none;transition:border-color var(--t);width:100%}
.fg input:focus,.fg select:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.fg select option{background:var(--bg3)}
.sc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.sc-card{background:var(--bg3);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px 8px;
  text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);user-select:none}
.sc-card:hover{background:var(--bg4);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sc-card.sel{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.08))}
.sc-card .ico{font-size:24px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.sc-card .nm{font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.sc-card .dc{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}
.sc-card .mn{color:var(--green);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.btn-start{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a5a2a,#3d8c3d);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--gold);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;padding:13px;
  cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.5px;transition:all var(--t);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,.1)}
.btn-start:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3d8c3d,#4fa04f);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,.2);transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* â”€â”€ GAME SCREEN â”€â”€ */
#screen-game{flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden}

/* Stats Bar */
#stats-bar{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);padding:8px 14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
#char-summary{min-width:100px}
#char-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:130px}
#char-age-job{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.sdiv{width:1px;height:32px;background:var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
#stat-bars{display:flex;gap:12px;flex:1;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.si{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:72px}
.sl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.sb{height:5px;background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sbf{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s}
.sbf.health{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green-dim),var(--green))}
.sbf.happy{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f5720a,var(--orange))}
.sbf.smarts{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1976d2,var(--blue))}
.sv{font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
#nw-display{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;flex-shrink:0}
#nw-label{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
#nw-value{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;transition:color .3s}
#nw-value.pos{color:var(--green)}
#nw-value.neg{color:var(--red)}
#nw-delta{font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
#nw-delta.pos{color:var(--green)}
#nw-delta.neg{color:var(--red)}

/* Game Body */
#game-body{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden}

/* Left Panel - Tabs */
#left-panel{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.tabs{display:flex;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--white);background:var(--bg3)}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--gold);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.tab-content{display:none;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px}
.tab-content.active{display:block}

/* Right Panel - Actions */
#right-panel{width:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
.actions-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:10px}
.act-btn{padding:10px 6px;background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:var(--white);user-select:none}
.act-btn .aico{font-size:18px}
.act-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.act-btn.age{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);grid-column:1/-1;padding:12px}
.act-btn.age:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.1));box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,.15)}
.act-btn.job{border-color:var(--blue)}
.act-btn.bank{border-color:var(--teal)}
.act-btn.invest{border-color:var(--green)}
.act-btn.realty{border-color:var(--orange)}
.act-btn.crypto{border-color:var(--purple)}
.act-btn.hustle{border-color:#80cbc4}
.act-btn.edu{border-color:#ef9a9a}
.act-btn.biz{border-color:#ffb74d}
.act-btn.sponsors{border-color:#f48fb1;color:#f48fb1}
.act-btn.sponsors:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(244,143,177,.1))}
.act-btn.fitness{border-color:#81c784;color:#81c784}
.act-btn.fitness:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(129,199,132,.1))}
.act-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}

/* Chart Area */
#chart-area{flex-shrink:0;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#chart-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
#nw-chart{width:100%;height:80px;display:block}

/* Timeline */
#timeline{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#timeline-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.tl-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tl-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:5px}
.tl-dot.good{background:var(--green)}.tl-dot.bad{background:var(--red)}.tl-dot.info{background:var(--blue)}.tl-dot.gold{background:var(--gold)}
.tl-age{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);flex-shrink:0;min-width:22px}
.tl-text{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}

/* â”€â”€ INBOX (inside actions area) â”€â”€ */
.act-btn.inbox{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.act-btn.inbox:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.08))}
.inbox-badge-btn{position:absolute;top:4px;right:6px;min-width:18px;height:16px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:0 5px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.inbox-badge-btn.show{display:flex}
.inbox-dots{position:absolute;top:4px;right:6px;display:flex;gap:3px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.inbox-dot{min-width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.inbox-dot.show{display:flex}
.inbox-dot.red{background:#c44}
.inbox-dot.blue{background:#3a7bd0}
.inbox-dot.orange{background:#d68a3a}
.inbox-item{padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);background:var(--bg2);text-align:left}
.inbox-item:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dim)}
.inbox-item.unread{border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.inbox-item.read{opacity:.55}
.inbox-item.bill{border-left-color:var(--orange)}
.inbox-item.news{border-left-color:var(--blue)}
.ii-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:3px}
.ii-date{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.ii-subject{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}
.ii-preview{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* Tab Panels Content */
.section{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.section h3{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.info-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.info-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ir-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ir-value{font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.ir-value.pos{color:var(--green)}.ir-value.neg{color:var(--red)}.ir-value.gold{color:var(--gold)}

/* Credit Score Arc */
.cs-wrap{text-align:center}
#credit-canvas{width:120px;height:70px}
.cs-score{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.cs-grade{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}

/* Stock Table */
.stock-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.stock-table th{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;padding:3px 5px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.stock-table td{padding:4px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.stock-table tr:last-child td{border:none}
.chg-pos{color:var(--green)}.chg-neg{color:var(--red)}

/* Crypto grid */
.crypto-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.crypto-card{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:8px}
.cc-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--purple)}
.cc-price{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.cc-hold{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}

/* Progress bars */
.prog-wrap{background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px;height:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}
.prog-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s}
.prog-fill.green{background:var(--green)}.prog-fill.blue{background:var(--blue)}.prog-fill.gold{background:var(--gold)}.prog-fill.purple{background:var(--purple)}

/* Cash flow bar */
.cf-bar-wrap{height:12px;background:var(--bg4);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0;position:relative}
.cf-fill{height:100%;border-radius:6px;transition:width .4s;position:absolute;left:0}
.cf-fill.pos{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green-dim),var(--green))}
.cf-fill.neg{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red-dim),var(--red))}

/* â”€â”€ MODAL â”€â”€ */
#modal-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
#modal-overlay.open{display:flex}
#modal-box{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:18px;
  max-width:460px;width:100%;padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow),0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,.08);
  animation:scaleIn .2s ease;position:relative;max-height:92vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  overflow:hidden}
/* When viewport is cramped, constrain to a square so the player doesn't chase a tall modal */
@media (max-height:720px){
  #modal-box{max-width:min(92vh,460px)}
}
#modal-close-x{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,61,61,.12);color:var(--red);border:1.5px solid var(--red);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;z-index:20;
  font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:0;transition:all var(--t)}
#modal-close-x:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
#modal-box > .modal-choices{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto;min-height:0}
#modal-box > .modal-body{flex:0 0 auto}
@keyframes scaleIn{from{transform:scale(.9);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.modal-icon{font-size:36px;text-align:center;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.modal-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.modal-tag.opp{background:rgba(0,200,83,.2);color:var(--green)}
.modal-tag.dis{background:rgba(255,61,61,.2);color:var(--red)}
.modal-tag.mil{background:rgba(255,215,0,.2);color:var(--gold)}
.modal-tag.fla{background:rgba(79,195,247,.2);color:var(--blue)}
.modal-tag.exp{background:rgba(255,167,38,.2);color:var(--orange)}
.modal-tag.tip{background:rgba(206,147,216,.2);color:var(--purple)}
.modal-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px;text-align:center}
.modal-body{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px;text-align:center}
.modal-result{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.modal-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.choice-btn{padding:11px 16px;background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  color:var(--white);cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:left}
.choice-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--bg4);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* â”€â”€ ASSET GRID MODAL (stocks / crypto) â”€â”€ */
#modal-box.wide{max-width:860px}
#modal-box.compact{max-width:380px;padding:20px 18px}
#modal-box.compact .modal-body{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
#modal-box.compact .modal-choices{max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
#modal-box.compact .choice-btn{padding:8px 12px;font-size:11.5px}
.asset-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;max-height:62vh;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
.asset-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.asset-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dim)}
.ac-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}
.ac-name{font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.ac-ticker{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px}
.ac-price{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold)}
.ac-chg{font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.ac-chg.pos{color:var(--green)} .ac-chg.neg{color:var(--red)}
.ac-chart{width:100%;height:50px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;display:block}
.ac-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.ac-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:2px;align-items:stretch}
.ac-buy-input{width:70px;padding:6px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--white);text-align:right;-moz-appearance:textfield}
.ac-buy-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.ac-buy-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.ac-buy-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green)}
.ac-btn{flex:1;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--white);transition:all var(--t)}
.ac-btn.buy{border-color:rgba(0,200,83,.4);color:var(--green)}
.ac-btn.buy:hover{background:rgba(0,200,83,.15)}
.ac-btn.sell{border-color:rgba(255,61,61,.4);color:var(--red)}
.ac-btn.sell:hover{background:rgba(255,61,61,.15)}
.ac-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:not-allowed}
@media(max-width:700px){.asset-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* â”€â”€ GAME OVER â”€â”€ */
#screen-gameover{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#3a1a1a 0%,var(--bg) 70%);padding:24px;overflow-y:auto}
.go-card{width:100%;max-width:500px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid rgba(255,61,61,.3);
  border-radius:18px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;text-align:center}
.go-card h1{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red)}
.go-card .go-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.go-nw{font-size:40px;font-weight:800;margin:8px 0}
.go-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;text-align:left}
.go-stat{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px}
.go-stat .gs-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.go-stat .gs-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.go-achieve{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;text-align:left}
.go-achieve h3{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.ach-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:3px 0;font-size:12px}
.btn-retry{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red-dim),#c62828);border:1.5px solid var(--red);
  border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--white);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t)}
.btn-retry:hover{opacity:.85;transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* â”€â”€ TOAST â”€â”€ */
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:30px;padding:8px 20px;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;z-index:200;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s;opacity:0;white-space:nowrap}
#toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);opacity:1}

/* Mobile */
@media(max-width:680px){
  #game-body{flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
  #left-panel{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
  #right-panel{width:100%;flex:0 0 auto;max-height:52vh;overflow-y:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--border-gold)}
  #right-panel #chart-area,#right-panel #timeline{display:none}
  .actions-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;padding:8px}
  .act-btn{padding:10px 4px;font-size:11px;min-height:60px}
  .act-btn .aico{font-size:20px}
  .act-btn.age{grid-column:1/-1;padding:14px;min-height:52px}
  #stats-bar{padding:6px 10px;gap:8px}
  #char-name{font-size:12px;max-width:110px}
  #stat-bars{gap:8px}
  .si{min-width:56px}

function triggerDownside(c){
  const d = pick(DOWNSIDES);
  const rawCost = d.apply(c);
  const bank = c.bankId ? BANKS.find(b=>b.id===c.bankId) : null;
  const covFrac = bank ? (bank.covers[d.cat] || 0) : 0;
  const refund = Math.round(rawCost * covFrac);
  const netCost = rawCost - refund;
  c.checking -= netCost;
  const date = currentMonthDate(c);
  let body = `Amount: ${fmt$(rawCost)}\n`;
  if(refund > 0){
    body += `${bank.icon} ${bank.name} insurance covered ${fmt$(refund)} (${Math.round(covFrac*100)}%)\n`;
    body += `Out of pocket: ${fmt$(netCost)}\nStatus: Paid from checking\n\n${d.body}`;
  } else {
    if(bank) body += `${bank.icon} ${bank.name}: no coverage for ${d.cat} on your plan.\n`;
    body += `Status: Paid from checking\n\n${d.body}`;
  }
  addInboxItem({
    type:'bill', icon:d.icon, subject:`${d.subject} â€” ${fmt$(netCost)}`, date, body,

  logEvent(`${d.icon} ${d.subject}: -${fmt$(netCost)}${refund>0?` (insurance -${fmt$(refund)})`:''}`, 'bad');
}

function bankById(id){ return BANKS.find(b=>b.id===id) || null; }

function joinBank(c, bankId){
  const b = bankById(bankId);
  if(!b) return 'Bank not found.';
  const prev = c.bankId ? bankById(c.bankId) : null;
  // Switching fee
  if(prev && prev.id !== b.id){
    const fee = 50;
    if(c.checking < fee) return `Need ${fmt$(fee)} to close your ${prev.name} account.`;
    c.checking -= fee;
  }
  c.bankId = b.id;
  c.bankTenureMonths = 0;
  c.checking += b.signupBonus;
  const date = currentMonthDate(c);
  const covList = Object.entries(b.covers).map(([k,v])=>`  â€¢ ${k.padEnd(10,' ')} ${Math.round(v*100)}% coverage`).join('\n');
  addInboxItem({
    type:'news', icon:b.icon, subject:`Welcome to ${b.name}`, date,
    body:`${b.blurb}\n\nSignup bonus: +${fmt$(b.signupBonus)}\nMonthly fee: ${fmt$(b.fee)}\nAPY bonus on high-yield: +${b.apyBonus.toFixed(1)}%\n\nâ”€â”€ Insurance Coverage â”€â”€\n${covList||'  (none)'}\n\n${prev?`Previous bank (${prev.name}) closed. -${fmt$(50)} closing fee.`:'Welcome aboard.'}`
  });
  return `Joined ${b.name}. +${fmt$(b.signupBonus)} signup bonus credited.`;
}

}

// Auto-classify inbox items into a section ('opportunities' for offers/promos/raises/wins;
// 'bills_news' for everything else) and a priority color (red emergency, blue big offer, orange regular).
const INBOX_RED_RX  = /injury|hospital|hospitalized|lawsuit|sued|fine|penalty|relegat|fired|laid ?off|emergency|approval ratings collapse|robbery|burglary|crash|attack|assault|passed away|died|death|funeral|critical|cancer|surgery required|complications|bankrupt|foreclos|repossess|tornado|hurricane|earthquake|flood|fire damage|injured|broke|broken bone|fracture|concussion|defect|recall/i;
const INBOX_BLUE_RX = /\boffer\b|signed|signing|contract|raise|promotion|promoted|award|hall of fame|championship|brand deal|sponsorship|deal|bonus|won the lottery|callup|drafted|callback|book deal|nomination|grant|investment offer|equity|partnership offer|buyout/i;
const INBOX_OPP_RX  = /\boffer\b|signed|signing|contract|raise|promotion|promoted|brand deal|sponsorship|callup|drafted|bonus|book deal|investment offer|partnership offer|buyout|equity/i;

function classifyInboxItem(item){
  const subj = (item.subject||'') + ' ' + (item.body||'').slice(0,200);
  // Priority â€” explicit override wins
  let priority = item.priority;
  if(!priority){
    if(item.type === 'offer' && /raise|signing/i.test(subj)) priority = 'blue';
    else if(item.type === 'offer') priority = 'blue';
    else if(INBOX_RED_RX.test(subj)) priority = 'red';
    else if(INBOX_BLUE_RX.test(subj)) priority = 'blue';
    else priority = 'orange';
  }
  // Section
  let section = item.section;
  if(!section){
    section = (item.type === 'offer' || INBOX_OPP_RX.test(subj)) ? 'opportunities' : 'bills_news';
  }
  return { priority, section };
}

function addInboxItem(item){
  if(!GS.inbox) GS.inbox=[];
  const { priority, section } = classifyInboxItem(item);
  GS.inbox.unshift({id:`ib_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, read:false, priority, section, ...item});
  if(GS.inbox.length>40) GS.inbox.length=40;
}

function getInboxPrefs(){
  if(!GS.inboxPrefs) GS.inboxPrefs = { showRed: true, showBlue: true, showOrange: true };
  return GS.inboxPrefs;
}

function renderInbox(){
  const items = GS.inbox||[];
  const prefs = getInboxPrefs();
  const counts = { red:0, blue:0, orange:0 };
  // Dot counts are based on dotSeen, not read â€” opening the inbox clears the dots
  // while per-item unread state still shows in the modal until the player taps each one.
  for(const i of items){ if(!i.dotSeen){ const p = i.priority || classifyInboxItem(i).priority; if(counts[p] !== undefined) counts[p]++; } }
  for(const color of ['red','blue','orange']){
    const el = $('ibd-'+color);
    if(!el) continue;
    const enabled = prefs['show'+color.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+color.slice(1)];
    const show = enabled && counts[color] > 0;
    el.textContent = counts[color];
    el.className = 'inbox-dot '+color+(show?' show':'');
  }
}

function toggleInboxPref(color){
  const prefs = getInboxPrefs();
  const key = 'show'+color.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+color.slice(1);
  prefs[key] = !prefs[key];
  renderInbox();
  showInboxModal(_inboxSection || 'bills_news');
}

  const tier = EQUIPMENT_TIERS.find(e=>e.tier===(b.equipTier||1)) || EQUIPMENT_TIERS[0];
  const age = b.equipAge||0;
  // Old equipment: age > 5 years OR tier 1 + age > 2 years
  const old = age >= 6 || (tier.tier===1 && age>=3) || (tier.tier===2 && age>=5);
  const next = EQUIPMENT_TIERS.find(e=>e.tier===tier.tier+1) || null;
  return {tier, age, old, next};
}

  if(n===undefined||n===null) return '$0';
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const sign = n<0?'-':'';
  if(abs>=1e9) return sign+'$'+(abs/1e9).toFixed(1)+'B';
  if(abs>=1e6) return sign+'$'+(abs/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M';
  if(abs>=1e3) return sign+'$'+Math.round(abs/100)/10+'k';
  return sign+'$'+Math.round(abs).toLocaleString();
};

    _graduated:scenario!=='broke', _hadFirstJob:false, _everMarried:false,
    events:[],
    pendingExpenses:[],  // [{name, icon, cost, monthsLeft}]
    belongings:[],       // [{id, name, icon, cost, purchasedAt}]
    bankId:null, bankTenureMonths:0, _bankFeeWaivedMonth:-1,
  };
}

function ageDisplay(char){
  const m = char.monthAge % 12;
  return m===0 ? `${char.age}` : `${char.age}y ${m}m`;
}

function eduIdx(e){return EDU_LEVELS.indexOf(e)}

function computeSalary(char, tier){
  const [mn,mx] = EDU_SALARY[char.education]||[28000,55000];
  const base = rf(mn,mx);
  const sm = 0.5+(char.smarts/100);
  return Math.round(base*tier.salScale*sm);
}

function getJobTier(char){
  const eidx = eduIdx(char.education);
  if(eidx>=5) return CAREER_TIERS[3]; // doctoral+
  if(eidx>=3) return CAREER_TIERS[2]; // bachelors
  if(eidx>=2) return CAREER_TIERS[1]; // associates
  return CAREER_TIERS[0];
}

function tickCareer(char, ev){
  if(char.inSchool||!char.employed) return;
  char.yearsAtJob++;
  const raise = 0.01+(char.smarts/100)*0.02+(char.performance/100)*0.02;
  char.salary = Math.round(char.salary*(1+raise));
  // Promotion check
  const tIdx = CAREER_TIERS.findIndex(t=>t.id===char.careerTierId);
  const tier = CAREER_TIERS[tIdx];
  if(tIdx<CAREER_TIERS.length-1 && char.yearsAtJob>=tier.promYrs){
    if(pct(0.15+(char.performance/100)*0.35)){
      const next = CAREER_TIERS[tIdx+1];
      char.careerTierId = next.id;
      char.jobTitle = pick(next.title);
      char.salary = computeSalary(char, next);
      char.yearsAtJob = 0;
      ev.push({type:'career',text:`Promoted to ${char.jobTitle}! Salary: ${fmt$(char.salary)}/yr`});
    }
  }
  char.performance = clamp(char.performance+ri(-5,5),10,100);
  if(pct(0.03+(char.performance<30?0.1:0))){
    char.employed=false; char.salary=0; char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-15,0,100);
    ev.push({type:'career',text:'Laid off. Job lost.'});
  }
}

function getAvailableJobs(char){
  const charEdu = eduIdx(char.education);
  return ALL_JOBS
    .filter(j => charEdu >= eduIdx(j.edu))
    .sort((a,b) => b.min - a.min)
    .slice(0,8);
}

const ENV_JOB_IDS = new Set(['farmer','rancher','landscaper','gardener','arborist','env_scientist','conservationist','wildlife_biologist','park_ranger','zookeeper','marine_biologist','soil_scientist','hydrologist','forester','solar_installer']);
const JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER = ['healthcare','tech','trades','education','law','finance','creative','service','transport','environment','sports'];
function jobCategory(j){
  if(ENV_JOB_IDS.has(j.id)) return 'environment';
  return j.sector;
}
function getBalancedJobChoices(char){
  const charEdu = eduIdx(char.education);
  const eligible = ALL_JOBS.filter(j => charEdu >= eduIdx(j.edu));
  const byCat = {};
  JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER.forEach(c => byCat[c] = []);
  eligible.forEach(j => { const c = jobCategory(j); if(byCat[c]) byCat[c].push(j); });
  const shuffle = arr => { const a = arr.slice(); for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const k=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [a[i],a[k]]=[a[k],a[i]]; } return a; };
  const picked = [];
  const usedIds = new Set();
  // Guarantee one from each category if available
  shuffle(JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER).forEach(cat => {
    const pool = shuffle(byCat[cat]);
    if(pool.length){ picked.push(pool[0]); usedIds.add(pool[0].id); }
  });
  // Fill up to 14 with random eligible extras for variety
  const extras = shuffle(eligible.filter(j => !usedIds.has(j.id)));
  while(picked.length < 14 && extras.length) picked.push(extras.shift());
  return shuffle(picked);
}

function applyForJob(char, job){
  const smartsMod = 0.7 + (char.smarts/100)*0.6;
  char.employed     = true;
  char.jobId        = job.id;
  char.jobTitle     = job.name;
  char.jobSector    = job.sector;
  char.jobMin       = job.min;
  char.jobMax       = job.max;
  char.sportsTeam   = null;
  char.salary       = Math.round(rf(job.min, job.max) * smartsMod);
  char.yearsAtJob   = 0;

  char.careerTierId = 'tier' + job.tier;
  char.bossName     = pick(['Alex Mercer','Jordan Hayes','Taylor Quinn','Morgan Vance','Dana Rhodes','Sam Whitaker','Casey Lin','Riley Okafor']);
  char.bossMorale   = ri(55,75);
}

function buildJobChoices(char){
  const jobs = getBalancedJobChoices(char);

    return [{text:'No jobs available â€” get more education',fn(){return'No qualifying jobs found. Consider furthering your education.'}}];
  }
  return jobs.map(job => ({
    text:`${job.name} (${job.sector}) â€” ${fmt$(job.min)}â€“${fmt$(job.max)}/yr`,
    fn(){
      applyForJob(char, job);
      return `Hired as ${job.name} in ${job.sector}! Starting salary: ${fmt$(char.salary)}/yr`;
    }
  }));
}

function tickRelationship(char, ev){
  const r = char.relationship;
  if(r==='single'&&char.age>=18){
    if(pct(0.12+(char.looks/100)*0.12)){
      char.relationship='dating'; char.spouseName=genName(); char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.spouseIncome=ri(25000,90000);
      ev.push({type:'good',text:`Started dating ${char.spouseName}.`});
    }
  } else if(r==='dating'){
    char.yearsTogether++;
    if(char.age>=21&&pct(Math.min(0.05+char.yearsTogether*0.07,0.5))){
      char.relationship='married';
      ev.push({type:'gold',text:`Married ${char.spouseName}!`});
    } else if(pct(Math.max(0.08-char.yearsTogether*0.01,0.02))){
      const n=char.spouseName; char.relationship='single'; char.spouseName=null; char.spouseIncome=0; char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-10,0,100);
      ev.push({type:'bad',text:`Broke up with ${n}.`});
    }
  } else if(r==='married'){
    char.yearsTogether++;
    char.spouseIncome=Math.round(char.spouseIncome*(1+rf(0.01,0.03)));
    const dChance = char.yearsTogether<5?0.04:char.yearsTogether<15?0.02:0.01;
    if(pct(dChance+(50-char.happiness)/500)){
      const n=char.spouseName; const settle=Math.round(char.checking*0.3);
      char.checking=Math.max(0,char.checking-settle); char.relationship='divorced';
      char.spouseName=null; char.spouseIncome=0; char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-20,0,100);
      ev.push({type:'bad',text:`Divorced ${n}. Settlement: ${fmt$(settle)}`});
    }
  } else if(r==='divorced'&&char.age<75){
    if(pct(0.1)){char.relationship='dating';char.spouseName=genName();char.yearsTogether=0;char.spouseIncome=ri(20000,80000);}
  }
}

function calcTax(income){
  const brackets=[[11600,0.10],[47150,0.12],[100525,0.22],[191950,0.24],[243725,0.32],[609350,0.35],[Infinity,0.37]];
  let tax=0,prev=0;
  for(const[lim,rate]of brackets){const s=Math.min(income,lim)-prev;if(s<=0)break;tax+=s*rate;prev=lim;}
  return Math.round(tax+income*0.05+Math.min(income,168600)*0.0765);
}

function tickFinances(char, ev){
  // All figures monthly, returned annualized for UI display
  const monthSalary = char.employed ? Math.round(char.salary/12) : 0;
  const monthSide = Math.round((char.sideHustleIncome||0)/12);
  const monthSpouse = char.relationship==='married' ? Math.round(char.spouseIncome*0.5/12) : 0;
  const monthGross = monthSalary + monthSide + monthSpouse;
  const monthTax = Math.round(calcTax(monthGross*12)/12);
  const monthNet = monthGross - monthTax;
  const expTable = {frugal:1500,normal:2333,lavish:3750};
  const livedInProp = (GS.inv&&GS.inv.properties||[]).find(p=>p.livedIn);
  // If living in own property: pay mortgage instead of rent-equivalent (~$1200 of exp), plus upkeep
  const housingAdj = livedInProp ? (livedInProp.monthlyPayment + 300 - 1200) : 0;
  const vehicleCost = vehicleMonthlyCost(GS.inv||{vehicles:[]});
  const monthLiving = (expTable[char.lifestyle]||2333) + Math.round(char.kids*15000/12) + housingAdj + vehicleCost;
  // Monthly debt interest + minimum payment
  if(char.debt>0){
    const interest = Math.round(char.debt*0.05/12);
    const pay = Math.max(50, Math.min(char.debt, Math.round(char.debt*0.01)+interest));
    char.debt = Math.max(0, char.debt+interest-pay);
  }
  // Bank monthly maintenance fee (after fee waiver check)
  if(char.bankId){
    const bk = bankById(char.bankId);
    const waivedThisMonth = char._bankFeeWaivedMonth === char.monthAge;
    if(bk && !waivedThisMonth){
      char.checking -= bk.fee;
    }
    char.bankTenureMonths = (char.bankTenureMonths||0) + 1;
  }
  const monthSavings = monthNet - monthLiving;
  char.checking += monthSavings;
  // Monthly compound interest on savings
  char.savings = Math.round(char.savings*(1+0.02/12));
  // High-yield: base 4% + optional bank APY bonus
  const apyBonus = char.bankId ? (bankById(char.bankId)?.apyBonus || 0) : 0;
  char.highYield = Math.round(char.highYield*(1+(0.04+apyBonus/100)/12));
  // Credit score: drift quarterly
  if(char.monthAge%3===0){
    if(char.debt>0&&char.checking>0) char.creditScore=clamp(char.creditScore+ri(-1,2),300,850);
    else if(char.debt===0) char.creditScore=clamp(char.creditScore+ri(0,2),300,850);
  }
  return {gross:monthGross*12, taxes:monthTax*12, livingCost:monthLiving*12, debtPay:char.debt>0?Math.round(char.debt*0.12):0, annSavings:monthSavings*12};
}

function tickDeath(char){
  // Annual probabilities divided by 12 for monthly check
  let base;
  if(char.age<40)base=0.003/12;
  else if(char.age<50)base=0.007/12;
  else if(char.age<60)base=0.015/12;
  else if(char.age<70)base=0.03/12;
  else if(char.age<80)base=0.07/12;
  else if(char.age<90)base=0.15/12;
  else base=0.30/12;
  const hm=1.0+(50-char.health)/100;
  if(pct(Math.min(base*hm,0.95))){
    char.alive=false;
    char.deathCause=char.age>=75?'Old Age':pick(DEATH_CAUSES);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function tickSchool(char, ev){
  if(!char.inSchool)return;
  char.checking-=char.schoolCostMonthly;
  char.debt+=char.schoolCostMonthly;
  char.schoolMonthsLeft--;
  if(char.schoolMonthsLeft<=0){
    const def=SCHOOL_DEFS[char.schoolType];
    char.inSchool=false; char.education=def.result;
    char.smarts=clamp(char.smarts+ri(5,15),0,100);
    ev.push({type:'gold',text:`Graduated with ${EDU_LABELS[def.result]}!`});
  }
}
