.fg input:focus,.fg select:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.fg select option{background:var(--bg3)}
.sc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.sc-card{background:var(--bg3);border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px 8px;
  text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);user-select:none}
.sc-card:hover{background:var(--bg4);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sc-card.sel{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.08))}
.sc-card .ico{font-size:24px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.sc-card .nm{font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.sc-card .dc{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}
.sc-card .mn{color:var(--green);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.btn-start{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a5a2a,#3d8c3d);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--gold);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;padding:13px;
  cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.5px;transition:all var(--t);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,.1)}
.btn-start:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3d8c3d,#4fa04f);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,.2);transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* â”€â”€ GAME SCREEN â”€â”€ */
#screen-game{flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden}

/* Stats Bar */
#stats-bar{background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);padding:8px 14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
#char-summary{min-width:100px}
#char-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:130px}
#char-age-job{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.sdiv{width:1px;height:32px;background:var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
#stat-bars{display:flex;gap:12px;flex:1;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.si{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:72px}
.sl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.sb{height:5px;background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sbf{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s}
.sbf.health{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green-dim),var(--green))}
.sbf.happy{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f5720a,var(--orange))}
.sbf.smarts{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1976d2,var(--blue))}
.sv{font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
#nw-display{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;flex-shrink:0}
#nw-label{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
#nw-value{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;transition:color .3s}
#nw-value.pos{color:var(--green)}
#nw-value.neg{color:var(--red)}
#nw-delta{font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
#nw-delta.pos{color:var(--green)}
#nw-delta.neg{color:var(--red)}

/* Game Body */
#game-body{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden}

/* Left Panel - Tabs */
#left-panel{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.tabs{display:flex;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--white);background:var(--bg3)}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--gold);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.tab-content{display:none;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px}
.tab-content.active{display:block}

/* Right Panel - Actions */
#right-panel{width:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
.actions-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:10px}
.act-btn{padding:10px 6px;background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:var(--white);user-select:none}
.act-btn .aico{font-size:18px}
.act-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.act-btn.age{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);grid-column:1/-1;padding:12px}
.act-btn.age:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.1));box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,.15)}
.act-btn.job{border-color:var(--blue)}
.act-btn.bank{border-color:var(--teal)}
.act-btn.invest{border-color:var(--green)}
.act-btn.realty{border-color:var(--orange)}
.act-btn.crypto{border-color:var(--purple)}
.act-btn.hustle{border-color:#80cbc4}
.act-btn.edu{border-color:#ef9a9a}
.act-btn.biz{border-color:#ffb74d}
.act-btn.sponsors{border-color:#f48fb1;color:#f48fb1}
.act-btn.sponsors:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(244,143,177,.1))}
.act-btn.fitness{border-color:#81c784;color:#81c784}
.act-btn.fitness:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(129,199,132,.1))}
.act-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}

/* Chart Area */
#chart-area{flex-shrink:0;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#chart-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
#nw-chart{width:100%;height:80px;display:block}

/* Timeline */
#timeline{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
#timeline-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.tl-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tl-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:5px}
.tl-dot.good{background:var(--green)}.tl-dot.bad{background:var(--red)}.tl-dot.info{background:var(--blue)}.tl-dot.gold{background:var(--gold)}
.tl-age{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);flex-shrink:0;min-width:22px}
.tl-text{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}

/* â”€â”€ INBOX (inside actions area) â”€â”€ */
.act-btn.inbox{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.act-btn.inbox:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(255,215,0,.08))}
.inbox-badge-btn{position:absolute;top:4px;right:6px;min-width:18px;height:16px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:0 5px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.inbox-badge-btn.show{display:flex}
.inbox-dots{position:absolute;top:4px;right:6px;display:flex;gap:3px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.inbox-dot{min-width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.inbox-dot.show{display:flex}
.inbox-dot.red{background:#c44}
.inbox-dot.blue{background:#3a7bd0}
.inbox-dot.orange{background:#d68a3a}
.inbox-item{padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);background:var(--bg2);text-align:left}
.inbox-item:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dim)}
.inbox-item.unread{border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.inbox-item.read{opacity:.55}
.inbox-item.bill{border-left-color:var(--orange)}
.inbox-item.news{border-left-color:var(--blue)}
.ii-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:3px}
.ii-date{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.ii-subject{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}
.ii-preview{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* Tab Panels Content */
.section{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.section h3{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.info-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.info-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ir-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ir-value{font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.ir-value.pos{color:var(--green)}.ir-value.neg{color:var(--red)}.ir-value.gold{color:var(--gold)}

/* Credit Score Arc */
.cs-wrap{text-align:center}
#credit-canvas{width:120px;height:70px}
.cs-score{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.cs-grade{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}

/* Stock Table */
.stock-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.stock-table th{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;padding:3px 5px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.stock-table td{padding:4px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.stock-table tr:last-child td{border:none}
.chg-pos{color:var(--green)}.chg-neg{color:var(--red)}

/* Crypto grid */
.crypto-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.crypto-card{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:8px}
.cc-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--purple)}
.cc-price{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.cc-hold{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}

/* Progress bars */
.prog-wrap{background:var(--bg4);border-radius:3px;height:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}
.prog-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s}
.prog-fill.green{background:var(--green)}.prog-fill.blue{background:var(--blue)}.prog-fill.gold{background:var(--gold)}.prog-fill.purple{background:var(--purple)}

/* Cash flow bar */
.cf-bar-wrap{height:12px;background:var(--bg4);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0;position:relative}
.cf-fill{height:100%;border-radius:6px;transition:width .4s;position:absolute;left:0}
.cf-fill.pos{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green-dim),var(--green))}
.cf-fill.neg{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red-dim),var(--red))}

/* â”€â”€ MODAL â”€â”€ */
#modal-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
#modal-overlay.open{display:flex}
#modal-box{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:18px;
  max-width:460px;width:100%;padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow),0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,.08);
  animation:scaleIn .2s ease;position:relative;max-height:92vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  overflow:hidden}
/* When viewport is cramped, constrain to a square so the player doesn't chase a tall modal */
@media (max-height:720px){
  #modal-box{max-width:min(92vh,460px)}
}
#modal-close-x{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,61,61,.12);color:var(--red);border:1.5px solid var(--red);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;z-index:20;
  font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:0;transition:all var(--t)}
#modal-close-x:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
#modal-box > .modal-choices{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto;min-height:0}
#modal-box > .modal-body{flex:0 0 auto}
@keyframes scaleIn{from{transform:scale(.9);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.modal-icon{font-size:36px;text-align:center;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.modal-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.modal-tag.opp{background:rgba(0,200,83,.2);color:var(--green)}
.modal-tag.dis{background:rgba(255,61,61,.2);color:var(--red)}
.modal-tag.mil{background:rgba(255,215,0,.2);color:var(--gold)}
.modal-tag.fla{background:rgba(79,195,247,.2);color:var(--blue)}
.modal-tag.exp{background:rgba(255,167,38,.2);color:var(--orange)}
.modal-tag.tip{background:rgba(206,147,216,.2);color:var(--purple)}
.modal-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px;text-align:center}
.modal-body{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px;text-align:center}
.modal-result{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.modal-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.choice-btn{padding:11px 16px;background:var(--bg3);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  color:var(--white);cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:left}
.choice-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--bg4);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* â”€â”€ ASSET GRID MODAL (stocks / crypto) â”€â”€ */
#modal-box.wide{max-width:860px}
#modal-box.compact{max-width:380px;padding:20px 18px}
#modal-box.compact .modal-body{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
#modal-box.compact .modal-choices{max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
#modal-box.compact .choice-btn{padding:8px 12px;font-size:11.5px}
.asset-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;max-height:62vh;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
.asset-card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.asset-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-dim)}
.ac-hdr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}
.ac-name{font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.ac-ticker{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px}
.ac-price{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold)}
.ac-chg{font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.ac-chg.pos{color:var(--green)} .ac-chg.neg{color:var(--red)}
.ac-chart{width:100%;height:50px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;display:block}
.ac-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.ac-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:2px;align-items:stretch}
.ac-buy-input{width:70px;padding:6px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--white);text-align:right;-moz-appearance:textfield}
.ac-buy-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.ac-buy-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.ac-buy-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green)}
.ac-btn{flex:1;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--white);transition:all var(--t)}
.ac-btn.buy{border-color:rgba(0,200,83,.4);color:var(--green)}
.ac-btn.buy:hover{background:rgba(0,200,83,.15)}
.ac-btn.sell{border-color:rgba(255,61,61,.4);color:var(--red)}
.ac-btn.sell:hover{background:rgba(255,61,61,.15)}
.ac-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:not-allowed}
@media(max-width:700px){.asset-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* â”€â”€ GAME OVER â”€â”€ */
#screen-gameover{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#3a1a1a 0%,var(--bg) 70%);padding:24px;overflow-y:auto}
.go-card{width:100%;max-width:500px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid rgba(255,61,61,.3);
  border-radius:18px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;text-align:center}
.go-card h1{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red)}
.go-card .go-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.go-nw{font-size:40px;font-weight:800;margin:8px 0}
.go-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;text-align:left}
.go-stat{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px}
.go-stat .gs-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.go-stat .gs-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.go-achieve{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;text-align:left}
.go-achieve h3{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.ach-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:3px 0;font-size:12px}
.btn-retry{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red-dim),#c62828);border:1.5px solid var(--red);
  border-radius:var(--radius);color:var(--white);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t)}
.btn-retry:hover{opacity:.85;transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* â”€â”€ TOAST â”€â”€ */
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:30px;padding:8px 20px;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;z-index:200;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s;opacity:0;white-space:nowrap}
#toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);opacity:1}

/* Mobile */
@media(max-width:680px){
  #game-body{flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
  #left-panel{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
  #right-panel{width:100%;flex:0 0 auto;max-height:52vh;overflow-y:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--border-gold)}
  #right-panel #chart-area,#right-panel #timeline{display:none}
  .actions-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;padding:8px}
  .act-btn{padding:10px 4px;font-size:11px;min-height:60px}
  .act-btn .aico{font-size:20px}
  .act-btn.age{grid-column:1/-1;padding:14px;min-height:52px}
  #stats-bar{padding:6px 10px;gap:8px}
  #char-name{font-size:12px;max-width:110px}
  #stat-bars{gap:8px}
  .si{min-width:56px}
  .tab-btn{font-size:10px;padding:8px 3px}
  #modal-overlay{padding:10px}
  #modal-box{padding:20px 16px;max-height:94vh;border-radius:14px}
  #modal-box.compact{padding:18px 14px}
  #modal-close-x{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:18px}
  .modal-title{font-size:17px}
  .modal-body{font-size:12.5px}
  .choice-btn{padding:13px 12px;font-size:13px;min-height:46px}
  .ac-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .ac-buy-input{width:100%}
  .ac-btn{min-height:36px}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  .actions-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .act-btn{min-height:64px}
}

/* â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� 3D ISLAND OVERRIDES â•�â•�â•�â•�â•� */
/* Hide the original 2D shell â€” handlers stay live in the DOM */
#screen-game #stats-bar,
#screen-game #left-panel,
#screen-game #right-panel{display:none !important}
#screen-game #game-body{display:block;height:100vh;width:100vw;padding:0;margin:0}

/* Three.js canvas fills the screen */
#world3d{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:1;display:block;background:#87ceeb;cursor:crosshair}

/* In-world HUD */
#hud3d{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif}
#hud-crosshair{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#hud-prompt{position:absolute;bottom:22%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,0);background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);border:2px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.5px;display:none;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000}
#hud-prompt.show{display:block;animation:pulse 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,215,0,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0)}}
#hud-status{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);min-width:200px}

function triggerDownside(c){
  const d = pick(DOWNSIDES);
  const rawCost = d.apply(c);
  const bank = c.bankId ? BANKS.find(b=>b.id===c.bankId) : null;
  const covFrac = bank ? (bank.covers[d.cat] || 0) : 0;
  const refund = Math.round(rawCost * covFrac);
  const netCost = rawCost - refund;
  c.checking -= netCost;
  const date = currentMonthDate(c);
  let body = `Amount: ${fmt$(rawCost)}\n`;
  if(refund > 0){
    body += `${bank.icon} ${bank.name} insurance covered ${fmt$(refund)} (${Math.round(covFrac*100)}%)\n`;
    body += `Out of pocket: ${fmt$(netCost)}\nStatus: Paid from checking\n\n${d.body}`;
  } else {
    if(bank) body += `${bank.icon} ${bank.name}: no coverage for ${d.cat} on your plan.\n`;
    body += `Status: Paid from checking\n\n${d.body}`;
  }
  addInboxItem({
    type:'bill', icon:d.icon, subject:`${d.subject} â€” ${fmt$(netCost)}`, date, body,
  });
  logEvent(`${d.icon} ${d.subject}: -${fmt$(netCost)}${refund>0?` (insurance -${fmt$(refund)})`:''}`, 'bad');
}

function bankById(id){ return BANKS.find(b=>b.id===id) || null; }

function joinBank(c, bankId){
  const b = bankById(bankId);
  if(!b) return 'Bank not found.';
  const prev = c.bankId ? bankById(c.bankId) : null;
  // Switching fee
  if(prev && prev.id !== b.id){
    const fee = 50;
    if(c.checking < fee) return `Need ${fmt$(fee)} to close your ${prev.name} account.`;
    c.checking -= fee;
  }
  c.bankId = b.id;
  c.bankTenureMonths = 0;
  c.checking += b.signupBonus;
  const date = currentMonthDate(c);
  const covList = Object.entries(b.covers).map(([k,v])=>`  â€¢ ${k.padEnd(10,' ')} ${Math.round(v*100)}% coverage`).join('\n');
  addInboxItem({
    type:'news', icon:b.icon, subject:`Welcome to ${b.name}`, date,
    body:`${b.blurb}\n\nSignup bonus: +${fmt$(b.signupBonus)}\nMonthly fee: ${fmt$(b.fee)}\nAPY bonus on high-yield: +${b.apyBonus.toFixed(1)}%\n\nâ”€â”€ Insurance Coverage â”€â”€\n${covList||'  (none)'}\n\n${prev?`Previous bank (${prev.name}) closed. -${fmt$(50)} closing fee.`:'Welcome aboard.'}`
  });
  return `Joined ${b.name}. +${fmt$(b.signupBonus)} signup bonus credited.`;
}

// Auto-classify inbox items into a section ('opportunities' for offers/promos/raises/wins;
// 'bills_news' for everything else) and a priority color (red emergency, blue big offer, orange regular).
const INBOX_RED_RX  = /injury|hospital|hospitalized|lawsuit|sued|fine|penalty|relegat|fired|laid ?off|emergency|approval ratings collapse|robbery|burglary|crash|attack|assault|passed away|died|death|funeral|critical|cancer|surgery required|complications|bankrupt|foreclos|repossess|tornado|hurricane|earthquake|flood|fire damage|injured|broke|broken bone|fracture|concussion|defect|recall/i;
const INBOX_BLUE_RX = /\boffer\b|signed|signing|contract|raise|promotion|promoted|award|hall of fame|championship|brand deal|sponsorship|deal|bonus|won the lottery|callup|drafted|callback|book deal|nomination|grant|investment offer|equity|partnership offer|buyout/i;
const INBOX_OPP_RX  = /\boffer\b|signed|signing|contract|raise|promotion|promoted|brand deal|sponsorship|callup|drafted|bonus|book deal|investment offer|partnership offer|buyout|equity/i;

function classifyInboxItem(item){
  const subj = (item.subject||'') + ' ' + (item.body||'').slice(0,200);
  // Priority â€” explicit override wins
  let priority = item.priority;
  if(!priority){
    if(item.type === 'offer' && /raise|signing/i.test(subj)) priority = 'blue';
    else if(item.type === 'offer') priority = 'blue';
    else if(INBOX_RED_RX.test(subj)) priority = 'red';
    else if(INBOX_BLUE_RX.test(subj)) priority = 'blue';
    else priority = 'orange';
  }
  // Section
  let section = item.section;
  if(!section){
    section = (item.type === 'offer' || INBOX_OPP_RX.test(subj)) ? 'opportunities' : 'bills_news';
  }
  return { priority, section };
}

function addInboxItem(item){
  if(!GS.inbox) GS.inbox=[];
  const { priority, section } = classifyInboxItem(item);
  GS.inbox.unshift({id:`ib_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, read:false, priority, section, ...item});
  if(GS.inbox.length>40) GS.inbox.length=40;
}

function getInboxPrefs(){
  if(!GS.inboxPrefs) GS.inboxPrefs = { showRed: true, showBlue: true, showOrange: true };
  return GS.inboxPrefs;
}

function renderInbox(){
  const items = GS.inbox||[];
  const prefs = getInboxPrefs();
  const counts = { red:0, blue:0, orange:0 };
  // Dot counts are based on dotSeen, not read â€” opening the inbox clears the dots
  // while per-item unread state still shows in the modal until the player taps each one.
  for(const i of items){ if(!i.dotSeen){ const p = i.priority || classifyInboxItem(i).priority; if(counts[p] !== undefined) counts[p]++; } }
  for(const color of ['red','blue','orange']){
    const el = $('ibd-'+color);
    if(!el) continue;
    const enabled = prefs['show'+color.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+color.slice(1)];
    const show = enabled && counts[color] > 0;
    el.textContent = counts[color];
    el.className = 'inbox-dot '+color+(show?' show':'');
  }
}

function toggleInboxPref(color){
  const prefs = getInboxPrefs();
  const key = 'show'+color.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+color.slice(1);
  prefs[key] = !prefs[key];
  renderInbox();
  showInboxModal(_inboxSection || 'bills_news');
}

const rf = (lo,hi) => Math.random()*(hi-lo)+lo;
const clamp = (v,lo,hi) => Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,v));
const fmt$ = n => {
  if(n===undefined||n===null) return '$0';
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const sign = n<0?'-':'';
  if(abs>=1e9) return sign+'$'+(abs/1e9).toFixed(1)+'B';
  if(abs>=1e6) return sign+'$'+(abs/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M';
  if(abs>=1e3) return sign+'$'+Math.round(abs/100)/10+'k';
  return sign+'$'+Math.round(abs).toLocaleString();
};

function eduIdx(e){return EDU_LEVELS.indexOf(e)}

function computeSalary(char, tier){
  const [mn,mx] = EDU_SALARY[char.education]||[28000,55000];
  const base = rf(mn,mx);
  const sm = 0.5+(char.smarts/100);
  return Math.round(base*tier.salScale*sm);
}

function getJobTier(char){
  const eidx = eduIdx(char.education);
  if(eidx>=5) return CAREER_TIERS[3]; // doctoral+
  if(eidx>=3) return CAREER_TIERS[2]; // bachelors
  if(eidx>=2) return CAREER_TIERS[1]; // associates
  return CAREER_TIERS[0];
}

  char.yearsAtJob++;
  const raise = 0.01+(char.smarts/100)*0.02+(char.performance/100)*0.02;
  char.salary = Math.round(char.salary*(1+raise));
  // Promotion check
  const tIdx = CAREER_TIERS.findIndex(t=>t.id===char.careerTierId);
  const tier = CAREER_TIERS[tIdx];
  if(tIdx<CAREER_TIERS.length-1 && char.yearsAtJob>=tier.promYrs){
    if(pct(0.15+(char.performance/100)*0.35)){
      const next = CAREER_TIERS[tIdx+1];
      char.careerTierId = next.id;
      char.jobTitle = pick(next.title);
      char.salary = computeSalary(char, next);
      char.yearsAtJob = 0;
      ev.push({type:'career',text:`Promoted to ${char.jobTitle}! Salary: ${fmt$(char.salary)}/yr`});
    }
  }
  char.performance = clamp(char.performance+ri(-5,5),10,100);
  if(pct(0.03+(char.performance<30?0.1:0))){
    char.employed=false; char.salary=0; char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-15,0,100);
    ev.push({type:'career',text:'Laid off. Job lost.'});
  }
}

function getAvailableJobs(char){
  const charEdu = eduIdx(char.education);
  return ALL_JOBS
    .filter(j => charEdu >= eduIdx(j.edu))
    .sort((a,b) => b.min - a.min)
    .slice(0,8);
}

const ENV_JOB_IDS = new Set(['farmer','rancher','landscaper','gardener','arborist','env_scientist','conservationist','wildlife_biologist','park_ranger','zookeeper','marine_biologist','soil_scientist','hydrologist','forester','solar_installer']);
const JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER = ['healthcare','tech','trades','education','law','finance','creative','service','transport','environment','sports'];
function jobCategory(j){
  if(ENV_JOB_IDS.has(j.id)) return 'environment';
  return j.sector;
}
function getBalancedJobChoices(char){
  const charEdu = eduIdx(char.education);
  const eligible = ALL_JOBS.filter(j => charEdu >= eduIdx(j.edu));
  const byCat = {};
  JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER.forEach(c => byCat[c] = []);
  eligible.forEach(j => { const c = jobCategory(j); if(byCat[c]) byCat[c].push(j); });
  const shuffle = arr => { const a = arr.slice(); for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const k=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [a[i],a[k]]=[a[k],a[i]]; } return a; };
  const picked = [];
  const usedIds = new Set();
  // Guarantee one from each category if available
  shuffle(JOB_CATEGORY_ORDER).forEach(cat => {
    const pool = shuffle(byCat[cat]);
    if(pool.length){ picked.push(pool[0]); usedIds.add(pool[0].id); }
  });
  // Fill up to 14 with random eligible extras for variety
  const extras = shuffle(eligible.filter(j => !usedIds.has(j.id)));
  while(picked.length < 14 && extras.length) picked.push(extras.shift());
  return shuffle(picked);
}

function applyForJob(char, job){
  const smartsMod = 0.7 + (char.smarts/100)*0.6;
  char.employed     = true;
  char.jobId        = job.id;
  char.jobTitle     = job.name;
  char.jobSector    = job.sector;
  char.jobMin       = job.min;
  char.jobMax       = job.max;
  char.sportsTeam   = null;
  char.salary       = Math.round(rf(job.min, job.max) * smartsMod);
  char.yearsAtJob   = 0;
  char.monthsAtJob  = 0;
  char.careerTierId = 'tier' + job.tier;
  char.bossName     = pick(['Alex Mercer','Jordan Hayes','Taylor Quinn','Morgan Vance','Dana Rhodes','Sam Whitaker','Casey Lin','Riley Okafor']);
  char.bossMorale   = ri(55,75);
}

function buildJobChoices(char){
  const jobs = getBalancedJobChoices(char);
  if(!jobs.length){
    return [{text:'No jobs available â€” get more education',fn(){return'No qualifying jobs found. Consider furthering your education.'}}];
  }
  return jobs.map(job => ({
    text:`${job.name} (${job.sector}) â€” ${fmt$(job.min)}â€“${fmt$(job.max)}/yr`,
    fn(){
      applyForJob(char, job);
      return `Hired as ${job.name} in ${job.sector}! Starting salary: ${fmt$(char.salary)}/yr`;
    }
  }));
}

function tickRelationship(char, ev){
  const r = char.relationship;
  if(r==='single'&&char.age>=18){
    if(pct(0.12+(char.looks/100)*0.12)){
      char.relationship='dating'; char.spouseName=genName(); char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.spouseIncome=ri(25000,90000);
      ev.push({type:'good',text:`Started dating ${char.spouseName}.`});
    }
  } else if(r==='dating'){
    char.yearsTogether++;
    if(char.age>=21&&pct(Math.min(0.05+char.yearsTogether*0.07,0.5))){
      char.relationship='married';
      ev.push({type:'gold',text:`Married ${char.spouseName}!`});
    } else if(pct(Math.max(0.08-char.yearsTogether*0.01,0.02))){
      const n=char.spouseName; char.relationship='single'; char.spouseName=null; char.spouseIncome=0; char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-10,0,100);
      ev.push({type:'bad',text:`Broke up with ${n}.`});
    }
  } else if(r==='married'){
    char.yearsTogether++;
    char.spouseIncome=Math.round(char.spouseIncome*(1+rf(0.01,0.03)));
    const dChance = char.yearsTogether<5?0.04:char.yearsTogether<15?0.02:0.01;
    if(pct(dChance+(50-char.happiness)/500)){
      const n=char.spouseName; const settle=Math.round(char.checking*0.3);
      char.checking=Math.max(0,char.checking-settle); char.relationship='divorced';
      char.spouseName=null; char.spouseIncome=0; char.yearsTogether=0;
      char.happiness=clamp(char.happiness-20,0,100);
      ev.push({type:'bad',text:`Divorced ${n}. Settlement: ${fmt$(settle)}`});
    }
  } else if(r==='divorced'&&char.age<75){
    if(pct(0.1)){char.relationship='dating';char.spouseName=genName();char.yearsTogether=0;char.spouseIncome=ri(20000,80000);}
  }
}

function calcTax(income){
  const brackets=[[11600,0.10],[47150,0.12],[100525,0.22],[191950,0.24],[243725,0.32],[609350,0.35],[Infinity,0.37]];
  let tax=0,prev=0;
  for(const[lim,rate]of brackets){const s=Math.min(income,lim)-prev;if(s<=0)break;tax+=s*rate;prev=lim;}
  return Math.round(tax+income*0.05+Math.min(income,168600)*0.0765);
}

function tickFinances(char, ev){
  // All figures monthly, returned annualized for UI display
  const monthSalary = char.employed ? Math.round(char.salary/12) : 0;
  const monthSide = Math.round((char.sideHustleIncome||0)/12);
  const monthSpouse = char.relationship==='married' ? Math.round(char.spouseIncome*0.5/12) : 0;
  const monthGross = monthSalary + monthSide + monthSpouse;
  const monthTax = Math.round(calcTax(monthGross*12)/12);
  const monthNet = monthGross - monthTax;
  const expTable = {frugal:1500,normal:2333,lavish:3750};
  const livedInProp = (GS.inv&&GS.inv.properties||[]).find(p=>p.livedIn);
  // If living in own property: pay mortgage instead of rent-equivalent (~$1200 of exp), plus upkeep
  const housingAdj = livedInProp ? (livedInProp.monthlyPayment + 300 - 1200) : 0;
  const vehicleCost = vehicleMonthlyCost(GS.inv||{vehicles:[]});
  const monthLiving = (expTable[char.lifestyle]||2333) + Math.round(char.kids*15000/12) + housingAdj + vehicleCost;
  // Monthly debt interest + minimum payment
  if(char.debt>0){
    const interest = Math.round(char.debt*0.05/12);
    const pay = Math.max(50, Math.min(char.debt, Math.round(char.debt*0.01)+interest));
    char.debt = Math.max(0, char.debt+interest-pay);
  }
  // Bank monthly maintenance fee (after fee waiver check)
  if(char.bankId){
    const bk = bankById(char.bankId);
    const waivedThisMonth = char._bankFeeWaivedMonth === char.monthAge;
    if(bk && !waivedThisMonth){
      char.checking -= bk.fee;
    }
    char.bankTenureMonths = (char.bankTenureMonths||0) + 1;
  }
  const monthSavings = monthNet - monthLiving;
  char.checking += monthSavings;
  // Monthly compound interest on savings
  char.savings = Math.round(char.savings*(1+0.02/12));
  // High-yield: base 4% + optional bank APY bonus
  const apyBonus = char.bankId ? (bankById(char.bankId)?.apyBonus || 0) : 0;
  char.highYield = Math.round(char.highYield*(1+(0.04+apyBonus/100)/12));
  // Credit score: drift quarterly
  if(char.monthAge%3===0){
    if(char.debt>0&&char.checking>0) char.creditScore=clamp(char.creditScore+ri(-1,2),300,850);
    else if(char.debt===0) char.creditScore=clamp(char.creditScore+ri(0,2),300,850);
  }
  return {gross:monthGross*12, taxes:monthTax*12, livingCost:monthLiving*12, debtPay:char.debt>0?Math.round(char.debt*0.12):0, annSavings:monthSavings*12};
}

function tickDeath(char){
  // Annual probabilities divided by 12 for monthly check
  let base;
  if(char.age<40)base=0.003/12;
  else if(char.age<50)base=0.007/12;
  else if(char.age<60)base=0.015/12;
  else if(char.age<70)base=0.03/12;
  else if(char.age<80)base=0.07/12;
  else if(char.age<90)base=0.15/12;
  else base=0.30/12;
  const hm=1.0+(50-char.health)/100;
  if(pct(Math.min(base*hm,0.95))){
    char.alive=false;
    char.deathCause=char.age>=75?'Old Age':pick(DEATH_CAUSES);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function tickSchool(char, ev){
  if(!char.inSchool)return;
  char.checking-=char.schoolCostMonthly;
  char.debt+=char.schoolCostMonthly;
  char.schoolMonthsLeft--;
  if(char.schoolMonthsLeft<=0){
    const def=SCHOOL_DEFS[char.schoolType];
    char.inSchool=false; char.education=def.result;
    char.smarts=clamp(char.smarts+ri(5,15),0,100);
    ev.push({type:'gold',text:`Graduated with ${EDU_LABELS[def.result]}!`});
  }
}

function totalVehicleValue(inv){return (inv.vehicles||[]).reduce((s,v)=>s+v.value,0);}
function vehicleMonthlyCost(inv){return (inv.vehicles||[]).reduce((s,v)=>s+v.monthlyCost,0);}

function tickVehicles(inv){
  if(!inv.vehicles) inv.vehicles=[];
  for(const v of inv.vehicles){
    // Monthly depreciation = yearly rate / 12
    v.value = Math.max(Math.round(v.price*0.15), Math.round(v.value * (1 - v.depRate/12)));
    v.age = (v.age||0) + 1;
  }
}

function tickMarket(inv){
  if(inv.climateYearsLeft>0){inv.climateYearsLeft--;if(inv.climateYearsLeft===0)inv.climate='normal';}
  else{
    const r=Math.random();
    if(r<0.07){inv.climate='recession';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,3);}
    else if(r<0.13){inv.climate='bear';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,2);}
    else if(r<0.21){inv.climate='bull';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,3);}
    else if(r<0.25){inv.climate='bubble';inv.climateYearsLeft=ri(1,2);}
    else inv.climate='normal';
  }
}

const CLIMATE_MULT = {
  normal:{stock:1.0,tech:1.0,crypto:1.0,re:1.0},
  bull:{stock:1.4,tech:1.5,crypto:1.3,re:1.15},
  bear:{stock:0.75,tech:0.70,crypto:0.65,re:0.90},
  bubble:{stock:1.1,tech:2.0,crypto:1.5,re:1.0},
  recession:{stock:0.70,tech:0.65,crypto:0.50,re:0.85},
};

function tickStocks(inv){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  const SQRT12=Math.sqrt(12);
  for(const s of inv.stocks){
    const cm=s.sector==='tech'?m.tech:s.id==='SPY'?m.stock:m.stock;
    const annDrift=(s.avgReturn||0.08)*cm-1;
    const monthlyDrift=annDrift/12;
    const monthlyVol=s.vol/SQRT12;
    const z=randn();
    s.price=Math.max(0.01,+(s.price*(1+monthlyDrift+monthlyVol*z)).toFixed(2));
    s.history.push(s.price);if(s.history.length>50)s.history.shift();
  }
}

function tickCrypto(inv){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  const SQRT12=Math.sqrt(12);
  for(const c of inv.cryptos){
    const z=randn();
    const monthlyDrift=rf(-0.3,0.5)*m.crypto/12;
    const monthlyVol=c.vol*0.3/SQRT12;
    const ret=monthlyDrift+monthlyVol*z;
    c.price=Math.max(0.00001,+(c.price*(1+ret)).toPrecision(5));
    c.history.push(c.price);if(c.history.length>50)c.history.shift();
  }
}

function tickRetirement(inv, char){
  const baseRet={normal:0.07,bull:0.12,bear:0.02,bubble:0.09,recession:-0.05}[inv.climate]||0.07;
  const z=randn(); const r=baseRet+0.10*z;
  inv.k401=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.k401*(1+r)));
  inv.ira=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.ira*(1+r)));
  inv.roth=Math.max(0,Math.round(inv.roth*(1+r)));
  // Auto 401k contribution if employed
  if(char.employed&&char.salary>0){
    const contrib=Math.round(char.salary*0.05);
    const match=Math.round(char.salary*0.03);
    inv.k401+=contrib+match;
    char.checking-=contrib;
  }
}

function tickRealEstate(inv, ev){
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  let rentInc=0, mortPaid=0;
  for(const p of inv.properties){
    const z=randn(); const app=(0.03+0.06*z)*m.re;
    p.value=Math.max(10000,Math.round(p.value*(1+app)));
    if(p.debt>0){const pay=p.monthlyPayment*12;const int=p.debt*0.065;const prin=Math.min(p.debt,pay-int);p.debt=Math.max(0,p.debt-prin);mortPaid+=pay;}
    if(p.rented){p.rent=Math.round(p.rent*1.03);rentInc+=p.rent*12;}
    p.age++;
  }

function tickBusinesses(inv, char, ev){
  for(const b of inv.businesses){
    if(!b.employees) b.employees=[];
    if(b.equipTier===undefined){ b.equipTier=1; b.equipAge=0; }
    const cm=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
    const statF=(char.smarts/100)*0.6+(char.looks/100)*0.2+0.2;
    // Employee morale dampens boost: avg morale < 50 cuts effectiveness
    const avgMorale=b.employees.length ? b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.morale||75),0)/b.employees.length : 75;
    const moraleF=0.4 + (avgMorale/100)*0.7;  // ~0.75 at 50 morale, ~1.05 at 90
    const empBoost=1 + b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+((e.boost||0)*((e.morale||75)/75)),0);
    const einfo = equipmentInfo(b);
    const equipF = 1 + einfo.tier.revBoost - (einfo.old ? 0.08 : 0);
    const rev=Math.round(b.startCost*b.revMult*statF*(cm.stock)*rf(0.75,1.25)*Math.max(0.5,Math.log(b.age+2))*empBoost*equipF);
    const wages=b.employees.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.wage||0)*12,0);
    const exp=Math.round(rev*rf(0.55,0.75)+b.startCost*0.05)+wages;
    b.profit=rev-exp; b.value=Math.max(Math.round(b.startCost*0.3),Math.round(b.profit*rf(2,4)));
    b.age++;
    b.equipAge=(b.equipAge||0)+1;
    if(b.profit>0){char.checking+=b.profit;ev.push({type:'good',text:`${b.name} profit: ${fmt$(b.profit)} (wages ${fmt$(wages)}, morale ${Math.round(avgMorale)}%, equip ${einfo.tier.label}${einfo.old?' OLD':''})`});}
    else{char.checking+=b.profit;ev.push({type:'bad',text:`${b.name} loss: ${fmt$(Math.abs(b.profit))} (wages ${fmt$(wages)}, morale ${Math.round(avgMorale)}%, equip ${einfo.tier.label}${einfo.old?' OLD':''})`});}
  }
}

function rollSponsorOffers(){
  const inv = GS.inv;
  const bizVal = totalBizValue(inv);
  const scale = Math.min(4, 1 + Math.log10(Math.max(1, bizVal/500000))); // 1x at 500k, ~2x at 5M, ~3x at 50M
  const pool = SPONSOR_CATALOG.slice();
  const picks = [];
  const n = Math.min(5, pool.length);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const idx = ri(0, pool.length-1);
    const s = pool.splice(idx,1)[0];
    const monthly = Math.round(s.monthly * scale * rf(0.85, 1.25));
    picks.push({...s, monthly});
  }
  inv.sponsorOffers = picks;
  inv.sponsorOffersMonth = GS.char.monthAge;
  return picks;
}

    icon: team.emoji,
    subject: `${team.name} offers you a contract`,

  });
}

function sendSoccerStandings(c){

  // Random placement biased by salaryFactor: 60% top-6 if salary rich
  let playerPos;
  const r = Math.random();

  } else if(salaryFactor > 0.2){

  } else {

  else { playerSummary = `${c.sportsTeam} finished ${ordinal(playerPos)} â€” a mid-table season.`; c._euroComp = null; }

function sendEuroCompResults(c){
  const comp = c._euroComp;
  if(!comp || !EURO_COMP_POOLS[comp]) return;
  const meta = EURO_COMP_META[comp];
  const pool = EURO_COMP_POOLS[comp].filter(t => t !== c.sportsTeam);
  const salaryFactor = Math.min(1, (c.salary||0) / 10000000);
  // League-phase finish position (1-36), salary-biased

  let leaguePos;
  if(salaryFactor > 0.5) leaguePos = r<0.5 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.85 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  else if(salaryFactor > 0.2) leaguePos = r<0.3 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.75 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  else leaguePos = r<0.15 ? ri(1,8) : r<0.6 ? ri(9,24) : ri(25,36);
  const path = [];
  path.push(`League phase: finished ${ordinal(leaguePos)} of 36`);
  let champion = null;
  let eliminatedAt = null;
  const shuffleOpp = () => pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  const aggScore = (win) => {
    const a = win ? ri(2,4) : ri(0,2);
    const b = win ? ri(0,2) : ri(2,4);
    if(a === b) return `${a}-${b} (${win?'won':'lost'} on penalties)`;
    return `${a}-${b} agg`;
  };
  if(leaguePos > 24){
    eliminatedAt = 'league phase';
  } else {
    if(leaguePos > 8){
      const kpOpp = shuffleOpp();
      const win = Math.random() < (0.45 + salaryFactor*0.2);
      path.push(`Knockout Playoff vs ${kpOpp} â€” ${aggScore(win)} ${win?'âœ…':'â�Œ'}`);
      if(!win) eliminatedAt = 'Knockout Playoff';
    } else {
      path.push(`Top 8 finish â†’ direct to Round of 16 âœ…`);
    }
    if(!eliminatedAt){
      const rounds = ['Round of 16','Quarterfinal','Semifinal','Final'];
      for(const round of rounds){
        const opp = shuffleOpp();
        const isFinal = round === 'Final';
        const baseWin = 0.5 + salaryFactor*0.15;

function tickSoccerSeason(c){
  if(c.jobId !== 'soccer_player' || !c.sportsTeam) return;
  if(c._euroInit !== true){ initEuroCompForTeam(c); c._euroInit = true; }
  const monthInYear = c.monthAge % 12; // 0-indexed month position in life year
  // Proxy: monthInYear 7 = August (season start), monthInYear 5 = June (season end)
  if(monthInYear === 7){
    sendSoccerFixtures(c);

  } else if(monthInYear === 5){
    if(c._euroComp) sendEuroCompResults(c); // must fire before standings so the slot is clear
    sendSoccerStandings(c);
  }
}

function sendNHLPlayins(c){
  const team = c.sportsTeam;

  addInboxItem({type:'news', icon:'ðŸ�’', subject:`${conf} â€” standings + play-in (${team} ${ordinal(seed)})`, date:`Y${y}-Apr`, body});

}

function signSportsContract(item){
  const c = GS.char;
  if(!item || !item.offer) return 'Invalid offer.';

  const o = item.offer;

  c.jobTitle = `${baseRole} @ ${o.teamName}`;

function tickSponsors(inv, char){
  if(!inv.sponsors || !inv.sponsors.length) return;
  const remaining=[];
  for(const s of inv.sponsors){
    char.checking += s.monthly;
    s.monthsLeft--;
    if(s.monthsLeft <= 0){
      addInboxItem({
        type:'news', icon:s.icon,
        subject:`Sponsorship ended â€” ${s.name}`,
        date: currentMonthDate(char),
        body:`Your deal with ${s.name} has run its course.\n\nTotal monthly payments over the term added up over time. You can re-sign if they're still available in the Sponsors tab.`
      });
    } else {
      remaining.push(s);

  }
  inv.sponsors = remaining;
}

function stockPortfolioValue(inv){
  return Object.entries(inv.portfolio).reduce((s,[id,pos])=>{
    const st=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===id);return s+(st?st.price*pos.shares:0);},0);
}
function cryptoPortfolioValue(inv){
  return Object.entries(inv.cryptoHeld).reduce((s,[id,pos])=>{
    const c=inv.cryptos.find(x=>x.id===id);return s+(c?c.price*pos.coins:0);},0);
}
function totalRetirement(inv){return inv.k401+inv.ira+inv.roth;}
function totalPropertyValue(inv){return inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0);}
function totalPropertyEquity(inv){return inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+(p.value-p.debt),0);}
function totalBizValue(inv){return inv.businesses.reduce((s,b)=>s+b.value,0);}

function calcNetWorth(char, inv){
  const liquid=char.checking+char.savings+char.highYield;
  const invested=stockPortfolioValue(inv)+cryptoPortfolioValue(inv)+totalRetirement(inv)+totalPropertyEquity(inv)+totalBizValue(inv)+totalVehicleValue(inv);
  const debt=char.debt+(inv.properties.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.debt,0));
  return liquid+invested-debt;
}

function selectEvents(char){
  const rw={opportunity:60,disaster:40,milestone:50,flavor:30};
  const elig=EVENTS_POOL.filter(e=>{try{return e.cond(char)}catch{return false}});
  if(!elig.length)return[];
  const pool=elig.map(e=>({e,w:rw[e.cat]||20}));
  const total=pool.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.w,0);
  const count=ri(1,3); const sel=[]; const used=new Set();
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const rem=pool.filter(x=>!used.has(x.e.id));
    if(!rem.length)break;
    let r=Math.random()*rem.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.w,0);
    for(const{e,w}of rem){r-=w;if(r<=0){sel.push(e);used.add(e.id);break;}}
  }
  return sel;
}

// â”€â”€ Pending Expense Tick â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function tickPendingExpenses(char, ev){
  if(!char.pendingExpenses) char.pendingExpenses=[];
  const stillPending=[];
  for(const exp of char.pendingExpenses){
    exp.monthsLeft--;
    if(exp.monthsLeft<=0){
      // Time's up â€” force-pay regardless of balance
      const hadFunds = char.checking >= exp.cost;
      char.checking -= exp.cost;
      // Credit score hit: -15 to -25, worse if it pushed balance negative
      const scoreDrop = hadFunds ? ri(15,25) : ri(30,50);
      char.creditScore = clamp(char.creditScore - scoreDrop, 300, 850);
      const balanceNote = !hadFunds ? ` Account went negative!` : '';
      if(!char.belongings) char.belongings=[];
      char.belongings.push({id:`b_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, name:exp.name, icon:exp.icon, cost:exp.cost, purchasedAt:char.monthAge});
      ev.push({type:'bad', text:`âš ï¸� Forced payment: ${exp.icon} ${exp.name} â€” ${fmt$(exp.cost)} auto-deducted. Credit score -${scoreDrop}.${balanceNote}`});
    } else {
      stillPending.push(exp);
    }
  }
  char.pendingExpenses = stillPending;
}

// â”€â”€ Monthly Expense Generator â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function generateMonthlyExpenseEvent(char){
  if(char.age < 16) return null;
  // Pick 4 distinct items, each with its own rolled cost
  const pool = MONTHLY_EXPENSES.slice();
  const picks = [];
  const count = Math.min(4, pool.length);
  for(let i=0; i<count; i++){
    const idx = ri(0, pool.length-1);
    const item = pool.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    picks.push({item, cost: ri(item.min, item.max)});
  }
  const descLines = picks.map(p => `${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)}`).join('  Â·  ');
  const choices = [];
  for(const p of picks){
    choices.push({
      text:`Buy ${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)}`,
      fn(c){
        c.checking -= p.cost;
        const bump = ri(1,3);
        c.creditScore = clamp(c.creditScore + bump, 300, 850);
        if(!c.belongings) c.belongings=[];
        c.belongings.push({id:`b_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`, name:p.item.name, icon:p.item.icon, cost:p.cost, purchasedAt:c.monthAge});
        return `Paid ${fmt$(p.cost)} for ${p.item.name}. Added to belongings â€” sell anytime from Assets tab. Credit score +${bump}.`;
      }
    });
  }
  for(const p of picks){
    choices.push({
      text:`Defer ${p.item.icon} ${p.item.name} â€” ${fmt$(p.cost)} (10 mo)`,
      fn(c){
        if(!c.pendingExpenses) c.pendingExpenses=[];
        c.pendingExpenses.push({name:p.item.name, icon:p.item.icon, cost:p.cost, monthsLeft:10});
        return `Deferred ${p.item.name}. ${fmt$(p.cost)} due in 10 months. Miss it and your credit takes a hit.`;
      }
    });
  }
  choices.push({
    text:`Pass â€” none of these`,
    fn(){ return `Skipped this month's offers. Maybe next time.`; }
  });
  return {
    id: 'monthly_expense_'+Date.now(),
    title: 'Monthly Shopping Offers',
    cat: 'expense',
    icon: picks[0].item.icon,
    desc: `Four items caught your eye this month. Pick one to buy, defer the cost up to 10 months, or pass entirely.\n\n${descLines}`,
    choices,
  };
}

function monthlyTick(){
  const c=GS.char, inv=GS.inv;
  const ev=[];

  c.monthAge++;
  const prevAge = c.age;
  c.age = Math.floor(c.monthAge / 12);
  const isNewYear = c.age > prevAge; // a full year just completed

  // Auto high school at 14
  if(c.age===14&&isNewYear&&c.education==='none'&&!c.inSchool){
    c.inSchool=true;c.schoolType='high_school';c.schoolMonthsLeft=48;c.schoolCostMonthly=0;
    ev.push({type:'info',text:'Started high school.'});
  }

  // School progress (monthly)
  tickSchool(c, ev);

  // Auto seek job
  if(!c.inSchool&&!c.employed&&!c.retired&&c.age>=16&&pct(0.065)){
    const avail=getAvailableJobs(c);
    if(avail.length){const j=avail[ri(0,Math.min(2,avail.length-1))];applyForJob(c,j);ev.push({type:'good',text:`Got job: ${c.jobTitle} â€” ${fmt$(c.salary)}/yr`});}
  }

  // Monthly markets: prices update every month
  tickStocks(inv);
  tickCrypto(inv);
  tickVehicles(inv);

  // Annual systems: fire once per year
  if(isNewYear){
    tickCareerNew(c, ev);
    tickRelationship(c, ev);
    tickMarket(inv);
    tickRetirement(inv, c);
    tickRealEstate(inv, ev);
    tickBusinesses(inv, c, ev);
    if(c.age>40) c.health=clamp(c.health-rf(0.5,1.5),0,100);
  }

  // Tick deferred expenses (auto-pay overdue ones)
  tickPendingExpenses(c, ev);

  // Monthly sponsor payments + term tracking
  tickSponsors(inv, c);

  // Sports team contract offers (monthly chance for athletes)
  tickSportsOffers(c);

  // Soccer season events (fixtures in Aug, standings in Jun)
  tickSoccerSeason(c);
  // NFL season: Sep schedule, Jan playoffs, Feb Super Bowl
  tickNFLSeason(c);
  // NHL season: Oct schedule, Apr play-in, Jun Stanley Cup
  tickNHLSeason(c);

  // Monthly finances
  const fin=tickFinances(c, ev);

  // Happiness drifts slowly each month
  c.happiness=clamp(Math.round(c.happiness+(55-c.happiness)*0.004),0,100);

  // Net worth
  const prevNW = GS.nwHistory.length?GS.nwHistory[GS.nwHistory.length-1]:0;
  const nw=calcNetWorth(c,inv);
  GS.nwHistory.push(nw);

  // Log background events
  for(const e of ev) logEvent(e.text, e.type||'info');

  // Death check (monthly probability)
  if(tickDeath(c)){
    setTimeout(()=>showGameOver(),500);
    return;
  }

  // Build event queue: monthly expense first, then life event, then occasional tip
  GS.pendingEvents=[];
  const expEvent = generateMonthlyExpenseEvent(c);
  if(expEvent) GS.pendingEvents.push(expEvent);
  if(pct(0.30)){
    const events=selectEvents(c);
    if(events.length) GS.pendingEvents.push(events[0]);
  }
  // Financial tip: roughly every 4-5 months
  if(pct(0.22)) GS.pendingEvents.push(generateTipEvent());

  // Inbox: monthly news + bills
  generateInboxItems(c, inv);

  // Downside event: 3% monthly chance
  if(pct(0.03)) triggerDownside(c);

  // Bank update message: ~9% monthly chance (about 1/year per bank feature)
  maybeEmitBankUpdate(c);

  // Employee check-ins: monthly morale drift + inbox messages from staff
  tickEmployeeMessages(c, inv);

  updateUI(fin, prevNW, nw);
  saveGame();

  if(GS.pendingEvents.length>0) showNextEvent();
}

function resaleValue(item, c){
  const ageMonths = Math.max(0, (c.monthAge||0) - (item.purchasedAt||0));
  // First month: 70% resale; drop 3% per month; floor at 15% of cost
  const factor = Math.max(0.15, 0.70 - ageMonths*0.03);
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(item.cost * factor));
}

function renderBelongings(c){
  const el=$('belongings-list'); if(!el) return;
  const items=c.belongings||[];
  if(!items.length){
    el.innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px">Nothing to sell. Monthly expense items you buy will show up here.</p>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = items.map((b,i)=>{
    const resale = resaleValue(b, c);
    const ageM = Math.max(0, (c.monthAge||0) - (b.purchasedAt||0));
    return `<div class="info-row" style="align-items:center">
      <span class="ir-label">${b.icon} ${b.name} <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:10px">Â· ${ageM}mo old Â· paid ${fmt$(b.cost)}</span></span>
      <span style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center">
        <span class="ir-value pos">${fmt$(resale)}</span>
        <button class="choice-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px;margin:0" onclick="sellBelonging('${b.id}')">Sell</button>
      </span>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function sellBelonging(id){
  const c=GS.char; if(!c||!c.belongings) return;
  const idx=c.belongings.findIndex(b=>b.id===id); if(idx<0) return;
  const item=c.belongings[idx];
  const resale=resaleValue(item, c);
  c.checking += resale;
  c.belongings.splice(idx,1);
  logEvent(`Sold ${item.icon} ${item.name} for ${fmt$(resale)} (paid ${fmt$(item.cost)}).`, 'info');
  showToast(`Sold ${item.name} for ${fmt$(resale)}`);
  saveGame();
  renderBelongings(c);
  setText('fi-check',fmt$(c.checking));
}

function drawCreditDial(score){
  const canvas=$('credit-canvas'); if(!canvas)return;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cx=W/2,cy=H-10,r=H-20;
  // Background arc
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,Math.PI,0);ctx.strokeStyle='#2e4a2e';ctx.lineWidth=12;ctx.stroke();
  // Score arc
  const pct=(score-300)/550;
  const col=score>=750?'#00c853':score>=670?'#ffd700':score>=580?'#ffa726':'#ff3d3d';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,Math.PI,Math.PI+(pct*Math.PI));ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=12;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
  // Score label
  const el=$('cs-score'); if(el){el.textContent=score;el.style.color=col;}
  const gradeEl=$('cs-grade'); if(gradeEl){
    gradeEl.textContent=score>=800?'Exceptional':score>=740?'Very Good':score>=670?'Good':score>=580?'Fair':'Poor';
  }
}

function drawNetWorthChart(){
  const canvas=$('nw-chart'); if(!canvas)return;
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const W=canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;const H=80;
  canvas.width=W*dpr;canvas.height=H*dpr;
  canvas.style.width=W+'px';canvas.style.height=H+'px';
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  const hist=GS.nwHistory;if(hist.length<2)return;
  const mn=Math.min(...hist),mx=Math.max(...hist);
  const range=mx-mn||1;
  const pts=hist.map((v,i)=>[i/(hist.length-1)*W,H-10-((v-mn)/range)*(H-20)]);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  const last=hist[hist.length-1];
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  const col=last>=0?'rgba(0,200,83,.3)':'rgba(255,61,61,.3)';
  grad.addColorStop(0,col);grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.lineTo(W,H);ctx.lineTo(0,H);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.strokeStyle=last>=0?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();
  // Current dot
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pts[pts.length-1][0],pts[pts.length-1][1],4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=last>=0?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';ctx.fill();
}

// â”€â”€ Mini sparkline chart for asset cards â”€â”€
function drawMiniChart(canvas, history, up){
  if(!canvas) return;
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const W=canvas.clientWidth||220, H=50;
  canvas.width=W*dpr; canvas.height=H*dpr;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(!history||history.length<2){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#4a6a4a'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,H/2); ctx.lineTo(W,H/2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--muted');
    ctx.font='10px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('No history yet',W/2,H/2+14);
    return;
  }
  const mn=Math.min(...history), mx=Math.max(...history);
  const range=mx-mn||Math.abs(mn)*0.01||1;
  const pad=4;
  const pts=history.map((v,i)=>[i/(history.length-1)*W, H-pad-((v-mn)/range)*(H-pad*2)]);
  const col=up?'#00c853':'#ff3d3d';
  // fill gradient
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, up?'rgba(0,200,83,.35)':'rgba(255,61,61,.35)');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle=grad; ctx.fill();
  // line
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke();
  // end dot
  const last=pts[pts.length-1];
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(last[0],last[1],2.5,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fill();
}

      if(c.checking<wanted){ showToast('Not enough cash.'); return; }
      const shares=Math.floor(wanted / s.price);
      const cost=Math.round(shares * s.price);
      if(shares<1){ showToast('Amount buys 0 shares.'); return; }
      c.checking-=cost;
      if(!inv.portfolio[s.id]) inv.portfolio[s.id]={shares:0,avgCost:0};
      const p=inv.portfolio[s.id]; p.avgCost=(p.avgCost*p.shares+cost)/(p.shares+shares); p.shares+=shares;
      showToast(`Bought ${shares} ${s.id} for ${fmt$(cost)}`);
      refreshStockCard(buyId); refreshStockAffordability();
    }else if(sellId){
      const s=inv.stocks.find(x=>x.id===sellId); const p=inv.portfolio[sellId]; if(!p) return;
      const proceeds=Math.round(s.price*p.shares);
      const cg=Math.round((s.price-p.avgCost)*p.shares);

      c.checking+=proceeds-tax;
      delete inv.portfolio[sellId];
      showToast(`Sold ${sellId} for ${fmt$(proceeds-tax)}`);
      refreshStockCard(sellId); refreshStockAffordability();
    }
  };
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>cards.forEach(cd=>drawMiniChart($(cd.canvas), cd.history, cd.up)));
}

// Build a synthetic vertical league table for the player's team's league
function buildSoccerStandings(c){
  const league = soccerPlayerTeamLeague(c);
  if(!league || !SOCCER_LEAGUE_TEAMS[league]) return null;
  const teams = SOCCER_LEAGUE_TEAMS[league].slice();
  if(!teams.includes(c.sportsTeam)) teams.unshift(c.sportsTeam);
  // Use cached standings per league/team if present
  const key = league+'|'+c.sportsTeam;
  if(c._lgStandingsKey === key && Array.isArray(c._lgStandings)) return { league, rows: c._lgStandings };
  const rows = teams.map(t => {
    const played = ri(20, 28);
    const w = ri(4, played-3);
    const d = ri(1, Math.max(2, played-w-1));
    const l = Math.max(0, played - w - d);
    const gf = w*2 + d + ri(0, 12);
    const ga = l*2 + ri(0, 14);
    return { team: t, p: played, w, d, l, gf, ga, gd: gf-ga, pts: w*3+d };
  });
  rows.sort((a,b) => b.pts - a.pts || b.gd - a.gd || b.gf - a.gf);
  c._lgStandings = rows;
  c._lgStandingsKey = key;
  return { league, rows };
}
function buildEuroCompStandings(c){
  if(!c._euroComp || !EURO_COMP_POOLS[c._euroComp]) return null;
  const meta = EURO_COMP_META[c._euroComp];
  const pool = [c.sportsTeam, ...EURO_COMP_POOLS[c._euroComp].filter(t => t !== c.sportsTeam)].slice(0, 36);
  const key = c._euroComp+'|'+c.sportsTeam;
  if(c._euroStandingsKey === key && Array.isArray(c._euroStandings)) return { meta, rows: c._euroStandings };
  const rows = pool.map(t => {
    const p = ri(2, 8);
    const w = ri(0, p);
    const d = ri(0, Math.max(0, p-w));
    const l = Math.max(0, p-w-d);
    return { team: t, p, w, d, l, gf: w*2+d+ri(0,4), ga: l*2+ri(0,5), gd: 0, pts: w*3+d };
  });
  rows.forEach(r => r.gd = r.gf - r.ga);
  rows.sort((a,b) => b.pts - a.pts || b.gd - a.gd || b.gf - a.gf);
  c._euroStandings = rows;
  c._euroStandingsKey = key;
  return { meta, rows };
}

}

$('btn-bank').onclick=()=>{
  const c=GS.char;
  const cur = c.bankId ? bankById(c.bankId) : null;
  const sector = c.jobSector;
  const headline = cur
    ? `Bank: ${cur.icon} ${cur.name} Â· Fee ${fmt$(cur.fee)}/mo Â· APY +${cur.apyBonus.toFixed(1)}%`
    : 'No bank yet. Pick one to unlock insurance, bonuses, and APY perks.';
  const choices = [
    {text:`Move $5k to Savings (2% APY)`,fn(){if(c.checking<5000)return'Not enough in checking.';c.checking-=5000;c.savings+=5000;return`Moved $5,000 to savings.`}},
    {text:`Move $5k to High-Yield (4%${cur?` +${cur.apyBonus.toFixed(1)}%`:''})`,fn(){if(c.checking<5000)return'Not enough in checking.';c.checking-=5000;c.highYield+=5000;return`Moved $5,000 to high-yield savings.`}},
    {text:`Personal Loan $10k (11.5% APR)`,fn(){c.checking+=10000;c.debt+=10000;return`Loan approved. +$10,000 cash, +$10,000 debt.`}},
    {text:`Pay off $5k debt`,fn(){if(c.checking<5000)return'Not enough.';if(c.debt<5000)return`Debt is only ${fmt$(c.debt)}.`;c.checking-=5000;c.debt-=5000;return`Paid $5,000 debt. Remaining: ${fmt$(c.debt)}`}},
  ];

  if(cur){
    const covTxt = Object.entries(cur.covers).map(([k,v])=>`${k}:${Math.round(v*100)}%`).join(' Â· ');
    choices.push({text:`ðŸ›¡ï¸� View my coverage (${covTxt||'none'})`, fn(){
      return `${cur.icon} ${cur.name}\n${cur.blurb}\nFee: ${fmt$(cur.fee)}/mo Â· Signup: ${fmt$(cur.signupBonus)} Â· APY +${cur.apyBonus.toFixed(1)}%\n\nCoverage: ${covTxt||'â€”'}`;
    }});

  const rankedBanks = [...BANKS].sort((a,b)=>{
    const as = sector && a.suits.includes(sector) ? 1 : 0;
    const bs = sector && b.suits.includes(sector) ? 1 : 0;
    return bs - as;
  });
  for(const b of rankedBanks){
    const isMine = cur && cur.id===b.id;
    const fit = sector && b.suits.includes(sector) ? ' â­�FIT' : '';
    const mineTag = isMine ? ' âœ… CURRENT' : '';
    const covTop = Object.entries(b.covers).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).slice(0,2)
      .map(([k,v])=>`${k} ${Math.round(v*100)}%`).join(', ');
    choices.push({
      text:`${b.icon} ${b.name}${fit}${mineTag} â€” ${fmt$(b.fee)}/mo Â· ${covTop||'basic'}`,
      fn(){
        if(isMine) return `Already a member at ${b.name}.`;
        return joinBank(c, b.id);
      }
    });
  }
  showActionModal('Banking', headline, choices);
  $('modal-box').classList.add('compact');
};

$('btn-realty').onclick=()=>{
  const inv=GS.inv,c=GS.char;
  const m=CLIMATE_MULT[inv.climate]||CLIMATE_MULT.normal;
  const tiers=[
    {name:'Starter Condo',price:Math.round(ri(150000,280000)*m.re)},
    {name:'2BR House',price:Math.round(ri(280000,500000)*m.re)},
    {name:'3BR House',price:Math.round(ri(450000,750000)*m.re)},
    {name:'Luxury Home',price:Math.round(ri(800000,2000000)*m.re)},
  ];
  const choices=tiers.map(t=>{
    const down=Math.round(t.price*0.2); const debt=t.price-down;
    const mp=Math.round(debt*(0.065/12)*Math.pow(1+0.065/12,360)/(Math.pow(1+0.065/12,360)-1));
    return{text:`Buy ${t.name}: ${fmt$(t.price)} (${fmt$(down)} down, ${fmt$(mp)}/mo mortgage)`,fn(){
      if(c.checking<down)return`Need ${fmt$(down)} for down payment.`;
      c.checking-=down;
      const isFirst = !inv.properties.some(p=>p.livedIn);
      inv.properties.push({name:t.name,value:t.price,debt,monthlyPayment:mp,rented:false,rent:Math.round(t.price*0.006),age:0,livedIn:isFirst});
      c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(p=>p.livedIn);
      return`Bought ${t.name}! Equity: ${fmt$(down)}${isFirst?' Â· Moved in.':''}`;
    }};
  });
  // Per-property options: move in/out, rent toggle, sell
  for(let i=0;i<inv.properties.length;i++){
    const p=inv.properties[i];
    const tag=p.livedIn?' ðŸ�¡ (living here)':p.rented?' ðŸ’° (renting out)':' (vacant)';
    if(!p.livedIn){
      choices.push({text:`Move into ${p.name}${tag}`,fn(){
        inv.properties.forEach(x=>x.livedIn=false);
        p.livedIn=true; p.rented=false;
        c.hasHouse=true;
        return`Moved into ${p.name}. Your new home!`;
      }});
    } else {
      choices.push({text:`Move out of ${p.name}${tag}`,fn(){
        p.livedIn=false;
        c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(x=>x.livedIn);
        return`Moved out of ${p.name}. Now paying rent elsewhere.`;
      }});
    }
    if(!p.livedIn){
      if(!p.rented) choices.push({text:`Rent out ${p.name} (~${fmt$(p.rent)}/mo)`,fn(){p.rented=true;return`Now renting for ${fmt$(p.rent)}/mo!`}});
      else choices.push({text:`Stop renting ${p.name}`,fn(){p.rented=false;return'Stopped renting.'}});
    }
    choices.push({text:`Sell ${p.name} (equity: ${fmt$(p.value-p.debt)})${tag}`,fn(){
      const eq=p.value-p.debt; c.checking+=eq;
      inv.properties.splice(i,1);
      c.hasHouse=inv.properties.some(x=>x.livedIn);
      return`Sold for ${fmt$(eq)} net equity.${!c.hasHouse?' Back to renting.':''}`;
    }});
  }
  choices.unshift({text:'ðŸš— Browse Vehicles (cars, bikes, boats, planes)',fn(){setTimeout(()=>showVehiclesModal(),50);return'Opening vehicles...';}});

function runSideHustle(h){
  const c=GS.char;
  if(c.checking<h.cost) return `Need ${fmt$(h.cost)} startup capital.`;
  c.checking-=h.cost;
  let successRate=h.success;
  if(h.stat==='smarts') successRate=clamp(successRate*(0.5+c.smarts/100),0,0.95);
  else if(h.stat==='looks') successRate=clamp(successRate*(0.5+c.looks/100),0,0.95);
  if(pct(successRate)){
    const statMult = h.stat==='smarts'?(0.6+c.smarts/120):h.stat==='looks'?(0.6+c.looks/120):1.0;
    const inc = Math.round((h.incMin + Math.random()*(h.incMax-h.incMin)) * statMult);
    if(inc<=0){
      const loss=Math.abs(inc);
      return `${h.name} lost money. Down ${fmt$(loss+h.cost)} total.`;
    }
    c.sideHustleIncome=(c.sideHustleIncome||0)+inc;
    return `ðŸŽ‰ ${h.name} paying off! +${fmt$(inc)}/yr side-hustle income (tracked separately from job salary).`;
  }
  const loss = h.incMin<0 ? Math.round(Math.abs(h.incMin)*Math.random()) : 0;
  if(loss>0){ c.checking-=loss; return `â�Œ ${h.name} flopped. Lost ${fmt$(h.cost+loss)} total.`; }
  return `â�Œ ${h.name} didn't gain traction. Lost ${fmt$(h.cost)} startup.`;
}

  function adoptPet(idx, name){
    const c=GS.char; const sp=PET_SPECIES[idx];
    if(!sp) return 'Pick a species.';
    if(c.pet) return `You already have ${c.pet.name}.`;
    if(c.checking < sp.cost) return `Need ${fmt$(sp.cost)} to adopt.`;

    return `Welcome ${sp.emoji} ${c.pet.name}! +6 happiness.`;
  }
  function tickPet(c){
    if(!c.pet) return;
    c.pet.ageMonths++;
    c.checking -= c.pet.upkeep;
    if(c.monthAge % 12 === 0) c.happiness = clamp(c.happiness + Math.round(c.pet.joy * 0.4), 0, 100);
    const ratio = c.pet.ageMonths / c.pet.lifeExpect;
    const deathPct = ratio < 0.7 ? 0.0005 : ratio < 0.95 ? 0.006 : 0.06;
    if(pct(deathPct)){
      inboxNow(c, {type:'news', icon:'ðŸ’”', subject:`${c.pet.name} passed away`, date:currentMonthDate(c),
        body:`Your ${c.pet.species.toLowerCase()} ${c.pet.name} passed peacefully at ${(c.pet.ageMonths/12).toFixed(1)} years old. They will be missed.`});
      c.happiness = clamp(c.happiness - 8, 0, 100);
      logScrap(c, `Lost pet ${c.pet.name}`, 'bad');
      c.pet = null;
    }
  }

  function genFriendName(){
    const f=['Sam','Riley','Max','Jamie','Taylor','Sky','Kai','Ash','Drew','Quinn','Blake','Sage','Reese','Jules'];
    const l=['T.','J.','M.','R.','S.','P.','K.','D.','B.','C.','H.'];

  }
  function makeFriend(){
    const c=GS.char;
    if(c.friends.length >= 5) return 'Your circle is full (5 friends).';
    const f={name:genFriendName(), closeness:ri(40,70), since:c.age};
    c.friends.push(f);
    return `New friend: ${f.name} (${f.closeness}% closeness).`;
  }
  function tickFriends(c){
    for(const f of c.friends){ f.closeness = clamp(f.closeness + ri(-2, 2), 0, 100); }

    if(pct(0.018) && c.friends.length){

  // Health: quick checkup + elective surgery
  function doCheckup(){
    const c=GS.char, cost=250;
    if(c.checking < cost) return `Need ${fmt$(cost)}.`;
    c.checking -= cost;
    const rec = ri(2,8);
    c.health = clamp(c.health + rec, 0, 100);

    const c=GS.char;

    const bank = c.bankId ? BANKS.find(b=>b.id===c.bankId) : null;
    const cov = bank ? (bank.covers.medical || 0) : 0;
    const refund = Math.round(cost*cov);

  function donate(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    if(c.checking < amount) return `Need ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
    c.checking -= amount;
    c.charityGiven += amount;
    c.happiness = clamp(c.happiness + Math.min(8, Math.round(amount/5000) + 2), 0, 100);

  function buyBonds(amount){
    const c=GS.char, inv=GS.inv;

    if(c.checking < amount) return `Need ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
    c.checking -= amount;
    inv.bonds = (inv.bonds||0) + amount;
    return `Bought ${fmt$(amount)} in 5-yr Treasuries (~4.5%/yr).`;
  }

    const inv=GS.inv, c=GS.char;
    const a = Math.min(inv.bonds||0, amount);
    if(a <= 0) return 'No bonds to sell.';
    inv.bonds -= a; c.checking += a;

    const baseRet = {normal:0.08, bull:0.14, bear:0.01, bubble:0.10, recession:-0.05}[inv.climate]||0.08;
    const r = baseRet + 0.18 * randn();
    inv.indexFunds = Math.max(0, Math.round((inv.indexFunds||0) * (1 + r/12)));

  // Personal loans (separate from existing student debt / credit cards)
  function takeLoan(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    const cs = c.creditScore || 580;
    const rate = cs>=750?0.06 : cs>=680?0.09 : cs>=620?0.13 : 0.20;
    const max = Math.round(((c.salary||30000) + 0.1*(c.savings||0)) * (cs>=720?2:1));
    if(amount > max) return `Max ${fmt$(max)} at credit ${cs}.`;
    c.checking += amount;
    c.personalLoan = (c.personalLoan||0) + amount;
    c.personalLoanRate = rate;
    return `Borrowed ${fmt$(amount)} at ${(rate*100).toFixed(1)}% APR.`;

  function payLoan(amount){
    const c=GS.char;
    if((c.personalLoan||0) <= 0) return 'No active loans.';
    if(c.checking < amount) return `Need ${fmt$(amount)}.`;
    const pay = Math.min(amount, c.personalLoan);
    c.checking -= pay;
    c.personalLoan -= pay;
    if(c.personalLoan <= 0){
      c.creditScore = clamp((c.creditScore||580) + 12, 300, 850);

    return `Paid ${fmt$(pay)}. Balance: ${fmt$(c.personalLoan)}.`;

      c.personalLoan = Math.max(0, c.personalLoan + interest - minPay);

    if(c.monthAge % 12 !== 4) return; // April

  function startNGPlus(){
    const c = GS.char;
    const peakNW = c ? calcNetWorth(c, GS.inv) : 0;
    const inheritedKids = Math.round(peakNW * (c?c.willPctKids/100:0)) || 0;
    const startCash = Math.min(5000000, Math.max(0, Math.round(inheritedKids * 0.01)));
    const heirName = c ? `${(c.name.split(' ')[0])||c.name} Jr.` : 'New Player';
    const newGen = (c?c.ngGeneration:0) + 1;
    GS.scenario = startCash > 1000000 ? 'rich' : startCash > 50000 ? 'middle' : 'broke';
    GS.char = createChar(heirName, GS.scenario);
    GS.char.checking = Math.max(GS.char.checking, startCash);
    GS.char.ngGeneration = newGen;
    GS.inv = createInvState();
    GS.nwHistory = [calcNetWorth(GS.char, GS.inv)];
    GS.inbox = [];
    GS.billAccum = [];
    GS.pendingEvents = [];
    ensureExtras(GS.char, GS.inv);
    showScreen('game');
    renderExtras();
    updateUI(null, 0, calcNetWorth(GS.char, GS.inv));
    showToast(`NG+ Generation ${newGen} â€” inherited ${fmt$(startCash)}`);
  }

  // â”€â”€ PATCH calcNetWorth to include new assets/liabilities â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const _origCalcNW = window.calcNetWorth;
  window.calcNetWorth = function(char, inv){
    const base = _origCalcNW(char, inv);
    const bondsV = (inv && inv.bonds)||0;
    const idxV = (inv && inv.indexFunds)||0;
    const hobV = ((inv && inv.hobbies)||[]).reduce((s,h)=>s+h.value, 0);
    const loan = (char && char.personalLoan)||0;
    return base + bondsV + idxV + hobV - loan;
  };

  // Sign canvas: front-of-building shop sign with icon + label
  function makeSignTexture(cfg){

    // â”€â”€ Walls â”€â”€

    body.position.y = tier1H / 2;

    // Skyscraper: add a slimmer second tier
    let topY = tier1H;
    if (isSkyscraper){

    // â”€â”€ Roof â”€â”€
    const roofMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: cfg.color });
    if (isSkyscraper){
      // Flat parapet roof + antenna
      const parapet = new THREE.Mesh(

      const rim = new THREE.Mesh(

      );
      rim.position.y = topY + 0.15;
      group.add(rim);
      // green pitch on top
      const pitch = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(tier1W*0.85, 0.05, tier1D*0.85),
        new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x5cb85c })
      );
      pitch.position.y = topY + 0.32;
      group.add(pitch);
    } else {
      // Pyramid roof (4-sided cone, rotated 45Â°)
      const r = Math.max(tier1W, tier1D) * 0.78;
      const roof = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, 1.7, 4), roofMat);
      roof.position.y = topY + 0.85;
      roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
      group.add(roof);
      // Trim band at top of walls

      group.add(trim);

    // â”€â”€ Door (front face = +Z in local space) â”€â”€

    );

    group.add(door);

      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 8, 6),

    const step = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4, 0.12, 0.6),

    );
    step.position.set(0, 0.06, tier1D/2 + 0.32);
    group.add(step);

    // â”€â”€ Windows â”€â”€
    const winMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
      color: 0x9fdcff,
      emissive: 0x4fc3f7,
      emissiveIntensity: 0.15,
    });
    const frameMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x222222 });
    function addWindow(x, y, z, rotY, ww=0.95, wh=0.95){
      const fr = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ww+0.12, wh+0.12, 0.06), frameMat);
      const w  = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ww, wh, 0.04), winMat);
      fr.position.set(x, y, z); fr.rotation.y = rotY;
      w.position.set(x, y, z);  w.rotation.y = rotY;
      const out = 0.05;
      if (rotY === 0)             { fr.position.z += 0.01; w.position.z += out; }
      else if (rotY === Math.PI)  { fr.position.z -= 0.01; w.position.z -= out; }
      else if (rotY ===  Math.PI/2){fr.position.x += 0.01; w.position.x += out; }
      else if (rotY === -Math.PI/2){fr.position.x -= 0.01; w.position.x -= out; }
      group.add(fr); group.add(w);

      addWindow( 1.55, 1.7, tier1D/2, 0);

      addWindow( tier1W/2,  1.7,  1.4, Math.PI/2);
      addWindow( tier1W/2,  1.7, -1.4, Math.PI/2);
      addWindow(-tier1W/2,  1.7,  1.4,-Math.PI/2);
      addWindow(-tier1W/2,  1.7, -1.4,-Math.PI/2);

      addWindow(-1.55, 1.7, -tier1D/2, Math.PI);

      for (let i=0; i<6; i++){

    const ltex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(lc);
    const lsprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: ltex, transparent: true, depthTest: false }));
    lsprite.renderOrder = 999;
    lsprite.scale.set(4.2, 1.05, 1);

    lsprite.position.set(cfg.pos[0], labelY, cfg.pos[1]);
    scene.add(lsprite);

    buildings3d.push({
      group, label: lsprite, cfg,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(cfg.pos[0], 0, cfg.pos[1]),
      collideR: Math.max(tier1W, tier1D) * 0.5 + 0.4,
    });
